Position: Infrastructure Engineer
Location: Poland/Europe - Remote
Type: This can be structured as a B2B contract or Employment Contract with full benefits
Poland B2B Annual Rate: $102,000 - $117,500 depending on experience + stock options
Portugal Salary Band: €60,000 - €72,000 depending on experience + stock options

Who We Are

Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are a Silicon Valley-based startup headquartered in San Francisco, with operations in Canada, the UK, multiple EU countries and a tech hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning-first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick-and-mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world, processing hundreds of millions of images per day across tens of thousands of stores globally.

We were recently named Confluent's inaugural Data Streaming Startup of the Year, a recognition of how seriously we take the engineering challenges at the core of our business.

We seek smart, creative, and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a Platform Engineer to own the platform that every image from every store passes through: ingestion, Kafka streaming, Python services, GPU model inference, databases, storage, and the GCP and Kubernetes layer underneath. The team is small, so there is no separate SRE, DBA or release team. When a pipeline slows down, you find out whether the cause is a Kafka consumer, a MySQL query, an autoscaler or a node pool, and you fix it, including in the application code. The role is cloud-only, with no on-prem or datacenter hardware, and CI/CD pipelines are a small part of it.

The core challenge is scale. We are processing hundreds of millions of images per day across tens of thousands of retail locations globally, and that number is growing fast. Load will grow by an order of magnitude, and your job is to make sure cost and operational effort do not grow with it.

What You Will Do

  • Own the design, operation and cost of Focal's production platform on GCP: Kubernetes, Kafka, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, object storage.
  • Drive measurable reductions in COGS and latency, for example lowering GPU inference cost per store through machine types, batching, autoscaling or scheduling, and report the numbers.
  • Read, debug and change Python (FastAPI, Kafka consumers) backend services. Platform problems are often fixed in application code, for example a MySQL query that ran fine at 1,000 stores and times out at 10,000.
  • Fix throughput bottlenecks such as consumer lag at store opening, whether the cause is partition count, consumer throughput, a downstream database or autoscaling reaction time.
  • Rework metrics, alerts and dashboards so the on-call engineer can tell which stores and regions are affected when an alert fires. Take part in incident response, postmortems and capacity planning.
  • Build tooling that gives engineers access to data across regions and storage systems in minutes instead of days.
  • Maintain infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm) and the deployment path to production, and work with the backend, deep learning and edge teams so the platform keeps up with new products and models.

What You Need to Be Successful

Must have

  • Python as a software engineer, not only for scripting. You will contribute to backend code every week.
  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems on a cloud platform. GCP preferred; deep AWS or Azure experience is fine.
  • Hands-on production experience operating at least one stateful system under load: Kafka or another streaming platform, MySQL/PostgreSQL, or MongoDB. We mean partitioning, replication, lag, slow queries and failover, not only provisioning.
  • Kubernetes in production, including scheduling, resource limits, autoscaling with KEDA, GPU node pools and debugging misbehaving pods.
  • Debugging production incidents across layers (application, messaging, database, orchestration, network), with examples you can walk us through.
  • Observability with Prometheus, Grafana, Grafana Mimir and Sentry, or equivalent: instrumenting code, writing useful alerts.
  • Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool.

Nice to have

  • MySQL query tuning; Kafka internals (consumer group rebalancing, partition strategy, throughput tuning), Confluent Cloud and Kafka Connect.
  • GPU workloads or ML inference serving in production (Ray/KubeRay or similar), and cloud cost optimization with measured results.
  • Go, Snowflake, Airflow, CircleCI, Helm, and blue/green or canary releases.

About you

  • You take ownership of problems end to end and follow them into whichever layer they lead.
  • You make decisions from data (profiles, metrics, query plans, cost reports) and prioritize well in startup/scaleup environments.
  • Advanced written and spoken English.
  • Comfortable coordinating across time zones with a global team.
  • Comfortable with a shared on-call rotation.

Why Focal Systems

Strong Values and Mission - We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.

Exceptional Team - We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.

Outstanding Partners - We work with some of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors.

What we offerWe care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:

  • Competitive Salary & Attractive Stock
  • Paid Time Off
  • Team Retreats
  • Education grants

Note: Our pay bands are driven by market benchmarks in the target geography for hiring. Our posted ranges typically include multiple job levels. A candidate's level is determined by their performance throughout our talent acquisition process including technical screens, behavior interviews, presentations, work samples, and references. We will communicate transparently with the candidate at final stages regarding how we have leveled them, and what salary range that places them into. Placement within range is equally determined by education, general experience in your profession, specific experience in our domain, and your performance in the talent acquisition process. It is rare to receive an offer at the top of the range for a role.

raw.description:
TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk.

At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.

AI Fearlessly.

About the Role:


The Senior Manager of Compliance leads the compliance function for a unified GRC team within the Global CISO Office. You will own the company’s certification and attestation programs, manage external audits, and lead a team that delivers compliance across multiple frameworks. This is a people-leadership role with a hands-on component: you will set the operating model and build strong relationships with auditors and business stakeholders.


Responsibilities:

Compliance program leadership

  • Own the compliance program across certifications and attestations, such as ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, and PCI DSS.
  • Establish and maintain a consolidated certificate inventory, and review certification investments and priorities regularly.
  • Define and maintain the compliance calendar, covering audit cycles, evidence collection, and renewal timelines.
  • Work across business and leadership to intake new compliance requirements, understand the level of effort to meet them, and lead readiness work with control owners, including gap analysis and remediation planning.
  • Drive the adoption of AI-enabled compliance workflows, such as control mapping and review triage, with clear human oversight for approvals and exceptions.
  • Understand the unified controls framework concept, so that all new compliance frameworks map to existing controls.
  • Oversee the Trust Center, responses to customer and partner security reviews, and external-facing compliance content, ensuring accuracy and consistency with approved policies.
  • Track regulatory developments and assess their impact on the compliance program. Work closely with Legal on reporting requirements, such as the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).
  • Keep compliance cost-effective, with each control and audit tied to a clear business need.

External audit management

  • Lead the selection, scoping, and management of external auditors and assessors, including vendor evaluation, audit budget, and contract coordination.
  • Oversee audit activities, including fieldwork scheduling. Track findings and control gaps to closure through issues management, with team members handling day-to-day auditor requests.

Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration

  • Lead, coach, and develop a global compliance team, including performance management and hiring.
  • Set clear ownership and a sustainable operating rhythm for each workstream, with regular check-ins.
  • Work with engineering, product, IT, legal, procurement, and business teams to embed compliance and resolve dependencies.
  • Partner with Global CISO Office leadership to prioritize resources, communicate status and risks, and represent compliance in executive and steering committee discussions.

Qualifications:

Required

  • 8+ years of experience in information security compliance, audit, or GRC, including at least 3 years in a people-management role leading global teams.
  • Hands-on experience managing multiple certification and attestation programs, such as ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, or PCI DSS, including external audits from planning through closure.
  • Experience selecting, managing, budgeting for, and contracting with external audit firms or other compliance vendors.
  • Experience in a technology, cloud, or security software company, working with engineering teams on compliance for products, cloud infrastructure, and cloud security controls.
  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation to improve compliance or security workflows, with an understanding of when human judgment and approval are required.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to senior leaders and managing competing priorities across functions.
  • Self-starter with a track record of driving initiatives forward with limited direction and ownership of outcomes.

Preferred

  • Experience building a compliance function from the ground up, or consolidating multiple compliance programs into one.
  • Experience with cost-effective compliance programs, including evidence automation, control reuse, and GRC platforms.
  • Understanding of modern software delivery, such as CI/CD pipelines, version control, and cloud environments.
  • Experience with government or regulated-sector authorization programs, such as FedRAMP.
  • Relevant professional certifications, such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor, are a plus.

At Trend Micro, we embrace change, empower people, and encourage innovation in a connected world. Our diversity and multicultural workforce are key contributing factors to our success across the globe. Trend Micro provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. Trend Micro does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy and childbirth or related medical conditions, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care leave status, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

About Us

HireHawk connects talented professionals with growing international businesses, creating opportunities to work remotely with ambitious teams.

We're recruiting on behalf of an innovative, sustainability-focused consumer brand with a strong direct-to-consumer presence in the UK and US. The business is rethinking everyday products through better design, sustainability, and an exceptional online shopping experience.

About the Role

We're looking for a E-commerce Operations Manager to take ownership of day-to-day website operations across the UK and US markets.

You'll manage promotions, product launches, storefront updates, quality assurance, and third-party Shopify apps to deliver a reliable, seamless customer experience.

This role goes beyond website maintenance. You'll use Claude, Shopify Sidekick, and Shopify Flow to automate repetitive processes, reduce manual work, and create scalable operating routines.

As your automation efforts free up capacity, you'll collaborate with the Growth team on conversion optimization, A/B testing, and customer journey improvements.

You'll report to the Head of Growth and collaborate closely with the Lead Developer, Growth Manager, CRM & Retention, Creative, and Customer Service teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own the monthly Shopify promotion cycle across UK and US markets, ensuring accurate pricing, discounts, scheduling, and promotional changes.
  • Deliver seamless product launches by managing SKUs, variants, imagery, descriptions, collections, preorders, and product drops.
  • Build and maintain campaign landing pages using existing Shopify components and AI-powered page-building tools.
  • Protect the customer experience through thorough QA testing across product pages, navigation, subscriptions, carts, and checkout on desktop and mobile.
  • Manage Shopify storefront applications, including Skio, AfterSell, and Fairing, while tracking application ownership, costs, and renewals.
  • Automate promotions, product setup, and pre-launch QA workflows using Claude, Shopify Flow, Shopify Sidekick, and scheduled checks.
  • Create proactive monitoring routines to identify pricing inconsistencies, product availability issues, and other storefront errors before they affect customers.
  • Document operational processes and develop reusable workflows that reduce manual workload and improve team efficiency.
  • Support A/B testing initiatives by launching experiments, monitoring results, and documenting findings alongside the Growth team.
  • Analyze customer behavior using GA4, Microsoft Clarity, and Fairing to identify friction points and recommend conversion improvements.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • At least 3 years of hands-on Shopify administration experience within a direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce brand.
  • Experience managing Shopify products, pricing, discounts, Markets, promotions, and storefront applications across multiple markets or currencies.
  • Strong understanding of Shopify's ecosystem, including themes, apps, checkout processes, and subscription functionality. Coding experience is not required.
  • Practical experience using AI tools to automate daily workflows, including at least one automation or routine you have personally built and can demonstrate.
  • Strong quality assurance skills, with a structured approach to testing, identifying edge cases, documenting issues, and preventing recurring errors.
  • Working knowledge of Klaviyo and Gorgias, plus excellent written and spoken English for communicating with UK and US teams and customers.
  • Availability to work Monday to Friday, 9 AM–5 PM UK time, with some flexibility around start and finish times.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience supporting A/B testing and conversion rate optimization initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Skio or other subscription platforms, AfterSell, and Fairing.
  • Experience building automated workflows using Shopify Flow, n8n, Zapier, or Claude skills and connectors.
  • Familiarity with Claude Code or Cursor for small website or landing page adjustments.
  • Experience interpreting customer behavior data using GA4, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics tools.

Overview

Overview:

Telephonic coordination and delivery of clinical behavioral health services designed to meet the wellness and recovery needs of the consumer. In addition to performing prospective, concurrent and retrospective review of inpatient, outpatient, ambulatory and ancillary services to ensure medical necessity, appropriate length of stay, intensity of service and level of care, including appeal requests initiated by providers, facilities and members. May establish care plans and coordinate care through the health care continuum.

This candidate will utilize clinical skills to coordinate, document and communicate all aspects of the utilization/benefit management program.

RESPONSIBILITIES/TASKS:

  • Utilizes clinical experience and skills in a collaborative process to assess, plan, implement, coordinate, monitor and evaluate options to facilitate appropriate healthcare services/benefits for members.
  • Review, research and authorize requests for authorization of elective, direct, ancillary, urgent, emergency, etc. services. Contact appropriate medical and support personnel to identify and recommend alternative treatment, service levels, length of stays, etc. using approved clinical protocols.
  • Analyze, research, respond to and prepare documentation related to retrospective review requests and appeals in accordance with local, state and federal regulatory and designated accreditation (e.g. NCQA) standards.
  • Establish, coordinate and communicate discharge planning needs with appropriate internal and external entities.
  • Research and resolve issues related to benefits, member eligibility, non-elective and non-authorized services, coordination of benefits, care coordination, etc.
  • Develop and deliver targeted education for provider community related to policies, procedures, benefits, etc.
  • Communicates with providers and other parties to facilitate care/treatment.
  • Identifies members for referral opportunities to integrate with other products, services and/or programs Identifies opportunities to promote quality effectiveness of healthcare services and benefit utilization Consults and lends expertise to other internal and external constituents in the coordination and administration of the utilization/benefit management function.
  • Other duties may be assigned based on designated department assignment.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

EMPLOYMENT QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:

Registered Nurse with current unrestricted Registered Nurse license required. Certification in Case Management may be preferred based upon designated department assignment. Continuous learning, as defined by the Company’s learning philosophy, is required. Certification or progress toward certification is highly preferred and encouraged.

EXPERIENCE:

2+ years of acute clinical experience as RN required.

One (1) year health insurance plan experience or managed care environment preferred.

1+ years Behavioral Health clinical experience

1+ years Managed Care of Utilization Management experience.

SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES (SKA) REQUIRED:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Working knowledge of current industry Microsoft Office Suite PC applications.
  • Ability to apply clinical criteria/guidelines for medical necessity, setting/level of care and concurrent patient management.
  • Knowledge of current standard medical procedures/practices and their application as well as current trends and developments in medicine and nursing, alternative care settings and levels of service.
  • Knowledge of policies and procedures, member benefits and community resources.
  • Knowledge of applicable accreditation standards, local, state and federal regulations.
  • Other related skills and/or abilities may be required to perform this job based upon designated department assignment.

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

Full-Stack Developer

Position Type: Remote
Location: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a skilled, self-driven Full-Stack Developer to build, maintain, and improve product features across both front-end and back-end systems.

In this role, you’ll take ownership of features from initial design through deployment, collaborate with other engineers, and contribute to a reliable, scalable codebase. The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills with proactive communication, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver high-quality work without constant supervision.

What You’ll Own

Full-Stack Development

  • Build, maintain, and improve features across front-end and back-end systems.
  • Write clean, well-tested, scalable, and maintainable code.
  • Work with modern front-end frameworks such as React, Vue, or equivalent technologies.

Feature Development & Ownership

  • Take ownership of features from initial design and development through deployment.
  • Collaborate with the technical team to define requirements and deliver solutions aligned with product goals.
  • Manage development tasks effectively to ensure timely delivery.

Code Quality & Reviews

  • Participate in code reviews and uphold engineering standards.
  • Follow collaborative development practices, including Git workflows and pull requests.
  • Contribute to a codebase that is reliable, maintainable, and easy for the team to work with.

Bug Triage & Resolution

  • Investigate, diagnose, and resolve issues across the technology stack.
  • Prioritize fixes based on user needs and business impact.
  • Support testing, deployment, and post-release monitoring.

Technical Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineers and stakeholders to scope requirements and evaluate technical tradeoffs.
  • Communicate progress, raise blockers early, and ask clarifying questions when requirements are unclear.
  • Balance rapid delivery with long-term maintainability and product quality.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience as a Full-Stack Developer, with a track record of delivering production-ready features.
  • Proficiency in modern front-end technologies such as React, Vue, or equivalent frameworks.
  • Experience with back-end frameworks and server-side development.
  • Solid understanding of databases, RESTful API design, and system integration patterns.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, code reviews, and collaborative development workflows.
  • Ability to write clean, testable, and maintainable code.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot issues across the stack.
  • Strong written English communication skills for working effectively with a distributed team.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and take ownership of deliverables.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You can own a feature end-to-end, from initial implementation through deployment and monitoring.
  • You communicate proactively, flag blockers early, and clarify requirements before making assumptions.
  • You value code quality without allowing perfectionism to delay delivery unnecessarily.
  • You approach code reviews as opportunities to collaborate and improve.
  • You adapt to feedback, work well with others, and make thoughtful technical decisions.
  • You understand how to balance immediate product needs with long-term maintainability.

What Success Looks Like

  • Product features are delivered on time and meet agreed requirements.
  • Code is clean, tested, scalable, and maintainable.
  • Bugs are investigated and resolved according to their impact.
  • Technical risks and blockers are communicated early.
  • Code reviews, testing, documentation, and deployment are consistently part of the development process.
  • The team can rely on you to take ownership and deliver with minimal supervision.

Typical Day

Your day will focus on building and improving the product. You may start by reviewing open pull requests, then move into focused development work on a feature or bug fix. Throughout the day, you’ll communicate progress and blockers asynchronously, collaborate with teammates on technical decisions, and contribute to testing, deployments, and documentation.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

We are looking for a Neurologist interested in a clinical research opportunity

POSITION OVERVIEW

Science 37 accelerates clinical research by expanding patient access to trials, leading to faster approvals and better health outcomes for all. Our solutions empower life sciences companies to reach diverse populations beyond traditional means of conducting clinical research

We are seeking an energetic physician to help drive innovation in the clinical research ecosystem​​. This is a remote position and the individual chosen to fulfill this role can work from home.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Duties include but are not limited to:

  1. Science 37 studies
  • Function as the Principal Investigator for clinical trials when Science 37 is executing studies as a Direct to Patient trial
  • Function as a Sub-Investigator for clinical trials for therapeutic areas/ indications that align with clinical expertise/ experience when Science 37 is executing studies.
  • Coordination with Site Operations Manager to identify, onboard and train investigators for Science 37 studies
  • Educate and train Science 37 study team about target patient population and treatment paradigms for given indication for Science 37 studies
  1. Support for Science 37 Commercial Team
  • Collaboration with Business Development counterpart to review study opportunity synopses/protocols to assess fit/feasibility for decentralized trial model
  • Support Business Development counterpart during sponsor/client meetings and teleconferences
  • Support Science 37 study opportunities as a subject matter expert in the development of study opportunity proposals
  1. Regulatory Engagement
  • Collaborate with Science 37 Regulatory Affairs team to engage the FDA and other global regulatory bodies regarding the decentralized trial model,
  • Work with sponsors/collaborators to identify clinical endpoints that are fit for decentralized clinical trial conduct
  • Collaborate with sponsors and regulatory bodies to migrate endpoints from clinic-based conduct and validate their use for in-home conduct
  1. Thought Leadership
  • Serve as Science 37 representative for decentralized clinical trial and therapeutic area-specific expertise at industry/clinical conferences and webinars
  • Publish peer-reviewed articles and white papers related to therapeutic area-specific expertise and the decentralized clinical trial model

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

Qualifications

  1. Advanced degree in Medicine (MD or equivalent)
  2. Board-certification in Neurology
  3. Experience as a Principal Investigator with a focus on pharmaceutical-sponsored studies

Skills/Competencies

  1. Expertise in project management - Demonstrates ability to successfully lead/manage research personnel. Proactive problem-solving abilities and follow through.
  2. Knowledge of field organizational strategies - The ability to adapt to a rapidly changing work environment. Successful decentralized team management and situational responsive decision-making.
  3. Extensive knowledge of clinical research - Understands the drug development process. Knowledgeable about the critical elements for success in clinical trials; participation in and contribution to these activities. Ability to create and review protocols, programs, and assess the feasibility/pathway to success of a project.
  4. Strong communication and presentation skills - Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to establish and maintain positive sponsor, project team members and internal Science37 relationships. Ability to conduct effective presentations.
  5. Computer skills - Working knowledge of Google applications. Able to generate business correspondence, create forms and generate reports as required.
  6. Practices professionalism and integrity in all actions – Demonstrates ability to foster concepts of teamwork, cooperation, responsibility, and flexibility to get the work done.
  7. Other – Ability to communicate in English (both verbal and written).
  8. Preferred knowledge of Spanish

REPORTING

  • Position Reports to the Chief Medical Officer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Science 37 values the well-being of its employees and aims to provide team members with everything they need to succeed.

raw.description:
Company Overview

Panacea Financial Holdings (“Panacea”) is a rapidly growing fintech and banking platform purpose-built to serve the unique financial needs of physicians, dentists, and veterinarians. Panacea is building the next-generation financial ecosystem for healthcare professionals—spanning practice finance, personal banking, patient finance, accounting / tax, advisory and payments.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Product Designer to help create intuitive, user-centered experiences across our digital products. In this role, you will translate complex user needs and business requirements into thoughtful, functional designs that improve the customer experience.

You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders to bring products from concept through implementation. This role is ideal for a designer who can independently own design initiatives while partnering closely with the Lead Product Designer for strategic alignment, guidance, feedback, and growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end design process, from discovery and concept development through implementation.
  • Create wireframes, user flows, high-fidelity designs, and interactive prototypes using Figma and other tools.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, and Business Analysts to translate user and business needs into effective design solutions.
  • Design intuitive experiences that simplify complex financial products and workflows.
  • Contribute to evolve our design system to ensure consistency and scalability.
  • Partner with Engineering throughout development to ensure designs are implemented accurately and effectively.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative insights to inform design decisions and continuously improve the user experience.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing to validate design decisions and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Leverage AI tools, including Claude and other emerging technologies, to accelerate prototyping, experimentation, and design workflows.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • 5+ years of experience designing digital products, preferably web-based and mobile native applications.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating UX thinking and visual design craft, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including component-based design.
  • Experience designing complex user workflows and translating business requirements into intuitive interfaces.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, technical account engineering helps customers maintain reliable, effective operations as their businesses grow. We value strong technical judgment, proactive problem-solving, clear communication, and people who take ownership of resolving technical challenges that affect customer success.

About the Role

We're looking for a Technical Account Engineer to help Bask Health's merchants maintain reliable technical operations, resolve complex platform challenges, and make effective use of our software.

This role combines ongoing technical account ownership, integration troubleshooting, platform configuration guidance, and cross-functional problem-solving.

You'll work with an assigned group of customer accounts to understand their technical environments, operational workflows, and recurring challenges.

Our customers include entrepreneurs, e-commerce operators, online business owners, and healthcare businesses using Bask Health to operate direct-to-consumer telehealth services.

You'll develop a detailed understanding of Bask Health's platform and how its technical capabilities support customer operations.

Our software brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll help customers maintain working configurations and address technical issues that interfere with their use of the platform.

You'll serve as a technical point of contact for assigned accounts when they need deeper guidance or investigation.

You'll work closely with customer success managers to understand each customer's business priorities and the technical challenges affecting their experience.

You'll develop familiarity with customer configurations, supported integrations, and important operational workflows.

You'll identify recurring technical issues and help customers address underlying causes rather than repeatedly relying on temporary fixes.

You'll investigate problems involving APIs, webhooks, authentication, configuration settings, and data exchange.

You'll use available logs, browser diagnostic tools, and technical documentation to understand reported problems.

You'll reproduce technical issues when possible and document relevant findings.

You'll distinguish between customer configuration errors, integration failures, product defects, and broader platform incidents.

You'll coordinate with technical support teams when issues require structured escalation or additional investigation.

You'll collaborate with software engineers when a problem requires code-level analysis, infrastructure expertise, or a product fix.

You'll provide clear technical evidence, reproduction steps, customer impact information, and troubleshooting history when escalating issues.

You'll work with product managers when recurring customer challenges indicate product limitations or opportunities for improvement.

You'll help customers understand supported configuration options and technical alternatives.

You'll participate in technical account reviews to discuss recurring issues, integration health, platform usage, and upcoming technical needs.

You'll provide recommendations that help customers maintain stable and effective workflows.

You'll assist customers with technical changes that affect existing integrations or platform configurations.

You'll help customers understand relevant product updates and any technical actions required to continue using supported features.

You'll coordinate with internal teams when customers need help preparing for significant configuration changes.

You'll support technical validation of customer workflows after relevant platform updates or issue resolutions.

You'll help identify technical risks that may affect important customer operations.

You'll communicate those risks to the appropriate internal teams and help coordinate preventive action.

You'll maintain clear communication with customers during technical investigations and escalations.

You'll explain technical findings in language that both technical contacts and business stakeholders can understand.

You'll keep customer success managers informed about issues that may affect account health or customer satisfaction.

You'll document customer technical environments, recurring issues, troubleshooting history, and outstanding action items.

You'll contribute to internal technical knowledge bases and customer-facing documentation.

You'll help create reusable troubleshooting guidance for common integration and configuration problems.

You'll identify patterns across customer accounts and recommend improvements to support procedures or product functionality.

You'll collaborate with customer success engineers on technical onboarding handoffs and post-implementation support.

You'll work with technical support teams to improve escalation quality and reduce repeated investigations.

You'll contribute to discussions about customer-facing platform reliability and technical service quality.

You'll help ensure that customer technical commitments are accurately documented and communicated.

You'll avoid promising custom development, unsupported integrations, or product changes without appropriate internal approval.

Because Bask Health supports healthcare-related businesses, you'll need to follow internal security and privacy requirements when investigating customer technical issues.

You'll recognize when a request involves clinical, pharmacy, or compliance responsibilities that must be handled by authorized specialists.

You'll provide technical guidance about software functionality without making clinical or pharmacy decisions.

You'll work in a remote, cross-functional environment where technical judgment, initiative, and accountability are important.

We're looking for someone with strong SaaS troubleshooting experience and the ability to manage ongoing technical relationships with customers.

You should be comfortable discussing integrations, configuration, reliability, and technical risks with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

You'll need to be organized, proactive, analytical, and capable of managing several customer technical priorities simultaneously.

Experience supporting merchant-facing SaaS platforms, e-commerce systems, or other transaction-heavy applications is particularly valuable.

Success in this role means helping customers maintain reliable platform operations, reducing recurring technical issues, improving technical account health, and strengthening long-term customer confidence in Bask Health.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a technical point of contact for assigned customer accounts.
  • Develop an understanding of each customer's technical environment and workflows.
  • Support ongoing technical account health after initial implementation.
  • Help customers maintain supported platform configurations and integrations.
  • Investigate recurring technical issues affecting customer operations.
  • Troubleshoot REST API, webhook, and authentication-related problems.
  • Analyze HTTP requests, responses, and relevant technical errors.
  • Use available diagnostic tools and logs to investigate software behavior.
  • Reproduce customer-reported technical problems and document findings.
  • Distinguish configuration issues from integration failures and product defects.
  • Identify technical risks affecting important customer workflows.
  • Recommend supported configuration changes and preventive improvements.
  • Participate in technical account reviews and customer discussions.
  • Explain technical findings to business and technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with customer success managers on account health concerns.
  • Coordinate with customer success engineers on post-implementation technical needs.
  • Work with technical support teams on complex escalations.
  • Collaborate with software engineers when product fixes are required.
  • Provide clear reproduction steps and technical evidence for engineering escalations.
  • Work with product teams on recurring customer technical requirements.
  • Support technical validation after relevant platform changes.
  • Help customers understand new technical capabilities and updates.
  • Document customer configurations, integration details, and troubleshooting history.
  • Create and maintain technical account documentation and support resources.
  • Identify recurring technical patterns across customer accounts.
  • Recommend improvements to technical support and escalation processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer technical requests and follow-up activity.
  • Coordinate technical issue resolution across internal stakeholders.
  • Communicate technical risks and resolution updates clearly.
  • Follow appropriate security and privacy procedures.
  • Escalate clinical, pharmacy, and compliance concerns to authorized teams.
  • Take ownership of assigned technical account issues through resolution or appropriate handoff.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in technical account management, customer engineering, technical support engineering, solutions engineering, or a closely related customer-facing technical role.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting customer-facing SaaS applications.
  • Experience maintaining ongoing technical relationships with customers.
  • Strong understanding of web-based software applications and integrations.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP methods, status codes, and JSON.
  • Familiarity with webhooks, authentication, and common integration patterns.
  • Experience troubleshooting technical problems affecting customer operations.
  • Ability to investigate integration errors and identify likely causes.
  • Experience using browser developer tools or similar technical diagnostic tools.
  • Ability to reproduce software defects and document troubleshooting steps.
  • Experience explaining technical concepts clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Ability to translate customer technical concerns into actionable internal requests.
  • Experience collaborating directly with software engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with technical escalation and incident management processes.
  • Ability to identify recurring technical issues and recommend improvements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience managing multiple customer technical requests simultaneously.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize technical issues based on customer impact.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience using customer support, ticketing, or project tracking tools.
  • Ability to maintain accurate technical records and account documentation.
  • Comfortable learning complex software platforms and technical workflows.
  • Ability to work independently on ambiguous technical problems.
  • Comfortable collaborating across customer success, product, and engineering teams.
  • Availability to collaborate during required U.S. Eastern Time working hours.
  • Strong ownership mentality and commitment to customer outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting e-commerce SaaS or merchant-facing software.
  • Experience working with Shopify, BigCommerce, or other storefront platforms.
  • Familiarity with direct-to-consumer business models.
  • Experience troubleshooting online checkout and payment workflows.
  • Familiarity with Stripe or similar payment processing platforms.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Experience using Postman or similar API testing tools.
  • Familiarity with SQL and database query fundamentals.
  • Experience troubleshooting third-party integrations.
  • Familiarity with OAuth and API authentication flows.
  • Experience supporting subscription commerce platforms.
  • Understanding of application logs and observability tools.
  • Experience with Datadog, Sentry, New Relic, or similar monitoring systems.
  • Experience participating in technical account reviews.
  • Familiarity with cloud-hosted SaaS environments.
  • Experience collaborating with product managers on recurring technical issues.
  • Experience supporting technical validation and regression testing.
  • Experience improving technical account support processes.
  • Familiarity with healthcare technology or telehealth platforms.
  • Experience supporting entrepreneurs and online business owners.

Principal Full Stack Engineer (Agentic Systems & Enablement)

About Us

Founded in 2011, Modus is a global, fully remote team of world-class technologists who thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment. We’re a digital product engineering partner for forward-thinking businesses. Our global teams work side-by-side with clients to design, build, and scale custom solutions that achieve real results and lasting change, partnering with industry leaders including AWS, GitHub, and Atlassian.

We were fully remote before it was cool! Recognized as one of the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies for nine years and a top remote work company by FlexJobs, we have helped some of the world’s largest brands deliver powerful digital experiences.

As an award-winning Atlassian partner with a world-class team, we help organizations innovate and solve complex challenges for Fortune 500 companies and beyond, we want to hear from you.

Opportunity!

We are looking for a Principal Full Stack Engineer to help accelerate feature delivery across complex enterprise applications while introducing and scaling production-ready agentic software engineering practices.

You'll work directly within a client's engineering team, combining hands-on development using Java, Spring Boot, TypeScript, and React with advanced Claude Code workflows. You'll contribute to production features, optimize existing repositories for AI-assisted development, and mentor engineers on effectively incorporating agentic coding into their daily work.

This is a highly hands-on engineering and consulting role for someone who combines deep full-stack expertise with a passion for AI-driven software development and technical enablement. Rather than simply recommending new practices, you'll demonstrate their value through collaborative coding, real feature delivery, and practical knowledge sharing.

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience building and delivering complex enterprise applications.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Java and Spring Boot, including backend services, APIs, and enterprise application development.
  • Advanced proficiency with TypeScript and React, including modern frontend architecture and build tooling such as Vite.
  • 2+ years of experience with agentic coding workflows, tool-augmented LLM programming, and AI-assisted development in production environments.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with Claude Code, including agent configuration, repository memory files, architectural context, sub-agents, custom skills, and development guardrails.
  • Experience integrating agentic development workflows into existing enterprise codebases to accelerate feature delivery, testing, and refactoring.
  • Strong understanding of repository architecture, code organization, automated testing, and technical documentation to support reliable AI-assisted development.
  • Experience defining structured development workflows, including task decomposition, context management, automated verification, and code review.
  • Ability to design and implement deterministic guardrails that maintain code quality, architectural consistency, and reliable AI-generated outputs.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring and upskilling software engineers, particularly through hands-on pairing and collaborative development.
  • Ability to work directly with client engineering teams, adapting technical explanations and coaching approaches to different levels of AI-assisted development experience.
  • Strong experience working within Agile, cross-functional product teams, contributing to production features from requirements through deployment.
  • Ability to independently navigate complex enterprise applications, understand unfamiliar codebases, and identify opportunities for engineering improvements.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and consulting skills, with the ability to translate advanced technical concepts into practical engineering practices.

Bonus points:

  • Experience with legacy COBOL systems or enterprise modernization initiatives involving legacy technologies.
  • Experience building custom Claude Code skills, sub-agents, repository-level instructions, and reusable agentic development workflows.
  • Experience designing AI-assisted engineering enablement programs or introducing agentic development practices across engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with prompt harnesses, context orchestration, automated testing loops, and agent-driven software development patterns.
  • Experience improving software delivery efficiency through AI-assisted code generation, refactoring, debugging, and automated verification.
  • Experience working in consulting or customer-facing technical leadership roles.
  • Experience documenting reusable engineering patterns, architectural decisions, and technical enablement practices.
  • Experience measuring improvements in engineering productivity, development cycle time, and software quality.

You'll Love:

  • Building production-ready applications using Java, Spring Boot, TypeScript, and React.
  • Working directly with engineering teams to introduce and scale agentic software development practices.
  • Using Claude Code to accelerate feature delivery, navigate complex codebases, and improve engineering workflows.
  • Mentoring developers through hands-on pairing, collaborative coding, and real production work.
  • Designing repository structures, context-management strategies, and guardrails that make AI-assisted development more reliable.

This is a full-stack position with a strong backend focus (approximately 75% server-side C#/.NET and 25% frontend across our WPF desktop and React web applications).

What you'll be doing

Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Finland

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Finland. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP automation people in front of the client.

raw.title: Medical Risk Process Improvement & Training Consultant
raw.excerpt: Symetra offers a thrilling chance to become part of our team as a Medical Risk Process Improvement & Training Consultant!
raw.description:
Symetra offers a thrilling chance to become part of our team as a Medical Risk Process Improvement & Training Consultant!

About the role

Responsible for developing and delivering training, supporting team member development, and improving processes to promote quality, consistency, and efficiency within the Medical Risk Consultant (MRC) team. This role combines clinical nursing expertise with process ownership and quality oversight to strengthen medical risk assessment practices. The position also performs medical risk reviews to support Underwriting in evaluating potential risks associated with Stop Loss coverage.

What you will do

  • Medical Risk Assessment Training and Education Develop, maintain, and oversee a structured MRC training framework that supports onboarding, role-specific learning, competency development, and ongoing refresher education. Design, facilitate, and continually improve training through virtual instructor-led sessions, interactive case-based discussions, guided practice, and self-directed learning resources. Create a supportive and engaging remote learning environment that encourages active participation, open communication, collaboration, and accountability. Establish and consistently reinforce clear expectations for professionalism, preparedness, participation, and engagement throughout the training process. Promote effective virtual learning practices, including appropriate use of cameras, interactive discussions, knowledge checks, and regular opportunities to assess understanding, in alignment with company policies and individual accommodation needs. Apply clinical expertise and adult learning principles to help trainees understand how medical information, claims experience, and other available reporting contribute to the evaluation of potential risk within a Stop Loss underwriting environment. Recognize the unique challenges of remote learning and adapt training approaches to individual needs while maintaining consistent expectations for competency, quality, and readiness for independent production. Identify learning needs through trainee assessments, operational trends, quality review findings, and evolving business priorities. Provide training and educational support to Claims, Underwriting, Sales, third-party administrators, and other business partners when knowledge or process gaps are identified. Translate complex clinical, insurance, and operational information into clear, practical learning materials, including procedures, job aids, reference guides, and other resources that support understanding and consistent application. Coordinate appropriate review of specialized content. Maintain organized training resources and documentation, including curriculum maps, job aid libraries, assessment materials, trainer guides, and training records. Pilot new or significantly revised training content before broader implementation and evaluate effectiveness through competency assessments, time to independent production, and post-training quality results. Review the overall training framework at least annually to ensure it continues to meet the needs of the MRC team and the organization.
  • Process Ownership and Continuous Improvement Serve as the primary resource and designated owner for assigned MRC processes, procedures, standards, and supporting documentation. Regularly evaluate existing workflows to identify opportunities to strengthen quality, efficiency, consistency, internal controls, documentation, and the customer experience. Develop and implement routine process improvements within the MRC function that align with established policies, regulatory requirements, business objectives, and the responsibilities and authority of the role. Share proposed changes through the established leadership review process, outlining the identified need, recommended approach, anticipated impact, implementation plan, and measures of success. Recognize opportunities for team member learning and professional growth by identifying improvements that may be appropriate for other Medical Risk Consultants or colleagues to lead. In these situations, provide supporting analysis, guidance, resources, and coaching to help the assigned individual successfully develop and present the proposed change. Obtain appropriate leadership and stakeholder approval before implementing changes that materially affect other departments, customer experience, systems, contractual obligations, regulatory or compliance requirements, staffing, financial controls, or significant business risk. Guide approved improvements from initial identification through implementation, including gathering requirements, evaluating potential impacts, coordinating with stakeholders, maintaining documentation, communicating changes, providing education, and assessing outcomes. Support team members leading assigned improvement initiatives by helping define the scope, providing clinical and technical guidance, and offering appropriate oversight. Investigate recurring operational challenges and process breakdowns to understand contributing factors and identify sustainable solutions. Maintain documentation of significant decisions and approvals, monitor outcomes following implementation, and recommend additional adjustments, escalation, or reversal when results do not meet expectations or introduce unintended risks.
  • Clinical Risk Review and Production Support Apply a strong foundation of clinical nursing knowledge, professional experience, and critical thinking to medical risk assessment. Develop and maintain proficiency in Medical Risk Consultant methodology, including the ability to interpret medical and claims-related information, identify potential areas of concern, and communicate findings that support informed underwriting decisions. Partner with Underwriting to evaluate paid claims reports, claimant disclosures, and other available medical and claims-related information to identify individuals with complex, catastrophic, or potentially high-cost medical conditions that may present increased risk under a Stop Loss contract. Use clinical knowledge, research skills, and sound professional judgment to evaluate diagnoses, treatment patterns, anticipated healthcare utilization, emerging therapies, and potential future medical costs. Bring together relevant information to develop clear, well-supported claimant assessments that help Underwriting understand the medical circumstances, potential financial exposure, and considerations relevant to underwriting decisions. Prepare accurate and timely written medical risk assessments in accordance with established procedures and service expectations. Remain engaged in medical risk reviews to strengthen and maintain knowledge of MRC practices, support meaningful training, evaluate process and system changes, and assist with production during periods of increased volume. Sustained production volume remains the primary responsibility of the Medical Risk Consultant role. Serve as a knowledgeable clinical resource by providing professional opinions, second opinions on complex risk assessments, and education to Medical Risk Consultants, Claims Examiners, Underwriters, and other internal and external partners. Coordinate additional clinical or underwriting review support when specialized expertise is needed.
  • Trainee Development and Readiness Assessment Evaluate trainee progress through observation, knowledge assessments, case-based learning, practice reviews, and other established methods that measure understanding and skill development. Review work completed during the training period to assess application of procedures, documentation quality, clinical reasoning, interpretation of medical and claims information, and readiness to perform medical risk reviews independently. Provide timely, thoughtful, and constructive feedback that reinforces strengths, supports learning, and clearly identifies areas where additional development may be beneficial. Create individualized coaching plans, practice opportunities, job aids, or other learning resources when additional reinforcement is needed. Promote a culture of accountability, professionalism, and continuous learning by establishing clear training expectations and consistently reinforcing established quality standards. Balance an encouraging and supportive coaching approach with thoughtful assessment of each trainee’s demonstrated knowledge, clinical reasoning, engagement, and ability to work independently. Address learning gaps promptly and constructively, ensuring recommendations for training completion and production readiness are supported by documented competencies and established expectations. Maintain accurate documentation of completed training, assessment results, demonstrated competencies, and areas identified for continued development. Communicate trainee progress, strengths, learning needs, and readiness recommendations to the trainee’s manager at established checkpoints, supporting a collaborative approach to successful onboarding and transition into independent production. Make recommendations regarding training completion and production readiness. Final decisions regarding work assignments, performance management, formal counseling, corrective action, or discipline remain with management. Conduct structured quality reviews of each Medical Risk Consultant’s work during the established post-training monitoring period, providing meaningful feedback and reinforcement as appropriate. At the conclusion of that period, transition ongoing performance monitoring to the employee’s manager and the applicable quality assurance process.
  • Quality Review and Continuous Learning Develop, maintain, and carry out a structured quality audit and feedback process that promotes consistent medical risk assessment practices and supports ongoing learning within the MRC function. Establish quality review methodology, including file selection and sampling, scoring criteria, review frequency, and documentation expectations. Conduct scheduled reviews of medical risk assessments and supporting documentation completed by Medical Risk Consultants within the post-training monitoring period. Facilitate periodic calibration discussions to promote shared understanding and consistent application of medical risk assessment methods, documentation standards, and quality scoring criteria. Evaluate audit findings to identify patterns, contributing factors, and opportunities for improvement. Use these insights to enhance procedures, job aids, and educational content, and conduct follow-up reviews to confirm that changes have achieved the intended results. Share quality findings, recurring error trends, and training effectiveness measures with Underwriting leadership and the designated quality assurance function at established intervals. Obtain appropriate management or quality assurance validation when findings may affect processes owned by this role. Use quality findings to guide education, coaching, and process improvements. Decisions related to formal performance management, corrective action, or discipline remain the responsibility of management.
  • Technology Proficiency and Adoption Serve as a knowledgeable resource for the technology and systems that support MRC medical risk assessment and related workflows. Maintain proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams, along with the ability to effectively use the ESL claim system and other platforms required for medical risk reviews, documentation, communication, and reporting. Use Microsoft Office applications to develop and maintain professional training materials, presentations, reference documents, and other resources that support team learning and operational needs. Develop and maintain familiarity with AI-enabled tools and their appropriate application in the business environment. Support responsible use consistent with company expectations for privacy, security, confidentiality, accuracy, human oversight, and acceptable use. Apply thoughtful review and professional judgment when evaluating technology-generated information, ensuring outputs are appropriately validated before being incorporated into medical risk assessments, training resources, business recommendations, processes, or decisions. Demonstrate adaptability and a willingness to learn new tools, systems, and methods, and help translate that knowledge into practical workflows, procedures, reference materials, and training. Identify opportunities for technology to improve efficiency, consistency, documentation, service delivery, and employee or customer experience. Support successful adoption through clear procedures, appropriate safeguards, training, and practical guidance for users.
  • Quality Collaboration, System Support, and Projects Partner with management and the designated quality assurance function to understand overall quality trends, recurring knowledge gaps, and potential process risks. Apply validated findings to guide training enhancements and process improvement priorities. Provide structured post-training quality monitoring for up to one year following completion of formal training, with the opportunity to conclude the monitoring period earlier when sustained proficiency has been demonstrated and documented. Ongoing routine quality reviews of established team members beyond this period remain the responsibility of management and the designated quality assurance function. Represent the MRC team in system development, testing, implementation, and enhancement activities, including changes to the ESL claim system. Develop testing scenarios, document outcomes, identify potential defects or workflow impacts, and help confirm operational readiness. Maintain current system procedures, user resources, and training plans to support the MRC team through changes and enhancements. Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects, and prepare and share relevant updates regarding processes, training, production support, and project progress with appropriate stakeholders.
  • Professional Development and Collaboration Maintain an active Registered Nurse license, required continuing education hours, and applicable professional certifications in accordance with established renewal requirements. Stay informed of advancements in medical care, emerging treatments, high-cost diagnoses, healthcare utilization, medical cost trends, and developments in Stop Loss insurance that may influence medical risk assessment. Participate in relevant clinical seminars, professional conferences, continuing education, and industry learning opportunities to maintain current medical knowledge and strengthen the application of clinical expertise to underwriting risk evaluation. Share relevant insights with the MRC team and business partners to support informed assessments, effective training, and consistent risk review practices. Foster positive and collaborative working relationships across Medical Risk, Claims, Underwriting, Sales, Technology, and Compliance. Maintain confidentiality and safeguard sensitive information in accordance with applicable legal, regulatory, privacy, security, and company requirements.

Why Work at Symetra

Here’s what some of our employees share about why they choose to work at Symetra:

raw.description:
Help strengthen the quality, accuracy, and integrity of behavioral healthcare through your expertise in auditing, coding, and compliance!

The Auditing and Coding Analyst – Inpatient plays an important role in supporting accurate clinical documentation, appropriate coding, and regulatory compliance across inpatient behavioral health services. Through medical record audits, data analysis, and collaboration with clinical and administrative teams, this position helps identify opportunities for improvement, strengthen documentation practices, and support organizational quality and reimbursement goals. The Analyst also serves as a resource and educator, helping teams navigate documentation and coding requirements while promoting consistent, high-quality care.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys bringing together analytical skills, healthcare knowledge, and collaboration to make a meaningful impact behind the scenes. You'll help strengthen compliance, support clinical teams, and contribute to the quality and sustainability of behavioral health services in the communities we serve.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct retrospective and concurrent audits of inpatient behavioral health records to evaluate documentation accuracy, medical necessity, coding, billing, and regulatory compliance.
  • Review clinical documentation and ICD-10/CPT coding to support accurate reporting, appropriate reimbursement, and adherence to payer and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify documentation trends, compliance risks, and opportunities for improvement through audits, reporting, and data analysis.
  • Partner with clinical leadership, providers, finance, quality, and other internal teams to strengthen documentation practices and reduce compliance risks.
  • Provide education, training, and constructive audit feedback to clinical and administrative staff on documentation, coding, and compliance expectations.
  • Support regulatory readiness, external audits, corrective action planning, and ongoing quality improvement initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain audit tools, educational resources, workflows, and monitoring processes that promote consistency and accountability.

Requirements, Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • High School/GED required
  • 2 years of Behavioral Health experience required
  • Understanding of medical necessity and level-of-care criteria required
  • Experience in ICD and DSM V required
  • At least one (1) year of medical terminology preferred
  • Knowledge of inpatient psychiatric regulations and accreditation standards preferred
  • Must have experience working collaboratively with diverse groups in a healthcare environment
  • Must be familiar with government healthcare reimbursement systems
  • Must be proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and Outlook, as required for the role

Licensure/Certification:Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Coding Specialist Professional (CCS-P), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), or Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC) preferred

Additional Requirements:
  • Must have knowledge of anatomy and physiology
  • Must be successful in interacting effectively with providers
  • Must have the ability to analyze large amounts of data to identify trends


You’ll be a great fit for this role if you:
  • Enjoy analyzing information, identifying patterns, and turning findings into meaningful improvements.
  • Have a strong attention to detail and take pride in accuracy and accountability.
  • Communicate effectively and enjoy building collaborative relationships with providers and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Are comfortable navigating healthcare documentation, coding, reimbursement, and regulatory requirements.
  • Approach education and feedback with a supportive, solutions-focused mindset.
  • Are passionate about helping healthcare teams deliver quality services while supporting the integrity and sustainability of the organization.

raw.description:
About Virtuozzo

Virtuozzo is a provider of infrastructure software for AI and the cloud, helping cloud service providers, SaaS companies, and enterprises build and operate efficient, scalable infrastructure. We combine an optimised operating system with orchestration, management, automation, and protection to deliver mainframe-like efficiency, performance, reliability, versatility, and security—while reducing overall cost and complexity.

Our Virtuozzo Infrastructure System (V/IS) brings together compute, storage, and networking to support traditional applications, cloud-native workloads, and AI services. We help organisations modernise their infrastructure, make better use of their hardware, and bring new cloud- and GPU-powered services to market on their own infrastructure and under their own brand.

Our technology serves more than 100,000 companies in over 100 countries. With deep engineering roots, we pioneered container-based virtualisation and continue to contribute to foundational open-source projects, including OpenVZ, the Linux kernel, Kubernetes, CRIU, KVM, and OpenStack.

The Role

Our team develops the V/IS and we are looking for Engineers to join our team. As a Software Engineer, you will play a key role in building new features, optimizing performance, and ensuring reliability in production environments. You will collaborate across the full stack of the product, from UI and REST APIs to cluster lifecycle management, virtualization, monitoring, and seamless product updates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop new features for V/IS.
  • Develop and maintain automated tests to ensure high code quality.
  • Improve and optimise existing functionality for performance and scalability.
  • Provide support and maintenance for real customer environments.

Skills & Abilities

  • Strong proficiency in at least one programming language: Python, Golang, C/C++, or Rust.
  • Deep understanding of Linux operating system architecture.
  • Solid knowledge of networking concepts.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to tackle complex challenges.

Preferred Knowledge

  • Experience with hypervisors and container technologies.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems design and implementation.
  • Background in system programming.
  • Understanding of Windows, Linux, or FreeBSD kernel internals.
  • Proficiency with automation and infrastructure tools such as Ansible, Bash scripting, and Terraform.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Web development skills (JavaScript, HTML).

What We Offer

  • Remote and flexible work from European locations.
  • A collaborative engineering culture focused on deep technical challenges and real-world impact.
  • A chance to influence the design and evolution of a global-scale cloud infrastructure platform.
  • Professional development opportunities through training, certifications, and mentoring.
  • Group private medical insurance / medical allowance.
  • Employee/Contributors recognition programmes and incentives.
  • Referral programme bonuses.
