As a Senior Data Analyst, you’ll be a key driver of insight and innovation within our Enterprise Data and Analytics team. We’re looking for a curious, detail-oriented professional who thrives on turning complex scientific and operational data into clear, actionable intelligence. In this role, you’ll lead the development of analytical solutions that illuminate critical KPIs, uncover performance trends, and support strategic decision-making across the business. You’ll partner closely with stakeholders to map business processes, align data solutions with real-world operations, and conduct deep-dive analyses that solve high-value challenges. This is a high-impact opportunity to shape how data informs strategy and contributes to our mission of creating healthier lives.

As a Sr. Data Analyst you will be focused on:

Our team thrives on curiosity, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence. We work closely with cross-functional engineering and business partners to deliver impactful data and analytics solutions that shape the future of research and development.

In this role, primary responsibilities include:

  • Analyzing complex scientific datasets to uncover meaningful insights and support strategic initiatives.
  • Mapping key business process rules to ensure data solutions align with operational realities.
  • Creating insight-driven solutions that bring visibility into critical KPIs and performance metrics.
  • Conducting deep-dive analyses to solve challenging problems and support evidence-based recommendations.
  • Engage Business Stakeholders at all levels to identify requirements for current and future products through ongoing interaction.
  • Lead requirements workshops and User Acceptance Testing for new data, products and analytics solutions.
  • Analyze business processes and develop business flow diagrams and data flow diagrams to support system design and optimization.
  • Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and business teams to ensure alignment and successful delivery.
  • Data Profiling, mining, and data validation/testing to ensure data is fit for use by the business.
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and present results in a clear and user-friendly manner.
  • Build strong business relationships that foster a collaborative and trusting approach and partnership.

We are looking for the following minimum qualifications for this role:

  • Bachelor degree in Business Management, Computer Science or any related field.
  • Master in Business Administration/ Information Systems/ Computer Science is an asset.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to approach challenges creatively.
  • Ability to understand and make sense of complex datasets with a strong attention to detail
  • Ability to translate requirements to well-written user stories to bridge the gap between business and technology.
  • Strong business mindset with ability to collaborate with business partners to identify needs and opportunities for improved data management and delivery.
  • Ability to see big picture and then identify key areas for deep analysis to support sound solutions.
  • Self-driven and capable of working both independently and collaboratively within a team setting.
  • Experience in life science or Biotechnology industry is a plus.
  • MUST be based in Canada

Technical Expertise required:

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in writing complex SQL queries, data mining, data profiling, and data validation/testing;
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience as a Business Systems Analyst / Data Analyst specializing in the Data & Analytics discipline, preferably in a senior or lead role;
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience organizing and running User Acceptance Testing cycles and training with business users and stakeholders;
  • Experience working with Data Visualization Tools like Power BI, Tableau, Looker, MicroStrategy
  • Experienced working in Agile Software Development Methodology.

raw.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Pharmacy Integrations
raw.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer, Pharmacy Integrations to design, build, and maintain the systems connecting Bask Health's telehealth platform with pharmacy partners and fulfillment operations.

You'll work on backend services that support prescription routing, pharmacy order processing, fulfillment updates, and the reliable exchange of information between Bask and external systems.

This role requires strong backend engineering skills and experience building integrations that handle complex workflows, asynchronous events, and third-party dependencies.

Our engineering stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases. You'll work with serverless infrastructure, APIs, and event-driven systems to build reliable services that can support growing transaction volumes and multiple pharmacy integrations.

You'll collaborate with engineers, product managers, pharmacy operations, and other internal teams to translate operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.

We're looking for someone who can independently own complex integrations, anticipate failure scenarios, and build systems that are observable, maintainable, and resilient.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend integrations between Bask's platform and pharmacy partners.
  • Build services supporting prescription routing, pharmacy order creation, fulfillment processing, and status updates.
  • Develop and maintain APIs, webhooks, and other integration mechanisms for exchanging data with external systems.
  • Design workflows that reliably handle asynchronous events, retries, timeouts, duplicate messages, and third-party service failures.
  • Build and maintain backend applications using TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases.
  • Use AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, and EventBridge to support event-driven processing and background workflows.
  • Design data models and database schemas for pharmacy orders, fulfillment events, and integration records.
  • Implement validation, error handling, and reconciliation processes to maintain data accuracy across systems.
  • Build monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational tools to identify and resolve integration failures.
  • Improve the reliability and performance of existing pharmacy-related backend services.
  • Collaborate with pharmacy operations teams to understand fulfillment workflows, operational constraints, and recurring issues.
  • Work with product managers to translate integration requirements into technical specifications and implementation plans.
  • Coordinate with external technical partners to understand API specifications, integration behavior, and testing requirements.
  • Build secure data exchange workflows with appropriate authentication, authorization, and protection of sensitive information.
  • Support the development of internal tools that help teams investigate order issues and monitor integration status.
  • Write automated tests covering successful workflows, failure scenarios, and integration edge cases.
  • Investigate production incidents, identify root causes, and implement long-term fixes.
  • Review code, provide technical guidance, and contribute to backend engineering standards.
  • Take ownership of integrations from initial design and development through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate engineering work while independently validating correctness, security, and reliability.
  • Help establish reusable integration patterns that can support additional pharmacy partners and future platform capabilities.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial backend development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js.
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining production backend applications and APIs.
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party services using REST APIs, webhooks, or similar integration technologies.
  • Experience working with AWS services and serverless architectures.
  • Familiarity with AWS Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, or comparable event-driven infrastructure.
  • Strong experience with SQL databases, relational data modeling, and database schema design.
  • Experience with modern database access tools or ORMs such as Prisma or Drizzle.
  • Understanding of asynchronous processing, message queues, distributed systems, and integration architecture.
  • Ability to design reliable systems that handle retries, failures, duplicate events, and inconsistent external data.
  • Experience implementing authentication, authorization, secure API communication, and sensitive-data protection.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, including investigating production integration failures.
  • Experience writing automated tests for APIs, backend services, and integration workflows.
  • Ability to independently own complex engineering projects from technical design through production deployment.
  • Strong understanding of performance, reliability, monitoring, and maintainability in production systems.
  • Experience making architectural decisions and evaluating technical tradeoffs.
  • Familiarity with Git, code reviews, CI/CD workflows, and modern software development practices.
  • Ability to use AI-assisted development tools effectively while independently validating generated code.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to coordinate technical work with internal teams and external partners.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with significant ownership and responsibility.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building integrations with pharmacies, pharmacy management systems, or healthcare technology platforms.
  • Familiarity with electronic prescribing, prescription fulfillment, medication orders, or pharmacy workflow systems.
  • Understanding of HIPAA, healthcare data privacy, and secure handling of protected health information.
  • Experience with pharmacy-related interoperability standards such as NCPDP SCRIPT.
  • Experience with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 or FHIR.
  • Familiarity with SST and serverless development on AWS.
  • Experience working with tRPC, Next.js, React, or full-stack TypeScript applications.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms or monorepo architectures.
  • Experience building event-driven integrations with queues, webhooks, and background processing.
  • Experience designing reconciliation systems, audit trails, and operational monitoring dashboards.
  • Experience integrating multiple external vendors with different APIs, data formats, and reliability requirements.
  • Experience building internal tools for operational teams.
  • Familiarity with pharmacy fulfillment, shipping status updates, and order exception handling.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or establishing reusable integration architecture.
  • Experience using Cursor, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted development tools in production engineering workflows.

About Fusemachines
Fusemachines is a leading AI strategy, talent, and education services and products provider. Founded by Sameer Maskey Ph.D., Adjunct Associate Professor at Columbia University, Fusemachines has a core mission of democratizing AI. With a presence in 4 countries (Nepal, United States, Canada, and Dominican Republic and more than 450 full-time employees), Fusemachines seeks to bring its global expertise in AI to transform companies around the world.

Type: Remote, Contracted

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer with deep expertise in Tableau, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic data modeling (LookML / Looker, dbt, Omni, or Looker Studio) to join our team. In this role, you will lead critical business intelligence modernization initiatives, reverse-engineering complex reporting logic from legacy dashboards and rebuilding high-performance analytical data models to power executive decision-making.

Job Description

As a Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer, you will work closely with technical leads, product managers, and business stakeholders to modernize legacy BI environments.

You will be responsible for deconstructing legacy dashboard architectures, extracting embedded business rules and Level of Detail (LOD) calculations, and re-architecting those metrics into scalable SQL models and LookML-governed cloud semantic layers.

You will perform as a core data translator, bridging the gap between cloud data warehouses, semantic layers, and client-facing business teams.

Qualification & Experience

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, systems engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or analytics engineering.

raw.excerpt: OutcomesAI is a healthcare technology company building an AI-enabled nursing platform designed to augment clinical teams, automate routine workflows, and safely scale nursing capacity.
raw.description:
OutcomesAI is a healthcare technology company building an AI-enabled nursing platform designed to augment clinical teams, automate routine workflows, and safely scale nursing capacity.
Our solution combines AI voice agents and licensed nurses to handle patient communication, symptom triage, remote monitoring, and post-acute care — reducing administrative burden and enabling clinicians to focus on direct patient care.

Our core product suite includes:

● Glia Voice Agents – multimodal conversational agents capable of answering patient calls, triaging symptoms using evidence-based protocols (e.g., Schmitt-Thompson), scheduling visits, and delivering education and follow-ups.
● Glia Productivity Agents – AI copilots for nurses that automate charting, scribing, and clinical decision support by integrating directly into EHR systems such as Epic and Athena.
● AI-Enabled Nursing Services – a hybrid care delivery model where AI and licensed nurses work together to deliver virtual triage, remote patient monitoring, and specialty patient support programs (e.g., oncology, dementia, dialysis).
Our AI infrastructure leverages multimodal foundation models — incorporating speech recognition (ASR), natural language understanding, and text-to-speech (TTS) — fine-tuned for healthcare environments to ensure safety, empathy, and clinical accuracy. All models operate within a HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2–certified framework. OutcomesAI partners with leading health systems and virtual care organizations to deploy and validate these capabilities at scale. Our goal is to create the world’s first AI + nurse hybrid workforce, improving access, safety, and efficiency across the continuum of care.

About the Role

OutcomesAI is seeking skilled and compassionate Registered Nurses to join our clinical team as Clinical AI Triage Testers. In this specialized per diem role, you will play a vital part in the development and validation of our conversational agentic AI triage workflows. Your focus is dedicated to clinical quality assurance, ensuring that our triage technology is grounded in clinical excellence. You will use your deep triage expertise and clinical assessment skills to stress-test and evaluate AI components for accuracy, appropriate acuity determination, safety, and context. This position blends the art of nursing judgment with the science of advanced technology, ensuring our AI enhances triage care and maintains the highest safety standards before it ever reaches a patient.

What You’ll Do

  • Test Conversational Nurse Triage AI: Interact with AI navigators and agentic triage workflows across varied clinical scenarios to evaluate their ability to gather relevant symptom histories and provide clinically accurate responses.

  • Audit Triage Accuracy: Review AI-generated symptom assessments, acuity levels, and care dispositions to ensure they align with evidence-based triage protocols (such as Schmitt-Thompson) and sound nursing judgment.

  • Identify Safety Risks: Stress-test AI triage logic to identify potential "hallucinations," missed red flags, or clinical errors that could lead to under-triaging or compromise patient safety.

  • Assess Context and Empathy: Evaluate the AI’s ability to communicate clearly, calmly, and empathetically with patients experiencing acute or concerning symptoms, maintaining the "human connection" in a digital environment.

  • Document Findings: Accurately document testing interactions, detailing where the AI succeeds and where it requires refinement in its clinical questioning, reasoning, or final disposition.

  • Collaborate on Triage Optimization: Participate in team-based improvement initiatives to refine triage pathways and bridge the gap between intelligent technology and clinical care.

What We're Looking For

  • Active, unrestricted RN license.

  • Minimum of 3 years of dedicated triage nursing experience (e.g., telephone triage, nurse advice line, ambulatory triage, or virtual triage).

  • Prior experience using Schmitt-Thompson Clinical Content (triage protocols) is required.

  • Strong Triage Assessment Skills: Proven ability to rapidly evaluate patient-reported symptoms, identify clinical red flags, and spot when an AI's logic deviates from safe triage practice.

  • Analytical Mindset: Demonstrated ability to balance standardized protocol adherence with independent critical thinking during the testing process.

  • Tech-Savvy: Highly comfortable using virtual care platforms, clinical decision-support tools, digital documentation systems, and emerging AI tools.

  • Clear Communicator: Able to convey complex clinical feedback and triage nuances to technical teams calmly and concisely.

  • Reliability: Ability to commit to a minimum of 10 hours per week of remote testing.

Why Join Us

  • Pioneer Virtual Triage: Be part of a clinical team redefining patient navigation and triage through safe, AI-enabled workflows.

  • Flexibility: Work fully remote with a per diem model designed to fit your lifestyle.

  • Mission-Driven Impact: Help patients access timely, appropriate levels of care by ensuring the triage tools they interact with are safe, reliable, and grounded in clinical excellence.

  • Supportive Culture: Collaborate with an organization built by nurses and clinicians who value the clinical leadership you bring to the forefront of virtual care.

The FP&A Analyst will support strategic decision-making through financial modeling, business-case analysis, and ongoing monitoring of key initiatives.   • Track financial results and operating drivers against business-case assumptions, explaining variances and identifying emerging issues.
  • Refresh established models and reporting as initiatives evolve, coordinating routine inputs with relevant business partners.
  • Support forecasting and multi-year planning projects as needed, including assumption validation and supporting analysis.

  • Maintain model checks, documentation, assumption records, and version controls to strengthen accuracy and shared understanding.

  • Independently gather routine inputs and resolve analytical questions with relevant stakeholders.
  • Prepare clear supporting schedules, commentary, and presentation materials for senior finance review.

  • Relevant experience in FP&A, financial analysis, or another modeling-intensive analytical role.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency, including experience with large, interconnected workbooks, structured references, defined names, external links, and refresh controls.

  • Demonstrated discipline in source-data reconciliation, model validation, troubleshooting, and documentation.
  • Ability to interrogate Power BI reports and understand how filters, definitions, and reporting scope affect results.
  • Ability to investigate ambiguous issues, organize competing priorities, and distinguish routine corrections from decisions requiring escalation.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate detailed analysis into concise business explanations.

Educational/Vocational/Previous Experience Recommendations:

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent business experience
  • 2-3 years of relevant experience
  • Preferred: Hands-on experience building and maintaining complex financial models and reconciling financial data across multiple sources

raw.description:
About Accumulus Technologies

Accumulus Technologies enables life sciences companies and health authorities to exchange information and collaborate through a shared cloud platform. Our focus is on making regulatory collaboration practical: helping customers progress submissions, apply reliance approaches, and coordinate activity across global markets.

The role

We are seeking a senior regulatory leader to provide the expertise, credibility and practical guidance needed to turn regulatory innovation into routine use.

The Global Head of Regulatory reports to the Chief Commercial Officer and will be Accumulus Technologies’ principal regulatory subject matter expert, connecting customer needs, health authority expectations, and platform capabilities. Our current emphasis is on Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls (CMC), post-approval changes, regulatory reliance and collaborative review, with scope to support initial marketing authorisations and other agreed use cases as we expand.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will work directly with customers and regulators, help select and shape viable projects, resolve regulatory barriers, and guide colleagues across Commercial, Solution Engineering, Customer Success and Product. Success means more well-qualified sponsor projects progressing into active use, measurable customer value, and repeat adoption.

Key responsibilities

Regulatory strategy and expertise

  • Set a focused regulatory strategy aligned with company priorities, customer demand and realistic opportunities for health authority participation.
  • Provide authoritative guidance on global CMC lifecycle management, post-approval changes, reliance, work-sharing and collaborative review.
  • Assess how differences in dossiers, local requirements, reference approvals and submission timing affect project feasibility.
  • Translate regulatory developments into clear recommendations for customers, product priorities and market opportunities.
  • Identify where additional specialist or local expertise is needed and coordinate that input.

Customer and commercial support

  • Join priority discovery and executive discussions to understand customers’ regulatory objectives, operational constraints and decision criteria.
  • Help customers identify suitable products, changes and markets, and define a credible route from initial project to broader adoption.
  • Work with Solution Engineering to establish regulatory feasibility, assumptions, dependencies and success measures before commitments are made.
  • Help build evidence-based business cases that link regulatory collaboration to operational efficiency, supply continuity, approval timing, and business value.
  • Support acquisition, expansion and renewal discussions with regulatory insight, practical examples and credible responses to objections.

Health authority collaboration

  • Work with Regulatory Engagement colleagues and regional leads in major markets to secure the right authority participation for priority customer projects.
  • Provide the regulatory substance for discussions with authorities, industry groups and collaboration initiatives.
  • Help sponsors and authorities agree workable review approaches, information-sharing arrangements and project milestones.
  • Convert expressions of interest into defined next steps, with clear owners and dependencies.
  • Bring authority feedback into customer planning and platform development.

Customer outcomes and adoption

  • Provide senior regulatory guidance during project execution and help resolve issues that could delay or limit customer value.
  • Work with Customer Success and Delivery to support the transition from pilots to repeatable operational use.
  • Establish an approach to capturing project outcomes, lessons learned and referenceable evidence, with customer permission.
  • Develop practical playbooks for project selection, reliance readiness, authority engagement and common regulatory questions.

Product, content and industry leadership

  • Translate sponsor and regulator workflows into clear requirements and priorities for Product.
  • Review priority demonstrations, proposals, presentations and external materials for regulatory accuracy and relevance.
  • Provide regulatory leadership for customer forums with focused agendas and actionable outputs.
  • Represent Accumulus Technologies in selected industry and regulatory forums.
  • Build internal capability through coaching, training and reusable guidance.

Experience and capabilities

  • Substantial senior-level experience in life sciences regulatory affairs, with deep practical expertise in global CMC and lifecycle management.
  • A track record of leading complex submissions or post-approval changes across multiple markets and engaging directly with health authorities.
  • Practical experience with regulatory reliance, collaborative review or initiatives to modernise regulatory processes.
  • Credibility with senior regulatory, quality, manufacturing and supply-chain leaders.
  • Experience translating regulatory strategy into operational change, ideally involving digital workflows, regulatory information management or cloud collaboration.
  • Commercial judgement: able to assess where a project can create value, where assumptions need testing and where a proposed approach is unlikely to work.
  • Clear communication, sound judgement and the ability to influence across functions without relying on hierarchy.
  • Willingness to work directly on customer issues in a lean, growing organisation and travel internationally as required.
  • A degree in a relevant scientific discipline or equivalent professional experience; an advanced qualification is desirable.

How the role works with the team

The role owns regulatory judgement, strategy and the quality of regulatory guidance. Sales owns account strategy and commercial negotiations; Solution Engineering owns solution scoping; Regulatory Engagement leads authority relationships and regional activation; Customer Success and Delivery own adoption and execution within their respective remits. Product owns the platform roadmap and technical implementation.

The Global Head of Regulatory works across these teams to ensure proposed projects are feasible, commitments are credible and regulatory issues have clear ownership. Sponsors retain responsibility for their submissions and health authorities retain their decision-making authority.

What success looks like

  • Priority opportunities have a clear regulatory pathway, appropriate project selection and documented dependencies.
  • Regulatory blockers are identified early and promptly resolved or escalated.
  • More customers progress from initial projects to repeat use across products and markets.
  • Authority engagement results in active participation in relevant projects.
  • Customer outcomes provide credible evidence for business cases, expansion and renewal.
  • Teams use consistent regulatory guidance and rely less on ad hoc specialist support.

Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Austria

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Austria. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP automation people in front of the client.

raw.description:
About the role

We are seeking a hands-on Security Engineer who thrives in a startup environment.

You'll work alongside product owners and engineers with the objective to secure the products in Startale's ecosystem. Products include a next-generation decentralized exchange with a fully on-chain order book (Strium), a user-facing application (StartaleApp) and a stablecoin (USDSC). This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll be the person who actively tests our systems, hunts for vulnerabilities, models threats against our products, and works with engineers to close the gaps — not the person who writes policies and generates reports. You'll report to the Security Lead and collaborate daily with Backend, Frontend, DevOps, and Blockchain engineering teams.

Why this role

  • Startale's products handle user funds and on-chain transactions so security work has tangible impact.
  • Owning the security posture of a project at scale and complexity such as Strium is an opportunity for professional growth.
  • You will have direct influence over how product security is built across the organization.
  • Focus is on driving product security and not on maintaining compliance documentation.
  • Our team is backed by and partnering with leading Japanese enterprises so you will have a chance to work in a stable and well-funded company but with the autonomy and speed of a small team.

Key responsibilities

  • Security Assessments & Penetration Testing: Conduct hands-on security testing of our applications, APIs, and infrastructure. Simulate real attack scenarios against our products. Find the vulnerabilities before external attackers or whitehat researchers do. Work with engineers to fix issues pragmatically.
  • Threat Modeling: Build threat models for new services and features — especially Strium's trading engine, order book, and transaction flows. Identify attack surfaces, model adversary behavior, and define what needs to be hardened before launch.
  • Vulnerability Triage & Remediation: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of findings — from discovery through severity assessment, developer-facing write-ups, remediation guidance, and verification of fixes. Coordinate with engineers so issues actually get closed.
  • Vulnerability Disclosure & Bug Bounty: Manage incoming whitehat reports, validate findings by reproducing them, assess severity, communicate with researchers.
  • AI Tools Security Support: Assess technical risks related to AI tools used within teams (such as data exfiltration, prompt injection, training-on-input), maintain security baselines for AI coding tools and review AI-powered internal tools.

Qualifications

Must-have

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with a focus on application security, penetration testing, or product security.
  • Demonstrated ability to find vulnerabilities — through manual testing, architecture and/or code review, or creative attack simulation. You should be able to describe specific bugs you've found and how you found them.
  • Practical experience with exchange or trading platform security — from a DEX (preferred) or DeFi protocol. You should understand order book mechanics, transaction flows, wallet security, and the threat landscape specific to trading infrastructure.
  • Scripting and automation ability — you write tools and automate to scale security across the stack, not just audit and write reports.
  • Experience triaging vulnerabilities and writing clear, actionable remediation guidance for developers.
  • Strong written communication in English — you'll write tickets, assessment reports and researcher responses.

Strong plus

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure security — least-privilege enforcement, network security, secrets management.
  • Experience with container security — network policies, RBAC, pod security standards, image scanning, Dockerfile hardening, base image management.
  • Ability to read and review code in at least one of: TypeScript/JavaScript, Solidity, Rust.
  • Understanding of software supply chain security, including dependency risks, build integrity, and methods for tracking what components are included in shipped software.
  • Experience managing or participating in a bug bounty program (e.g. Immunefi, HackerOne).

Domain plus

  • Experience securing AI/LLM tooling in engineering teams — prompt injection risks, data leakage prevention, tool configuration hardening
  • Japanese language ability (not required, but useful for company context)

Location / Timezone

  • Strong preference for Tokyo-based or Singapore-based candidates - Startale office locations.
  • Remote-friendly for exceptional candidates — must have 3+ hours overlap with Tokyo business hours (JST, UTC+9).

Target start date

  • As soon as available; realistic target start of Q3 2026.

Target companies

Decentralized exchanges, DeFi protocols, blockchain security firms, L1/L2 chain security teams, or fintech companies with trading infrastructure. We're also open to strong AppSec engineers from cloud-native startups who have genuine interest in web3.

Ideal candidate

You're a hands-on security engineer who finds real vulnerabilities, not just runs scanners. You've secured a trading platform or exchange and understand the threats specific to financial infrastructure — order book manipulation, transaction signing, wallet compromise, front-running. You can take a system, map the attack surface, and come back with findings that matter. You write clear reports that engineers act on, and you know the difference between a theoretical risk and a real one. You're comfortable working independently in a fast-moving team where there's no playbook — you write the playbook.

Role Overview

As a Senior Architecture & Performance Modeling Engineer, you will help shape the architecture of our next-generation AI inference accelerators. You will work directly with chip architects to explore architectural options, quantify tradeoffs, identify bottlenecks, and turn modeling results into actionable design recommendations.

This work starts before RTL exists. You will use analytical models and our in-house simulators to answer architectural questions quickly, then refine and validate those models as the design matures. Each engineer on the team takes primary modeling responsibility for a next-generation chip while contributing to a shared modeling framework.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture Studies and Recommendations

  • Partner with architects to turn design questions into focused modeling studies with clear assumptions, alternatives, metrics, and recommendations.
  • Perform what-if analysis across compute engines, memory capacity and bandwidth, dataflow, DMA, command processing, on-chip interconnect, and chip-to-chip communication.
  • Compare architectural options, explain performance sensitivities, and recommend changes within the system, power, area, and implementation constraints established with the architecture team.

Workload Analysis

  • Evaluate representative AI inference workloads across prefill and decode, batch sizes, context lengths, and dense and mixture-of-experts models to identify what limits latency, throughput, and hardware utilization.
  • Provide timely feedback throughout the design cycle by communicating findings, investigating unexpected results, and updating studies as workloads and architectural choices evolve.

Model Development and Correlation

  • Develop and extend analytical, transaction-level, and cycle-level models, choosing the level of detail needed to answer each question with useful turnaround time.
  • Maintain reusable models in our native Rust simulator and correlate predictions against RTL simulation, emulation, or silicon measurements as they become available, with regression coverage and clear documentation of assumptions, limitations, and discrepancies.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in computer architecture, microarchitecture, or performance modeling for accelerators, CPUs, or GPUs.
  • Demonstrated experience using models to influence architectural decisions, such as identifying a bottleneck, comparing design alternatives, or recommending a change backed by quantitative analysis.
  • A strong understanding of pipelines, queues, parallel execution, memory hierarchies, data movement, and interconnects.
  • Hands-on experience building analytical, transaction-level, or cycle-level performance models, including first-order estimates that help validate and explain simulation results.
  • Comfort working with incomplete specifications, making assumptions explicit, and balancing modeling fidelity with speed of iteration.
  • Strong Rust skills, or expert-level C/C++ skills and a willingness to work in Rust day to day, along with proficiency in Python for workload analysis, experiments, and visualization.
  • Ability to read SystemVerilog RTL and relevant verification results, reconcile them with architectural specifications, and calibrate models as implementation details become available.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain what drives a result, how much confidence to place in it, and what the architecture team should investigate or change next.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with LLM inference, including attention, KV caches, quantization, mixture-of-experts workloads, and parallelism across multiple chips.
  • A track record of connecting workload behavior and software execution choices to hardware performance.

Leveling & Scope

While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire.

Why Join Us?

  • You will own the performance modeling for a next-generation inference chip and see your analysis shape real architectural decisions before RTL is written.
  • You will work side by side with the architects behind Asimov and Titan on the hardware that defines how frontier models are served at scale.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role for Senior: $220,000 – $270,000, for Principal: $270,000-$350,000.

Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits.

At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact.

Benefits & Perks

Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Estonia

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Estonia. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

raw.description:
You’ve discovered something special. A company that cares. Cares about leading the way in construction, engineering, manufacturing and renewable energy. Cares about redefining how energy is designed, applied and consumed. Cares about thoughtfully growing to meet market demands. And ─ as “one of the Healthiest 100 Workplaces in America” ─ is focused on the mind/body/soul of team members through our Culture of Care.

The Lead Product Architect owns a specific product platform, ensuring technical architecture, requirements, standards, lessons learned, and reusable solutions continuously evolve throughout the complete product lifecycle. This individual leads the transformation of ambiguous concepts, customer needs, market requirements, manufacturing feedback, procurement opportunities, and site execution experience into standardized product architectures and clearly documented technical requirements.

The Lead Product Architect owns creation and maintenance of Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), Component Definition Documents (CDDs), specifications, scope documents and matrices, Illustrated Basis of Design (iBODs), client submittals, vendor and site specific permit submittals, and ETO submittal packages. This also includes development and maintenance of master Revit models, reusable BIM content, configuration standards, early Long Lead Equipment (LLE) Bills of Material (BOMs), and design intent documentation that establish the engineering baseline for Detailed Design, including Engineering Bills of Material (EBOMs), fabrication and manufacturing documentation, while supporting strategic procurement activities.

This role directs Product Developers and collaborates closely with Preconstruction, Program Design Managers, Detailed Design, Construction Engineering, Virtual Design Construction (VDC), Procurement, Manufacturing, Construction, Operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure product architecture, requirements, and design intent remain aligned throughout the product lifecycle.

The Lead Product Architect ensures product decisions made during concept development optimize the entire value stream including detailed design, supply chain, fabrication, manufacturing, logistics, site installation, commissioning, and long-term product evolution.

Ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience in leading ETO product development and lifecycle improvement, developing Modular Product Platforms or other complex integrated systems, product platform ownership and technical decision making, leading concept development and product standardization, and creating scalable product architectures and reusable design components. Will have experience developing, owning, and maintaining PRDs, CDDs, specifications, iBODs, scope documents/matrices, and product requirements as well as managing programmatic, site specific, vendor specific, and permit product submittal strategies. Experience reviewing and interpreting construction design documents and technical specifications, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams, as well as understanding concept development, engineering, procurement, fabrication, manufacturing, logistics, construction integration, commissioning, and lifecycle support. Will have demonstrated experience in driving Design for Manufacturing & Assembly (DFMA), cost optimization, quality improvement, and product scalability and leading cross-functional technical decisions and resolving complex product challenges. Will have an expert proficiency in Microsoft Office, Revit (BIM), Autodesk Forma, Navisworks, and Bluebeam as well as working knowledge of AutoCAD Electrical, Inventor (CAD), Vault (PDM), Fusion Manage (PLM), Acumatica (ERP), or related tools.

Success in this role requires the ability to think beyond individual projects and continuously strengthen the product platform through standardization, innovation, lessons learned, and lifecycle ownership.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Education: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Engineering Technology, or related technical discipline.

Experience: 5+ years of experience in engineering, product development, modular construction, manufacturing, or mission critical environments.

Travel: 10-50%

Work Schedule: This position works between the hours of 7 AM and 5 PM, Monday- Friday. However, work may be performed at any time on any day of the week to meet business needs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leads, coaches, and mentors direct reports.
  • Performs all responsibilities of Associate Product Architect while serving as technical owner for an assigned product platform across all clients and throughout the entire lifecycle.
  • Owns product architecture, standard designs, reusable components, configurations, and technical direction.
  • Maintains complete understanding of product capabilities, constraints, applications, and offerings.
  • Develops, owns, and maintains PRDs, CDDs, specifications, scope documents/matrices, iBODs, standards, and product documentation.
  • Develops and maintains master Revit models, reusable BIM content, product configuration standards, and digital product definition documentation.
  • Translates evolving concepts, customer needs, and business strategies into clear technical standards and requirements.
  • Leads creation of product definition packages for engineering execution.
  • Develops early Long Lead Equipment (LLE) Bills of Material (BOMs) supporting strategic procurement activities.
  • Directs Product Developers and coordinates engineering resources to ensure deliverables align with product requirements, architecture, and design intent.
  • Establishes the engineering baseline transitioned to Detailed Design for Inventor modeling, Engineering Bills of Material (E-BOMs), fabrication and manufacturing documentation, and engineering release.
  • Ensures alignment between product architecture, Detailed Design, Construction Engineering, VDC coordination, procurement strategy, manufacturing capability, constructability, installation, operations, and customer requirements.
  • Collaborates with Program Design Managers and Preconstruction to deliver optimized client solutions leveraging standard product platforms.
  • Collaborates with Detailed Design, Construction Engineering, VDC, Procurement, Manufacturing, Construction, Operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to establish the engineering baseline and support successful downstream execution.
  • Leads technical decision-making for assigned product platforms.
  • Champions product consistency and defend standards across implementations.
  • Captures and integrates lifecycle feedback from downstream execution teams.
  • Drives product evolution based on detailed design, procurement, fabrication, manufacturing, deployment, and operational lessons learned.
  • Identifies innovation opportunities that improve cost, schedule, quality, safety, scalability, and lifecycle value.
  • Performs other related duties as required and assigned.

How We Work:

We aim to create an environment where talented individuals are empowered to excel. How we collaborate, innovate, and engage with one another is important to us. Our work is driven by 5 key principles:

  • One team, One mission
    Our collective dedication to Nitro's mission defines us. Together, we are building an environment where everyone feels like a valued part of something bigger than themselves.
  • Own it
    We take full ownership of our actions and decisions. We empower one another to lead with confidence, creativity, and a solutions-focused mindset.
  • Accountable to our customers
    We are dedicated to our customers and take our commitments seriously. We do what we say we are going to do.

    Driven by passion and precision, ​we exemplify excellence in our delivery with innovative, top-quality results.

    We learn as we grow, dare to try, ​and bravely question. We are not chasing perfection but forever iterating towards it.

These guiding values shape our approach to work, fostering a culture where everyone is inspired to contribute their best.

The Role:We're looking for an experienced Strategic Account Executive to play a pivotal role in producing incremental sales revenue within the sales department. In this role, you will actively and consistently attain Nitro quarterly and annual sales targets. Your ability to prospect and close your own net-new business is imperative to your success and over achievement at Nitro.

The Strategic Account Executive role is expected to deliver Nitro’s differentiated message to key decision makers, demonstrating how the knowledge worker adoption of Nitro drives productivity, increases information security and resource sustainability. The Strategic Account Executive is expected to manage their time and customer engagement effectively to deliver the highest revenue return by activity type. Nitro’s Account Executives shall be a trusted adviser to assist prospects and customers during this transformative process.

What you'll be doing:

  • Hunting, prospecting and developing a network within your set territory to acquire net-new logos
  • Engage and empower channel partners to build partner led pipeline within your territory
  • Developing a deep understanding of pipeline development and pipeline diversification with the ability to answer questions including: what pipeline coverage do I require to maximize on target success? What is my gap and what activities do I need to undertake to fill them? What are the sources that contribute to my pipeline and how do I ensure I have a good mix of large and small opportunities?
  • Applying time and intelligence to move prospects through Nitro’s sales cycle – from prospecting to close
  • Navigating political structures and creating and running Mutual Action Plans to drive desired outcomes
  • Developing business cases and a clear understanding of the impact in productivity gains for businesses by vertical
  • Maintaining an appropriate and sustained level of calls, emails and InMails to ensure engagement and drive each sales conversation to the next stage of the sales cycle

What we're looking for:

  • BA/BS or equivalent. Business specialization preferred
  • 5+ years of SaaS sales experience
  • 2+ years of Channel (Value Added Reseller and or Distributor) experience
  • Work within your assigned territory to establish and develop a strategy for identifying and closing opportunities directly with key commercial accounts and net new commercial prospects across multiple industry verticals
  • Track record of overachieving quota in past roles
  • Net-new business “hunter” background with demonstrated ability to fill 50% of your own pipeline
  • Clear understanding of pipeline management to ensure consistent 3X coverage

Why Nitro?
Along with our regular benefits and programs (including health, dental, vision, and retirement as standard), we are also very proud to offer a few additional initiatives to future Nitronauts:

Flex Time Off
Work-life balance is important at Nitro, and we understand that there are events that we cannot plan for. We are proud to offer Flex Time Off to be used for holidays, spending days with your family, or appointments.

Benefits:Nitro provides all employees with a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, dental and vision coverage, and wellness perks. We also offer pension/401k matching, along with many other country-specific benefits.

Nitro strongly encourages applications from everyone regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. raw.description:
It’s an exciting time to join HiBob. Salesforce is leading a $166 million investment in the company, supporting our vision to bring trusted people context into the AI-powered enterprise. As we accelerate our product, technology, AI, and innovation roadmap, you’ll have the opportunity to help shape what comes next.

HiBob helps modern, mid-size businesses transform the way they manage people, giving HR and managers all they need to connect, engage, develop, and retain top talent. Since 2015, we've achieved strong and consistent growth, powered by a global team building one of the most modern HR platforms in the market.
Our platform is intuitive, data-driven, and built for the way people work today: globally, remotely, and collaboratively. Companies around the world rely on Bob to create better employee experiences and drive business outcomes.

As part of this evolution, HiBob is expanding into the Office of the CFO. The Finance Tech unit is building an AI-native FP&A product from the ground up: planning, forecasting and modeling on top of the people and financial data our customers already trust Bob with.

About the role
We're looking for a Director of Product to lead HiBob's FP&A product line. You'll set the product vision and strategy for FP&A, build and lead a team of product managers, and stay close enough to the work to shape the product yourself. You'll partner with engineering, design, go-to-market and HiBob's leadership to take a new product line from early build to a business that wins in the market. This is a senior, high-impact role. It needs deep domain knowledge, strong product leadership, and the judgment to make big bets in a category AI is reshaping.

East Coast location is strongly preferred, though we’re open to exceptional candidates based elsewhere in the U.S.

Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for HiBob's FP&A product line
  • Build, hire and lead a team of product managers across planning and modeling, data, and the agentic layer
  • Partner with engineering leadership on core architecture, including the calculation engine, the unified data model and how AI works with deterministic logic
  • Define how FP&A connects with HiBob's HR platform and people data to create advantages competitors can't match
  • Work with go-to-market teams on positioning, pricing, packaging and launch
  • Represent the FP&A product with customers, partners and HiBob leadership
  • Set the product standards, rituals and ways of working for a new unit
What makes this role interesting
  • You'll lead a new product line from the ground up, backed by an established platform and customer base
  • You'll help define what AI-native FP&A looks like as the category is being redefined
  • You'll have real ownership: the vision, the team and the product are yours to shape
  • You'll work with a senior, hands-on leadership team that's committed to the Office of the CFO

Requirements

  • 10+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, including 3+ years leading product managers or a product area
  • Deep experience building planning, EPM, FP&A or other finance products, ideally across modeling, forecasting and data
  • A clear point of view on where FP&A software is heading, and how AI changes planning, forecasting and collaboration
  • Strong technical depth, and the ability to lead architecture conversations with engineering on calculation engines, data models and integrations
  • A track record of taking products from concept to market, including strategy, roadmap, launch and adoption
  • Experience hiring, coaching and growing high-performing product managers
  • Executive-level communication: telling a clear story, handling hard questions and aligning stakeholders across the company
  • A hands-on leadership style. You're comfortable writing the spec, reviewing the prototype or joining the customer call yourself
Strong advantage
  • Leadership experience at a planning or EPM vendor, such as Anaplan, Adaptive, OneStream, Pigment, Vena, Prophix, Board or Jedox
  • Experience building or rebuilding a calculation or modeling engine, or a unified data model
  • A background as an FP&A practitioner, implementation leader or consultant
  • Experience shipping AI or agentic products to enterprise or mid-market customers
  • Experience building a new product line inside an established platform company

    You might be a strong fit if:
  • You want to build an FP&A product from the ground up, not maintain a mature one
  • You have strong opinions on modeling, data and AI in planning, and want the room to act on them
  • You like leading a small, senior team and still getting into the details yourself
  • You're energized by working across product, engineering, go-to-market and leadership to make a new bet succeed
  • What matters most is domain depth, product judgment, and the ability to build a team and a product at the same time.

Benefits

At HiBob, our people are at the heart of everything we do.

We’re building a global village of ambitious, thoughtful, and talented Bobbers who want to do the best work of their careers. With a vibrant NYC office and remote teammates across the country, we’ve created an environment where people can be themselves, grow quickly, and make a real impact.
Joining HiBob means working alongside exceptional people while being supported with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and pre-IPO equity, including the perks below.

Ownership & Financial
  • Equity in a global, high-growth HR tech SaaS leader
  • 401(k) with a 3% company match effective the month following your start date
  • $2,500 employee referral bonus
Health & Wellbeing
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage from day one
  • $1,920 annual wellness stipend to support your physical and mental wellbeing
  • Annual Headspace membership and expanded wellness benefits
Workplace Flexibility
  • Hybrid working model for Bobbers in the NY metro area
  • Temporary work from anywhere for up to 2 months per year (after 6 months)
Work-Life Balance
  • Generous paid time off and company holidays to rest, recharge, and enjoy
  • Bob Balance Days – 4 additional days within a calendar year - Enjoy a company-wide long weekend at the beginning of each quarter
  • Your birthday off — plus a special gift from us
Work From Home
  • Home office allowance to set up your ideal workspace
Community & Culture
  • Two paid Social Impact days each year to give back to causes you care about
  • Frequent team and company social events, both in-person and virtual
  • Dog friendly office

If this sounds like something you’ve been looking for, we’d love to have you. Come on, join our village!

raw.excerpt: About Us Korsana Biosciences is a private biopharmaceutical company advancing a pipeline of potential best-in-class therapies for neurodegenerative diseases.
raw.description:
About Us

Korsana Biosciences is a private biopharmaceutical company advancing a pipeline of potential best-in-class therapies for neurodegenerative diseases. In partnership with Paragon Therapeutics, we have developed Therapeutic Targeting (THETA™), a novel blood-brain barrier-penetrant shuttle platform designed to enable dramatically higher drug concentration inside the brain and overcome the limitations of earlier shuttle technologies. Our lead program is KRSA-028, an investigational, shuttled antibody targeting amyloid beta designed to be a best-in-class treatment for Alzheimer’s disease. Our mission is to advance precision-engineered therapies, designed to address some of the biggest unmet needs in medicine. For more information, please visit

Position Overview

The Senior Director, Biologics Drug Substance Development and Manufacturing, will provide program-specific leadership and subject matter expertise for drug substance development and manufacturing activities in support of a best-in-class portfolio of preclinical and clinical programs. This leader will oversee the planning and execution of outsourced drug substance development and manufacturing activities and will work proactively with external suppliers including CDMOs and contract labs to define project scope, mitigate risks, and ensure successful delivery in relation to technical quality, timelines and budget. The incumbent will collaborate with other functions to deliver quality products for preclinical studies and clinical trials and Module 3 Quality for regulatory submission and approval. The position requires strategic vision and hands-on experience managing early-stage biotech programs in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Establishes effective CMC strategies for biologics drug substance manufacturing process development, optimization, characterization, scale-up, GMP manufacturing for a portfolio of biologics in keeping with corporate and program objectives.
  • Collaborates with internal stakeholders in the areas of Drug Product Development, Combination Product Development, Analytical Development and Quality Control, Clinical Supply Chain, Program Management, Preclinical Development, Clinical Development/Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and external business partners to push project forward.
  • Creates metrics for drug substance function, monitors results and implements risk management strategies to address technical challenges and meet business goals.
  • In partnership with QA, supports deviation and OOS investigations, and associated CAPAs for drug substance release and stability testing.
  • Prepares CMC documentation for regulatory and/or patent filings.
  • Leads CDMO/CRO selection, contract negotiation, and budget/scope management related to drug substance development and manufacturing.
  • Maintains an understanding of current trends and emerging biologics drug substance manufacturing technologies.
  • Provides clear communication to management regarding progress against technical objectives/milestones.
  • Ensures well-organized, clear and complete records of all activities across areas of responsibility

Education & Experience

  • Ph.D. in (bio)chemistry, (bio)chemical engineering (or other relevant physical or life sciences discipline) or MS/BS with equivalent education or experience is required.
  • A minimum of 12 years of hands-on working experience in biologics drug substance development in biotech or biopharma industry.
  • Experience in a fast paced, high-growth startup environment is preferred
  • Experience in successful IND/IMPD

Skills & Attributes

  • Demonstrated ability in the areas ofleading and managing biologics drug substance manufacturing process development, optimization, characterization, scale-up, and GMP manufacturing in an outsourced business model.
  • Proven track record of CDMO selection and management in supporting biologics drug substance development and GMP manufacturing.
  • Hands-on working experience of global CMC regulatory submission and approval.
  • Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach; comfortable balancing long-term planning with day-to-day execution
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence across levels and functions
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to distinguish between critical and non-critical priorities

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $250,000 - $280,000. About the Role

raw.description:
What Do We Do?

Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern ecommerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it bites.

We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the most actionable AI in commerce — Moby 2 — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby 2 doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.

The result: more than 65,000 brands like Kitsch, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.

What you’re applying to

We’re looking for a Sales Development Representative to create qualified sales opportunities with ecommerce brands across EMEA. You’ll identify relevant accounts, research the people behind them and start conversations about business problems Triple Whale can help solve. You’ll qualify whether there is a genuine reason to explore further and arrange a clear next step with an Account Executive.

This is a proactive prospecting role. You won’t rely solely on inbound enquiries or work through a list with the same message for every company. You’ll combine targeted outbound with timely follow-up on marketing-generated interest, adapting your approach to the account, buyer and market. The priority is not simply booking more meetings. It’s creating relevant conversations that develop into qualified pipeline.

What you’ll do

  • Build a focused prospecting plan. Work with Account Executives to prioritise ecommerce brands that fit Triple Whale’s customer profile and agree account ownership before outreach.
  • Research accounts and relevant buyers. Understand the brand’s business, likely priorities and the people responsible for ecommerce, marketing and growth.
  • Create opportunities through outbound prospecting. Use phone, email and LinkedIn to reach relevant buyers with a clear reason for contacting them.
  • Make outreach specific and useful. Connect your message to an observable business signal or relevant challenge rather than lead with a generic product pitch.
  • Follow up on marketing-generated interest. Respond promptly to demo requests, event engagement and campaign enquiries, using the context of each interaction to guide the conversation.
  • Run initial qualification conversations. Establish customer fit, the business problem, relevant stakeholders and whether there is a credible reason to take the next step.
  • Book and support meaningful sales meetings. Set a clear agenda, confirm attendance and give the Account Executive the context needed to continue the conversation.
  • Develop longer-term prospects. Maintain appropriate follow-up with relevant accounts that are not ready to buy, coordinating with Marketing’s nurture programmes to avoid conflicting messages.
  • Keep CRM records accurate. Document account research, outreach, qualification, objections and agreed next steps. Respect contact preferences, opt-outs and applicable outreach requirements.
  • Improve the prospecting approach. Review calls and messages, test different approaches and share recurring buyer needs and objections with Sales and Marketing.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in sales development, business development, or a similar customer-facing role where you’ve proactively started commercial conversations. Experience with ecommerce brands or B2B SaaS is a plus.
  • Confidence making outbound calls and engaging prospects who weren’t expecting to hear from you.
  • Strong research and writing skills, with the ability to identify a relevant reason to reach out and communicate it clearly and concisely.
  • Good listening skills and thoughtful questions that uncover business needs and distinguish genuine sales potential from surface-level interest.
  • Strong organisation and follow-through, keeping accounts, conversations, and commitments on track.
  • A willingness to learn, apply coaching, and test new approaches to improve results.
  • Familiarity with marketing technology, analytics, or AI software, and an understanding of ecommerce metrics such as customer acquisition cost, return on ad spend, and profitability, would be valuable.
  • Experience using HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar prospecting and sales engagement tools is a plus.

Triple Whale is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Join Us in Making Waves

If you’re looking for more than just a job and want to be part of a movement reshaping the future of Ecommerce, Triple Whale is the place for you. We’re on the lookout for driven, curious, and creative individuals ready to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
