raw.description:
Overview

Overview:

HealthEdge is seeking a Manager, Regulatory Compliance to lead a team of regulatory professionals supporting HealthEdge Source™, HealthEdge’s reference data and pricing transparency platform. The Manager, Regulatory Compliance will lead a team of regulatory professionals responsible for monitoring, interpreting, and operationalizing federal and state regulatory requirements to align our products with regulatory changes impacting commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid lines of business. The Manager will coach, develop, and lead a team of claims pricing and editing subject matter experts, ensuring high-quality regulatory outputs, strong team engagement, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is a proven people manager who brings healthcare regulatory or reference data knowledge sufficient to guide the team’s work – someone who leads through others, builds capability, and creates accountability structures that allow the team to deliver consistently against a complex and evolving regulatory landscape.

Your Impact

As the Manager, Regulatory Compliance for HealthEdge Source™, you will:

  • Build and sustain a high-performing team of regulatory and reference data SMEs through active coaching, clear expectations, and ongoing feedback.
  • Manage workload distribution, prioritization, and delivery across the team to meet regulatory milestones and Source product release commitments.
  • Serve as an escalation point for Source-related regulatory issues, guiding the team through complex interpretation and resolution.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Client Success stakeholders to ensure regulatory requirements are clearly understood and operationalized in Source.

What you will do:

People Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, supervise, and develop a team of regulatory compliance professionals with expertise in claims pricing, reference data, and healthcare transparency requirements.
  • Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and career development conversations.
  • Build a team culture grounded in accountability, intellectual rigor, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage workload planning, capacity, and coverage to ensure consistent delivery against regulatory timelines and data release cycles.
  • Drive onboarding and skill development for new and existing team members as Source’s regulatory scope evolves.

Source Regulatory Operations

  • Oversee the team’s monitoring, interpretation, and documentation of federal and state regulatory requirements impacting pricing, reference data and editing.
  • Ensure regulatory deliverables - system requirement specifications, and client-facing materials – are accurate, timely, and meet quality standards.
  • Manage the team’s review and disposition of regulatory changes relevant to Source across commercial, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid lines of business.
  • Oversee escalation management and resolution of complex regulatory issues affecting Source customers or product functionality.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Source Product and Engineering to ensure regulatory requirements are incorporated into roadmap planning and sprint execution.
  • Collaborate with Client Success and Implementation teams to support health plan client inquiries related to Source regulatory content.
  • Represent the team’s work in cross-functional meetings, regulatory forums, and client-facing engagements as needed.
  • Coordinate on enterprise regulatory monitoring and cross-product impact assessments where Source data intersects with other HealthEdge platforms.

What you bring: 

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in healthcare regulatory compliance, healthcare operations, managed care, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive people leadership experience, including leading teams of highly specialized professionals.
  • Demonstrated success building team capability, managing performance, and developing staff in a technical or compliance environment.
  • Experience working within or in support of a healthcare technology or managed care organization.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Working knowledge of claims pricing, editing and reference data concepts
  • Familiarity with Transparency in Coverage requirements, including MRF obligations, schema versioning, and in-network/out-of-network file content standards.
  • Ability to translate regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for team members and cross-functional partners.
  • Exceptional people management skills: coaching, feedback, performance management, and team building.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills; comfortable managing multiple workstreams and release deadlines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to summarize complex regulatory content for varied audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting healthcare SaaS products or healthcare technology platforms.
  • Familiarity with HealthEdge Source™ or comparable claims pricing, editing, reference data and pricing transparency platforms.
  • Knowledge of CMS regulations, NCQA accreditation standards, interoperability requirements, HL7 FHIR, TEFCA, HIPAA, and related healthcare compliance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting core administration platforms, care management solutions, or digital health technologies.
  • Familiarity with Agile product development methodologies and regulatory-driven release management.
  • Experience leading organizational transformation, functional redesign, or large-scale compliance initiatives.

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

**The annual US base salary range for this position is $148,000 to $156,000. This salary range may cover multiple career levels at HealthEdge. Final compensation will be determined during the interview process and is based on a combination of factors including, but not limited to, your skills, experience, qualifications and education.

raw.description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Cyprus

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Cyprus. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

raw.description:
About Us

Korsana Biosciences is a private biopharmaceutical company advancing a pipeline of potential best-in-class therapies for neurodegenerative diseases. In partnership with Paragon Therapeutics, we have developed Therapeutic Targeting (THETA™), a novel blood-brain barrier-penetrant shuttle platform designed to enable dramatically higher drug concentration inside the brain and overcome the limitations of earlier shuttle technologies. Our lead program is KRSA-028, an investigational, shuttled antibody targeting amyloid beta designed to be a best-in-class treatment for Alzheimer’s disease. Our mission is to advance precision-engineered therapies, designed to address some of the biggest unmet needs in medicine. For more information, please visit

Position Overview

The Senior Director, Biologics Drug Substance Development and Manufacturing, will provide program-specific leadership and subject matter expertise for drug substance development and manufacturing activities in support of a best-in-class portfolio of preclinical and clinical programs. This leader will oversee the planning and execution of outsourced drug substance development and manufacturing activities and will work proactively with external suppliers including CDMOs and contract labs to define project scope, mitigate risks, and ensure successful delivery in relation to technical quality, timelines and budget. The incumbent will collaborate with other functions to deliver quality products for preclinical studies and clinical trials and Module 3 Quality for regulatory submission and approval. The position requires strategic vision and hands-on experience managing early-stage biotech programs in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Establishes effective CMC strategies for biologics drug substance manufacturing process development, optimization, characterization, scale-up, GMP manufacturing for a portfolio of biologics in keeping with corporate and program objectives.
  • Collaborates with internal stakeholders in the areas of Drug Product Development, Combination Product Development, Analytical Development and Quality Control, Clinical Supply Chain, Program Management, Preclinical Development, Clinical Development/Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and external business partners to push project forward.
  • Creates metrics for drug substance function, monitors results and implements risk management strategies to address technical challenges and meet business goals.
  • In partnership with QA, supports deviation and OOS investigations, and associated CAPAs for drug substance release and stability testing.
  • Prepares CMC documentation for regulatory and/or patent filings.
  • Leads CDMO/CRO selection, contract negotiation, and budget/scope management related to drug substance development and manufacturing.
  • Maintains an understanding of current trends and emerging biologics drug substance manufacturing technologies.
  • Provides clear communication to management regarding progress against technical objectives/milestones.
  • Ensures well-organized, clear and complete records of all activities across areas of responsibility

Education & Experience

  • Ph.D. in (bio)chemistry, (bio)chemical engineering (or other relevant physical or life sciences discipline) or MS/BS with equivalent education or experience is required.
  • A minimum of 12 years of hands-on working experience in biologics drug substance development in biotech or biopharma industry.
  • Experience in a fast paced, high-growth startup environment is preferred
  • Experience in successful IND/IMPD

Skills & Attributes

  • Demonstrated ability in the areas ofleading and managing biologics drug substance manufacturing process development, optimization, characterization, scale-up, and GMP manufacturing in an outsourced business model.
  • Proven track record of CDMO selection and management in supporting biologics drug substance development and GMP manufacturing.
  • Hands-on working experience of global CMC regulatory submission and approval.
  • Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach; comfortable balancing long-term planning with day-to-day execution
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence across levels and functions
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to distinguish between critical and non-critical priorities

This role may also be eligible for a target annual bonus and equity-based compensation, as well as participation in the company’s benefit programs. raw.description:
Overview

Overview:

HealthEdge is seeking a Manager, Regulatory Compliance to lead a team of regulatory professionals supporting HealthEdge Source™, HealthEdge’s reference data and pricing transparency platform. The Manager, Regulatory Compliance will lead a team of regulatory professionals responsible for monitoring, interpreting, and operationalizing federal and state regulatory requirements to align our products with regulatory changes impacting commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid lines of business. The Manager will coach, develop, and lead a team of claims pricing and editing subject matter experts, ensuring high-quality regulatory outputs, strong team engagement, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is a proven people manager who brings healthcare regulatory or reference data knowledge sufficient to guide the team’s work – someone who leads through others, builds capability, and creates accountability structures that allow the team to deliver consistently against a complex and evolving regulatory landscape.

Your Impact

As the Manager, Regulatory Compliance for HealthEdge Source™, you will:

  • Build and sustain a high-performing team of regulatory and reference data SMEs through active coaching, clear expectations, and ongoing feedback.
  • Manage workload distribution, prioritization, and delivery across the team to meet regulatory milestones and Source product release commitments.
  • Serve as an escalation point for Source-related regulatory issues, guiding the team through complex interpretation and resolution.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Client Success stakeholders to ensure regulatory requirements are clearly understood and operationalized in Source.

What you will do:

People Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, supervise, and develop a team of regulatory compliance professionals with expertise in claims pricing, reference data, and healthcare transparency requirements.
  • Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and career development conversations.
  • Build a team culture grounded in accountability, intellectual rigor, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage workload planning, capacity, and coverage to ensure consistent delivery against regulatory timelines and data release cycles.
  • Drive onboarding and skill development for new and existing team members as Source’s regulatory scope evolves.

Source Regulatory Operations

  • Oversee the team’s monitoring, interpretation, and documentation of federal and state regulatory requirements impacting pricing, reference data and editing.
  • Ensure regulatory deliverables - system requirement specifications, and client-facing materials – are accurate, timely, and meet quality standards.
  • Manage the team’s review and disposition of regulatory changes relevant to Source across commercial, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid lines of business.
  • Oversee escalation management and resolution of complex regulatory issues affecting Source customers or product functionality.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Source Product and Engineering to ensure regulatory requirements are incorporated into roadmap planning and sprint execution.
  • Collaborate with Client Success and Implementation teams to support health plan client inquiries related to Source regulatory content.
  • Represent the team’s work in cross-functional meetings, regulatory forums, and client-facing engagements as needed.
  • Coordinate on enterprise regulatory monitoring and cross-product impact assessments where Source data intersects with other HealthEdge platforms.

What you bring: 

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in healthcare regulatory compliance, healthcare operations, managed care, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive people leadership experience, including leading teams of highly specialized professionals.
  • Demonstrated success building team capability, managing performance, and developing staff in a technical or compliance environment.
  • Experience working within or in support of a healthcare technology or managed care organization.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Working knowledge of claims pricing, editing and reference data concepts
  • Familiarity with Transparency in Coverage requirements, including MRF obligations, schema versioning, and in-network/out-of-network file content standards.
  • Ability to translate regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for team members and cross-functional partners.
  • Exceptional people management skills: coaching, feedback, performance management, and team building.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills; comfortable managing multiple workstreams and release deadlines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to summarize complex regulatory content for varied audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting healthcare SaaS products or healthcare technology platforms.
  • Familiarity with HealthEdge Source™ or comparable claims pricing, editing, reference data and pricing transparency platforms.
  • Knowledge of CMS regulations, NCQA accreditation standards, interoperability requirements, HL7 FHIR, TEFCA, HIPAA, and related healthcare compliance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting core administration platforms, care management solutions, or digital health technologies.
  • Familiarity with Agile product development methodologies and regulatory-driven release management.
  • Experience leading organizational transformation, functional redesign, or large-scale compliance initiatives.

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

**The annual US base salary range for this position is $148,000 to $156,000. This salary range may cover multiple career levels at HealthEdge. Final compensation will be determined during the interview process and is based on a combination of factors including, but not limited to, your skills, experience, qualifications and education.

Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Cyprus

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Cyprus. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

About Future Group
Future Group is not your traditional financial services company – we're a collective of super funds and services committed to changing our planet now for a better tomorrow. When you join us, you’ll become part of a team united by a clear and important mission: to lead the investment movement by advocating and campaigning for a future worth retiring into.
We are looking for someone to join us as a Data Delivery Lead for an initial 12 month fixed term contract. This is a brand new role, reporting into our Head of Data. It exists to manage delivery end to end for Data & Analytics, so that each workstream can focus on the work itself. We would love this person to take the delivery approach the team has today and make it better - keeping what works and changing what does not - and helping shape what the role becomes.

And the best bit, you’ll get to work with some fantastic work mates!
Future Group values diverse lived experience and identities, and we strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander backgrounds, those with caring responsibilities, from culturally and racially marginalised groups, with disabilities, who experience ageism, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and those who face social exclusion due to their social class.

We recognise that the recruitment journey may present unique challenges for trans and gender diverse folk, and we are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all. We will happily make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate diverse needs, so if there is anything we can do to support you at any stage of your application, please let us know. For more information about DEIB at Future Group, please contact us at .

You'll love this job if

  • You want to bring structure, visibility and momentum to how Data & Analytics work gets delivered.
  • You enjoy owning the full delivery cycle across multiple workstreams, from the initial request through to release.
  • You like founding roles where you can keep what works, improve what doesn’t and help shape what the role becomes.
  • You’re comfortable making trade-offs, holding the line on scope and helping stakeholders understand what will move, when and why.
  • You like to be kept on your toes - we're a fast paced, growth-focused company and change is inevitable here! You like to tackle new challenges, and maybe even discover talents you never knew you had.

We're looking for someone who

  • Believes in Future Group’s mission of using the power of money to build a sustainable and equitable world
  • Has strong business analysis skills, including eliciting requirements and turning ambiguous requests into clear stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Has run delivery for a team, including sprint planning, prioritisation and dependency management, and is ready to own delivery across multiple workstreams.
  • Can own and maintain a prioritised, sprint-ready backlog, manage capacity, coordinate releases and keep the delivery roadmap and status visible. Experience using Jira or equivalent delivery tooling is essential.
  • Has enough SQL and data literacy to specify work precisely, understand how data pipelines, models and reporting are built, and challenge estimates where needed.
  • Can work with senior stakeholders, communicate status and trade-offs in plain business language, and say no or not yet with a rationale that holds.
Some nice-to-haves are:
  • Experience as a Scrum Master, Product Owner or Delivery Lead.
  • Experience in superannuation, wealth or financial services.
  • Experience using automation to improve delivery or reporting processes.
We value skills, passion and who you are over where you’ve studied. So if this job strikes a chord, we want to hear from you!

Why would you enjoy working at Future Group?

  • A purpose-driven organisation - spend your days working on making this world a better place! The more we grow, the bigger the impact we are making on climate change and inequality
  • A B Corp organisation that cares about how it behaves inside and out
  • AFR's Best Place to Work 2026! Proud winners of TWO awards: Best Medium Organisation, and our industry category of Banking, Superannuation and Financial Services (an award we also won in 2022!)
  • Flexibility to fit work into your life (not your life around our work). School drop-offs/pick-ups and lunch-time gym sessions are a thing here
  • The choice to work from home, from one of our co-working spaces, from anywhere within Australia or even from overseas (for a short period of time)
  • The potential to own a piece of the Future Group pie with our unique Employee Share Ownership Program (with some fineprint)
  • Fun company-wide events
  • Progressive, people-focused policies and benefits including Menstrual and Menopausal Leave, Public holidays swaps, Cultural Leave, Self Care Leave and Gender Affirmation Guidelines and Leave
  • We offer employee network groups for people from diverse backgrounds: SuperGenders for cisgender women, trans men and women and non-binary folks; SuperGlobal for culturally diverse folks; and SuperPride for LGBTQIA+ folks. The groups are a safe, supportive space for people to share experiences and ideas
  • An inclusive parental leave package, with 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents of all genders
  • A laptop you can use to work remotely plus an allowance to make your working from home setup comfortable
  • Other perks such as access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), the ability to purchase leave, novated leasing arrangements for electric vehicles, and a few more to find out!

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Manager, Contracts Management to provide strategic commercial and contractual support across DXC's diverse global business portfolio.


In this role, you will partner with Sales, Account Leadership, Legal, Finance, and Delivery teams to support complex technology, consulting, and outsourcing transactions across multiple industries.


You will play a critical role throughout the contract lifecycle, from proposal development and commercial negotiations through contract execution, ongoing administration, and contract closure.


As a trusted commercial advisor, you will help business leaders navigate contractual complexities, identify and mitigate commercial risks, optimize profitability and margins, and ensure that agreements align with DXC's business objectives, corporate policies, applicable laws, and customer requirements.


This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded contracts professional who combines strong negotiation and contract management expertise with business acumen and the ability to influence stakeholders in a complex, global technology environment.


What You'll Do


1. Commercial Strategy & Contract Advisory

  • Provide strategic commercial and contractual guidance to Sales, Account Leadership, and business stakeholders across a diverse portfolio of technology and outsourcing engagements.
  • Advise on the development, structuring, review, and negotiation of complex commercial agreements, ensuring alignment with DXC policies, business objectives, and applicable legal requirements.
  • Analyze contractual terms and conditions, identifying key commercial obligations, exposures, risks, and opportunities.
  • Provide guidance on contract interpretation, commercial implications, and contractual rights and obligations.
  • Support business teams in leveraging contractual provisions to protect DXC's commercial interests and maximize profitability and margin opportunities.
  • Evaluate commercial structures, pricing considerations, contractual commitments, and potential financial exposures.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to develop commercially sound solutions for complex contractual matters.

2. Contract Negotiation & Lifecycle Management

  • Lead and support contract drafting, review, analysis, and negotiations for technology services, consulting, and outsourcing agreements.
  • Manage the full contract lifecycle, from proposal initiation and contract development through execution, ongoing management, amendments, and closure.
  • Support negotiations with customers and external stakeholders, balancing commercial objectives, risk exposure, and customer expectations.
  • Manage contract changes, amendments, deliverables, correspondence, and contractual commitments.
  • Monitor contractual performance and compliance by both parties, identifying potential conflicts, deviations, risks, and opportunities for resolution.
  • Maintain accurate and comprehensive contract documentation, ensuring appropriate tracking and reporting throughout the contract lifecycle.
  • Monitor key contractual milestones, deadlines, obligations, and deliverables, proactively communicating potential issues to relevant stakeholders.

3. Risk Management & Governance

  • Conduct commercial and contractual risk assessments for new business opportunities, contract renewals, and existing customer engagements.
  • Identify, evaluate, and communicate contractual risks, obligations, and potential business impacts.
  • Ensure contracts and commercial arrangements comply with DXC's contracting policies, approval processes, applicable laws, and customer requirements.
  • Provide recommendations and mitigation strategies for complex commercial and contractual issues.
  • Maintain visibility into contract status, risk profiles, exceptions, and compliance matters.
  • Utilize digital tools and reporting platforms to monitor contract activity, track approvals, and provide management with timely and accurate information.
  • Support company-wide reporting and data requests related to contractual obligations, commercial terms, and contract portfolios.

4. Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a trusted commercial advisor to Account Leaders, Sales teams, Delivery organizations, and other business stakeholders.
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external customers, facilitating effective communication and resolution of contractual matters.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Legal, Finance, Procurement, Sales, and Operations, to support business objectives.
  • Translate complex contractual language and commercial risks into clear, practical business recommendations.
  • Develop an understanding of customer business strategies, operational requirements, and evolving technology needs.
  • Support other Contract Managers and account teams on complex transactions and commercial matters as business priorities require.

5. Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Identify opportunities to improve contract management processes, commercial governance, and operational efficiency.
  • Embrace innovative approaches to contract and legal service delivery, leveraging digital tools, automation, and technology.
  • Promote consistency, transparency, and best practices across contract management activities.
  • Contribute to the development and adoption of scalable contract management processes and reporting solutions.
  • Stay informed about evolving technology trends, industry developments, regulatory requirements, and commercial contracting practices.

What You'll Bring

Education & Experience


  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Legal Studies, Finance, or a related discipline, or equivalent regional education.
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or other advanced legal qualification is a plus.
  • 8+ years of experience in commercial contract management, contract drafting, review, and negotiation.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex commercial agreements, preferably within technology services, IT consulting, managed services, or outsourcing environments.
  • Experience supporting large-scale commercial transactions and working with cross-functional business teams.

Commercial & Contractual Expertise

  • Strong knowledge of commercial contracting principles, contract structures, terms and conditions, and negotiation strategies.
  • Ability to interpret complex contractual provisions and translate them into practical business guidance.
  • Experience identifying, assessing, and mitigating commercial, financial, and contractual risks.
  • Understanding of commercial finance principles, including pricing, profitability, margin optimization, and financial exposure.
  • Familiarity with technology services agreements, outsourcing contracts, consulting engagements, and service delivery models.
  • Knowledge of contract governance, lifecycle management, and corporate approval processes.

Leadership & Business Acumen

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior business leaders, customers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong negotiation, influencing, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to balance commercial priorities, customer expectations, and risk management considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex agreements and competing priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented approach with the ability to work independently and collaboratively across a matrixed organization.
  • Adaptability and willingness to embrace new technologies and innovative ways of working.

Why Join DXC Technology?

At DXC, you will have the opportunity to:


  • Influence strategic business decisions: Partner with senior leaders on complex commercial transactions and business opportunities.
  • Work across global industries: Support diverse technology and outsourcing engagements across multiple sectors.
  • Drive commercial value: Help protect business interests, manage contractual risks, and optimize profitability.
  • Collaborate with global teams: Work alongside experienced professionals across Sales, Legal, Finance, and Delivery.
  • Shape the future of contract management: Leverage technology, innovation, and process improvement to transform commercial operations.

Bring your commercial expertise and strategic mindset to DXC Technology. Help us create stronger partnerships, smarter agreements, and sustainable business value.

Compensation at DXC is influenced by an array of factors, including but not limited to the experience, job-related knowledge, skills, competencies, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. A reasonable estimate of the current compensation range for this position is $95,900 - $178,100.

Full-time hires are eligible to participate in the DXC benefit program. DXC offers a comprehensive, flexible, and competitive benefits program which includes, but is not limited to, health, dental, and vision insurance coverage; employee wellness; life and disability insurance; a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, paid time off.

Schedule Requirements: Typical business hours Monday through Friday with availability to work on the weekends per needs of the business.

Location: Remote within the U.S.; preference for candidates based in Texas or Florida

Everyone is welcome here. Each of us is unique, and that’s what makes us amazing. We believe in inclusiveness and celebrating each person’s individuality, because there’s power in bringing people with different points of view and life experiences together. That’s why we provide equal employment opportunities (EEO). All applicants are considered regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or sexual orientation.

So, bring yourself and your best ideas; when we feel safe and comfortable being ourselves, there’s no limit to what we can achieve.

IN A NUTSHELL…

This is a high-impact, remote role reporting to and primarily supporting the President at Parallel, with some support to the Senior Leadership Team (SLT). As an Executive Assistant & Special Projects Manager to the Senior Leadership Team (SLT), you will combine executive-level administrative support with strategic project management to drive alignment, operating rigor, and execution across the enterprise.

The ideal candidate acts as a central connector between the President and the SLT —enabling prioritization, driving operating cadence, and ensuring key initiatives move forward with clarity and accountability. This role requires strong business acumen, exceptional organization, and the ability to operate seamlessly between tactical execution and strategic support.

Parallel is one of the multi-state cannabis companies, owning and operating in three markets; Florida (Surterra Wellness), Massachusetts (NETA), and Texas (Goodblend). If you enjoy companies that are growing, moving fast, and constantly challenging themselves to achieve more, then Parallel is for you. We work hard, lean on each other, and are passionate about a pretty ambitious vision … pioneering a new paradigm of what well-being can be for all people, everywhere. For more information, visit .

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

Executive Support to the President, with some SLT Support

  • Provide high-level administrative support primarily to the President, with some support to SLT members, including calendar management, scheduling, and prioritization of time
  • Coordinate and prepare materials for key meetings (ELT, Board, Special Committee, Cross-Functional Leadership Forums)
  • Manage inbound requests and communications, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities
  • Draft, edit, and refine executive communications on behalf of the President, with some support to SLT members
  • Coordinate complex travel, logistics, and executive-level engagements

Operating Cadence & Alignment

  • Own and drive enterprise operating rhythms, including weekly ELT meetings, monthly business reviews, and quarterly planning cycles (IBP)
  • Ensure alignment across functions on priorities, deliverables, and timelines
  • Track key initiatives and follow-ups, holding teams accountable to commitments
  • Support development of executive-level materials (dashboards, one-pagers, board updates)

Special Projects & Strategic Initiatives

  • Lead and execute cross-functional projects on behalf of the President, with some support to the SLT (e.g., organizational transformation, cost optimization, retail performance initiatives)
  • Build and manage project plans, timelines, and stakeholder communication
  • Identify risks, surface insights, and drive solutions in partnership with functional leaders
  • Act as a force multiplier to accelerate execution of priority initiatives

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a central coordination point between President, SLT members, and their teams
  • Ensure clear, concise, and timely communication of decisions, priorities, and updates
  • Support alignment between enterprise functions and state-level teams
  • Maintain a high level of professionalism and confidentiality across all interactions

EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS YOU’LL BRING

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in executive support, consulting, business operations, or project management
  • Experience supporting multiple senior executives or leadership teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to understand financial and operational drivers
  • Exceptional organizational and time management skills with strong attention to detail
  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities and execute with speed and precision
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook) and collaboration tools
  • Ability to use AI tools such as Claude to support drafting, research, organization, and project coordination
  • Experience in highly regulated industries (e.g., cannabis, healthcare, CPG) is a plus
  • Ability to travel domestically as required

LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES

  • Proactive & Solutions-Oriented: Anticipates needs and drives outcomes
  • Highly Discreet: Trusted with sensitive and confidential information
  • Structured & Organized: Brings clarity to complex, fast-moving environments
  • Strong Communicator: Effective across all levels of the organization
  • Execution-Focused: Drives accountability and results across teams

YOU WILL BE SUCCESSFUL IF YOU…

  • Are self-motivated; micro-managing isn’t fun for anyone
  • Roll your sleeves up and do the work; strategy is important, but so is getting stuff done
  • Can work fast and be flexible; our industry is always changing
  • Play nice with others; we collaborate with each other a lot
  • Think creatively; sometimes, the “traditional” solution isn’t the best one

WHAT YOU GET

  • Employee discount
  • Consistent, reliable benefits; Full medical/vision/dental (full time only), 401k enrollment, access to company-sponsored well-being programs
  • Balance and flexibility; paid time off, paid parental leave, flexible work arrangements
  • Pet Insurance

PARALLEL IS UNITED BY OUR VISION, MISSION, & VALUES

Our Vision – why we exist – is to pioneer well-being and improve the quality of life for humanity through the benefits of cannabinoids.

Our Mission – how we will do this – is to build a leading, global well-being company through the best talent, our values, trusted and recognized brands, science and technology-based innovation, and a relentless focus on execution and continuous improvement.

Our Values – Integrity | Collaboration | Alignment | Intentionality | Accountability | Agility

We embrace and encourage our employees’ differences in age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, veteran status, and other characteristics that make our employees unique.

Your employment with Parallel is a voluntary one and is subject to termination by you or Parallel at will, with or without cause, and with or without notice, at any time. Nothing in this document shall be interpreted to be in conflict with or to eliminate or modify in any way the employment-at-will status of Parallel associates.

About CyberOne

CyberOne is a pure-play Microsoft security partner dedicated to helping enterprises realise the full value of the Microsoft Security portfolio—across Defender XDR, Sentinel, Entra, Purview, Intune, Copilot for Security and more. We combine deep technical expertise with outcome-driven services that accelerate secure cloud adoption, modernise threat protection and simplify compliance.

Job Title: Penetration Tester

Location:Remote

Employment Type:Full-time

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Penetration Tester to join our Cyber Security team. The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting advanced penetration testing engagements across enterprise environments, with a particular focus on Active Directory (AD) security assessments. This role requires hands-on experience identifying, exploiting, and documenting security vulnerabilities while providing practical remediation recommendations to strengthen clients' security posture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive penetration testing engagements against enterprise infrastructure, networks, systems, and applications.

  • Perform manual and automated security assessments to identify vulnerabilities, weaknesses, and potential attack vectors.

  • Assess and exploit Active Directory environments, identifying security risks including:

    • Misconfigurations

    • Privilege escalation paths

    • Lateral movement opportunities

    • Credential theft vulnerabilities

    • Excessive permissions and insecure delegation

  • Execute network and system exploitation activities to validate security weaknesses and assess their impact.

  • Evaluate the effectiveness of security controls, hardening measures, and defensive configurations within Active Directory environments.

  • Simulate real-world attack scenarios to assess organizational resilience against cyber threats.

  • Develop detailed technical reports outlining attack paths, findings, business impact, proof-of-concept evidence, and remediation recommendations.

  • Present technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Work closely with internal teams and clients to support remediation efforts and provide security best-practice guidance.

  • Stay up to date with emerging threats, attack techniques, exploitation methodologies, and security technologies.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience conducting penetration tests across enterprise networks and infrastructure.

  • Strong knowledge of Windows environments and Active Directory security.

  • Experience identifying and exploiting Active Directory vulnerabilities and attack paths.

  • Excellent understanding of:

    • Network protocols and architecture

    • Windows Server administration

    • Authentication mechanisms (Kerberos, NTLM)

    • Privilege escalation techniques

    • Lateral movement methodologies

  • Hands-on experience with penetration testing and red team tools such as:

    • BloodHound

    • Mimikatz

    • CrackMapExec

    • Impacket

    • Nmap

    • Burp Suite

    • Metasploit

    • Responder

  • Familiarity with vulnerability assessment and security testing methodologies including OWASP, NIST, and PTES.

  • Strong technical documentation and report-writing skills.

  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP)

  • CRTO (Certified Red Team Operator)

  • CREST Registered Penetration Tester (CRT) or CREST Certified Infrastructure Tester (CCT INF)

  • GIAC Penetration Tester (GPEN)

  • Relevant Microsoft security certifications

  • Experience delivering internal or external client-facing security assessments

raw.description:
About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at

Position Overview

Join Avaya’s Agent Experience team to build the agent desktop for Avaya Infinity, our flagship enterprise omnichannel contact-center platform. The desktop brings together real-time voice and digital interactions, integrated modules, extensions, and CRM capabilities into a reliable agent workspace.

You will deliver features across a React/TypeScript desktop and Go/Rust backend services, applying strong computer science fundamentals to state management, client/server coordination, messaging, and media integration. Our platform serves deployments from small environments to large enterprises, running on Kubernetes across Azure AKS and Google GKE, with on-premises support planned.

We expect hands-on experience with agentic AI development, using tools such as Codex or Cursor to move from rapid prototypes to well-designed, verified production software.

Responsibilities

  • Build features across the agent desktop and supporting services, partnering with product, design, and platform teams.
  • Define where state belongs and how clients and services synchronize, recover from failures, and preserve user work.
  • Design session and media ownership across tabs, browsers, virtual desktops, and embedded clients, preventing conflicting actions.
  • Develop real-time communication and media integrations, selecting appropriate APIs, streaming, and messaging patterns.
  • Build extensibility and CRM integrations with clear contracts for lifecycle, shared context, permissions, and failure isolation.
  • Make observability part of the experience through connection and media health indicators, useful diagnostics, and correlated client/backend telemetry.
  • Deliver accessible, responsive, secure applications with meaningful tests covering critical workflows, concurrency, and recovery.
  • Use AI agents effectively, contribute to architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and support production systems.

Required Experience

  • Computer science fundamentals and first-principles reasoning: strong understanding of concurrency, networking, and distributed systems, with the ability to explain tradeoffs and turn designs into production software.
  • Full-stack delivery: experience building complex, stateful applications across clients and services. Hands-on backend experience, with Go/Rust proficiency or demonstrated ability to become productive quickly.
  • Front-end engineering: strong React, TypeScript, and browser fundamentals, including asynchronous behavior, component architecture, state synchronization, performance, and accessibility.
  • Real-time reliability: experience with persistent connections, concurrent sessions, state ownership, event ordering, idempotency, reconnects, and partial failures.
  • Integration design: experience with APIs, event-driven interfaces, modular applications, authentication and authorization, and working knowledge of databases and caching.
  • Observability and quality: ability to investigate issues across browser, network, and service boundaries using logs, metrics, traces, and automated tests.
  • Cloud delivery: experience with automated build and deployment pipelines, containers, and working familiarity with Kubernetes.
  • Collaboration and ownership: ability to clarify ambiguous requirements, coordinate across teams, and own software through production operation.

Agentic AI Development

  • Prior hands-on experience with coding agents is required, along with the ability to rapidly deepen that capability.
  • Work prompt-first, providing clear requirements, codebase context, architectural constraints, and verification criteria.
  • Choose the right approach for the task: AI pair programming, delegated implementation, multiple agents, or rapid prototyping and spikes.
  • Guide agents through implementation and testing, critically evaluate their output, and rework prototypes into production-grade designs.
  • Own the correctness, security, maintainability, and performance of delivered software, following company policies for AI use.

Preferred Experience

  • Contact-center or other real-time communications applications, including voice and digital interaction workflows.
  • WebRTC and browser media integration, including diagnostics for jitter, packet loss, and latency.
  • Multi-instance coordination, Citrix environments, desktop extensions, client SDKs, or CRM integrations such as Salesforce.
  • Production Go or Rust; WebSockets, SSE, NATS, or comparable messaging technologies.
  • OpenTelemetry, AKS/GKE, and on-premises deployments.

Education

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or Engineering

Pay Transparency

The pay range for this opportunity is from $134,925 to $180,000 + benefits. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary plus bonus for this position. Actual total compensation will vary and is based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and competencies.

Sponsorship and Equal Opportunity

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U.S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic. In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location.

About Fusemachines
Fusemachines is a leading AI strategy, talent, and education services and products provider. Founded by Sameer Maskey Ph.D., Adjunct Associate Professor at Columbia University, Fusemachines has a core mission of democratizing AI. With a presence in 4 countries (Nepal, United States, Canada, and Dominican Republic and more than 450 full-time employees), Fusemachines seeks to bring its global expertise in AI to transform companies around the world.

Type: Remote, Contracted

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer with deep expertise in Tableau, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic data modeling (LookML / Looker, dbt, Omni, or Looker Studio) to join our team. In this role, you will lead critical business intelligence modernization initiatives, reverse-engineering complex reporting logic from legacy dashboards and rebuilding high-performance analytical data models to power executive decision-making.

Job Description

As a Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer, you will work closely with technical leads, product managers, and business stakeholders to modernize legacy BI environments.

You will be responsible for deconstructing legacy dashboard architectures, extracting embedded business rules and Level of Detail (LOD) calculations, and re-architecting those metrics into scalable SQL models and LookML-governed cloud semantic layers.

You will perform as a core data translator, bridging the gap between cloud data warehouses, semantic layers, and client-facing business teams.

Qualification & Experience

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, systems engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or analytics engineering.
  • At least 4 years of hands-on experience using Tableau to design, maintain, and audit complex dashboards and calculated fields.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience coding and maintaining LookML semantic models (views, explores, derived tables) in Looker.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud data warehouses, specifically Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
  • Proven experience delivering BI migration, dashboard refactoring, or semantic data modeling projects.

Required Skills / Competencies

  • Advanced Tableau Engineering: Deep understanding of complex Tableau calculations, parameters, table calculations, and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions (FIXED, INCLUDE, EXCLUDE), with the ability to unpack workbook logic.
  • Cloud Data Warehousing & Advanced SQL: Strong expertise in writing performant, modular SQL (CTEs, window functions) and structuring data within Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
  • Modern Transformations & Modeling: Hands-on experience with dbt for building curated data models and managing transformation workflows.
  • LookML & Modern BI Semantic Layers: Direct, hands-on experience writing LookML (.view and .model files, Explores, Persistent Derived Tables, symmetric aggregates) with Git version control, alongside building curated topics in Omni Analytics or Looker Studio.
  • Data Validation & Quality Assurance: Rigorous approach to data reconciliation, checking data parity between legacy source reporting and modernized target models.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (Full Professional / Advanced) to lead technical discussions, clarify metric definitions, and present solutions directly to stakeholders.
  • Ways of Working: Self-motivated, proactive problem-solver comfortable working independently in an Agile sprint-based environment.

Responsibilities

  • Reverse-Engineer Reporting Logic: Audit and deconstruct legacy Tableau workbooks, deciphering nested formulas, calculated fields, and LOD expressions into clear business documentation.
  • Warehouse Data Modeling: Translate extracted business logic into scalable, maintainable SQL and transformation models using dbt across BigQuery and Snowflake.
  • Semantic Layer Implementation: Architect, write, and maintain LookML semantic models, reusable metrics, and self-service Explores/topics in Looker, Omni Analytics, or Looker Studio.
  • Data Parity & Governance: Implement thorough data validation checks to ensure metrics produced in the modern semantic layer match legacy benchmarks with 100% precision.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with technical teams, data engineers, and business leaders to define canonical KPI definitions and document data dictionaries.
  • Best Practices & Documentation: Establish reusable modeling standards, Git workflows, documentation, and maintainable BI pipelines for long-term platform health.

If you are a senior data practitioner with deep experience across Tableau, LookML, BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic modeling, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Overview:

HealthEdge is seeking a Vice President, Payment Integrity to own the strategy, market positioning, financial performance, and operational execution of payment integrity solutions across the HealthEdge ecosystem. This executive leader will drive the long-term vision and commercialization strategy for payment integrity capabilities, ensuring alignment with enterprise growth objectives, client outcomes, and evolving market demands.

The VP will be accountable for business performance, innovation strategy, external market leadership, and delivery of measurable value across clients and product portfolios for Payment Integrity. This leader will influence investment priorities, shape strategic partnerships, and represent HealthEdge as an industry thought leader with clients, analysts, and industry forums.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Payment Integrity Strategy & Execution

  • Own the end-to-end payment integrity business strategy, operating model, and execution roadmap across the HealthEdge ecosystem
  • Accountable for portfolio performance, business growth, and achievement of financial objectives associated with payment integrity solutions
  • Define and execute a multi-year vision and transformation roadmap for payment integrity capabilities across the HealthEdge platform
  • Drive innovation strategies leveraging AI, analytics, automation, and emerging healthcare technologies
  • Lead business case development and investment strategies for new capabilities, partnerships, and market opportunities
  • Influence pricing, commercialization strategy, and go-to-market alignment for payment integrity offerings

Product & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Establish payment integrity roadmap priorities in alignment with product, technology, and market strategies
  • Serve as the enterprise authority on payment integrity strategy, claims accuracy, payment policy, and cost containment innovation
  • Drive enterprise analytics strategy and insight-driven innovation for payment integrity capabilities in partnership with Data teams
  • Ensure alignment across teams to deliver integrated, client-centric solutions

Client Impact & Value Realization

  • Drive executive-level client engagement strategies to accelerate adoption, value realization, retention, and expansion of payment integrity solutions
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with executive stakeholders across payer organizations and industry partners
  • Serve as HealthEdge’s executive spokesperson and thought leader for payment integrity strategy and innovation
  • Bring forward client insights to inform product development and continuous improvement

Team Leadership & Organizational Effectiveness

Enterprise Leadership & Governance

raw.description:
Are you an experienced Lead Product Designer who can guide a team through the work while building trust and alignment with client stakeholders?

DNA.inc is looking for a Lead Product Designer to help shape several key client engagements in the Spanish market.

This is a player-coach role for someone who remains close to the craft, takes responsibility for the effectiveness of the design team and strengthens client relationships. You will spend roughly half your time working in hands-on design, and the other leading a small team while managing client stakeholders, shaping direction, and creating alignment around what the team should solve and why.

About the job

As a Lead Product Designer at DNA.inc, you’ll join a diverse, multi-disciplinary team of designers, working on a variety of long-term challenges with key clients across multiple business domains.

You will be the senior design presence within each engagement. You will help turn complex, sometimes ambiguous business and product challenges into clear design direction, guide the team toward high-quality outcomes, and represent the work confidently with senior client stakeholders.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will stay actively involved in the work by shaping direction, reviewing and improving design, facilitating key decisions, solving difficult product problems, and stepping directly into execution where your contribution will have the greatest impact.

At the same time, you will own and actively manage key client stakeholders. You will build trust, navigate competing priorities, create alignment, and help stakeholders make good decisions.

As a Lead Product Designer at DNA.inc, we expect you to contribute in these key areas:

Lead the team

  • Provide clear direction across complex product challenges and help the team move from ambiguity to focused execution.

  • Stay close to the craft, contributing directly where your involvement improves the quality or pace of the work.

  • Set and maintain a high bar for interaction, visual design, prototyping, and product thinking.

  • Give designers clear, useful direction while creating enough space for them to own and develop their work.

  • Mentor and develop other designers through active collaboration, feedback, critique, and hands-on problem solving.

  • Identify gaps in how the team works and establish patterns, systems, or practices that improve quality and consistency beyond a single deliverable.

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to balance user needs, business goals, technical constraints, and delivery realities.

Lead the work

  • Act as a trusted partner to key client stakeholders and independently lead important design conversations.

  • Understand the wider business and organizational context behind the brief, and help stakeholders clarify what really needs to be solved.

  • Turn competing priorities, incomplete information, and differing perspectives into a clear path forward.

  • Present recommendations with conviction, adapt your communication to different audiences, and make the reasoning behind design decisions easy to understand.

  • Navigate pushback, organizational complexity, and stakeholder disagreement while maintaining productive relationships.

  • Build confidence in the team and the work through clear communication, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through.

  • Identify opportunities beyond the immediate request and help connect design decisions to broader product and business outcomes.

Strengthen the wider engagement

  • Help strengthen how design operates across the client account, improving the quality and effectiveness of the wider engagement.

  • Work with DNA.inc colleagues across design, product, and engineering to improve the way we deliver together.

  • Share patterns, lessons, and approaches that can strengthen DNA.inc’s wider design practice.

Requirements

About you

We’re looking for someone who is comfortable operating at this level of responsibility, and can show strong evidence of doing so in the Spanish market. We expect you to bring:

  • An extensive track record designing and shipping complex digital products across web and mobile, with strong hands-on visual, interaction, and product design craft.

  • Experience leading a design team while remaining actively involved in the work yourself.

  • Evidence of raising the quality and effectiveness of other designers through your leadership and craft.

  • Experience independently leading client or senior stakeholder relationships in complex organizations.

  • Confidence navigating disagreement, ambiguity, competing priorities, and organizational politics.

  • The ability to frame unclear problems, create strategic direction, and bring stakeholders with you.

  • Strong product development instincts and a track record of working closely with Product and Engineering through build, launch, and iteration.

  • The judgment to know when to step into the detail, when to give direction, and when to let others lead.

  • Professional fluency in Spanish.

  • Clear, concise, and empathetic written and verbal communication in English.

  • Eligibility to work in the European Union without sponsorship or restrictions.

Experience with motion, 3D design, or products beyond web and mobile is a plus, including platforms such as Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Smart TV, set-top boxes, wearables, or game consoles.

Who we are

At DNA.inc, we love building platforms and products that people want to use. We specialize in helping clients envision, build, and launch large-scale software projects in streaming, media, automotive, and other industries. Headquartered in Europe, with offices in Amsterdam, Valencia, and Madrid, we share a passion for working on influential products that captivate global audiences.

By joining DNA.inc, you’ll collaborate daily with seasoned designers, engineers, and executives who have contributed to major streaming services such as Disney+, ESPN+, Eurosport, and SiriusXM.

We combine dedication to our mission with great care for our team. Our people receive the trust and support needed to grow, and engaging projects to learn from. We invest in your professional development through mentorship, learning budgets, conference participation, and a clear long-term growth path — all within a culture that celebrates expertise.

What we offer

  • A position with a dynamic, international digital consultancy

  • Fair compensation, aligned with your experience and regional standards

  • Flexibility in working hours and location

  • Opportunities to learn from and collaborate with accomplished engineers and designers

  • A clear growth path, whether you prefer to deepen your craft or move into leadership

  • Periodic company offsites across Europe

  • Support for your home office setup (hardware, software, etc.)

  • Additional benefits (e.g. pension) vary by country; details available upon request

Compensation

  • Reference location: Valencia, Spain

  • Our mid-point for Lead Product Designer in Valencia: 75K EUR

Please note that DNA.inc is a remote-first organization. A specific range (based on data) for your location will be shared in a first interview. For more information, see Compensation at DNA.inc.

Interested?

If you’re excited about embarking on adventurous missions with DNA.inc and have the skills and experience we’re looking for, we encourage you to apply through the 'Apply' button on our website!

Please note that, to safeguard the quality and integrity of our services, candidates selected for hire will be expected to complete a standard screening process before starting. This includes reference checks, education verification, a credit check, and a criminal background check. When we get to this point, we will set up these checks on your behalf and happily guide you through the process.

For any questions or further information, feel free to reach out to 'recruitment at DNA.inc'. Please, no recruiters.
