raw.description:
Are you an experienced Lead Product Designer who can guide a team through the work while building trust and alignment with client stakeholders?

DNA.inc is looking for a Lead Product Designer to help shape several key client engagements in the Spanish market.

This is a player-coach role for someone who remains close to the craft, takes responsibility for the effectiveness of the design team and strengthens client relationships. You will spend roughly half your time working in hands-on design, and the other leading a small team while managing client stakeholders, shaping direction, and creating alignment around what the team should solve and why.

About the job

As a Lead Product Designer at DNA.inc, you’ll join a diverse, multi-disciplinary team of designers, working on a variety of long-term challenges with key clients across multiple business domains.

You will be the senior design presence within each engagement. You will help turn complex, sometimes ambiguous business and product challenges into clear design direction, guide the team toward high-quality outcomes, and represent the work confidently with senior client stakeholders.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will stay actively involved in the work by shaping direction, reviewing and improving design, facilitating key decisions, solving difficult product problems, and stepping directly into execution where your contribution will have the greatest impact.

At the same time, you will own and actively manage key client stakeholders. You will build trust, navigate competing priorities, create alignment, and help stakeholders make good decisions.

As a Lead Product Designer at DNA.inc, we expect you to contribute in these key areas:

Lead the team

  • Provide clear direction across complex product challenges and help the team move from ambiguity to focused execution.

  • Stay close to the craft, contributing directly where your involvement improves the quality or pace of the work.

  • Set and maintain a high bar for interaction, visual design, prototyping, and product thinking.

  • Give designers clear, useful direction while creating enough space for them to own and develop their work.

  • Mentor and develop other designers through active collaboration, feedback, critique, and hands-on problem solving.

  • Identify gaps in how the team works and establish patterns, systems, or practices that improve quality and consistency beyond a single deliverable.

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to balance user needs, business goals, technical constraints, and delivery realities.

Lead the work

  • Act as a trusted partner to key client stakeholders and independently lead important design conversations.

  • Understand the wider business and organizational context behind the brief, and help stakeholders clarify what really needs to be solved.

  • Turn competing priorities, incomplete information, and differing perspectives into a clear path forward.

  • Present recommendations with conviction, adapt your communication to different audiences, and make the reasoning behind design decisions easy to understand.

  • Navigate pushback, organizational complexity, and stakeholder disagreement while maintaining productive relationships.

  • Build confidence in the team and the work through clear communication, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through.

  • Identify opportunities beyond the immediate request and help connect design decisions to broader product and business outcomes.

Strengthen the wider engagement

  • Help strengthen how design operates across the client account, improving the quality and effectiveness of the wider engagement.

  • Work with DNA.inc colleagues across design, product, and engineering to improve the way we deliver together.

  • Share patterns, lessons, and approaches that can strengthen DNA.inc’s wider design practice.

Requirements

About you

We’re looking for someone who is comfortable operating at this level of responsibility, and can show strong evidence of doing so in the Spanish market. We expect you to bring:

  • An extensive track record designing and shipping complex digital products across web and mobile, with strong hands-on visual, interaction, and product design craft.

  • Experience leading a design team while remaining actively involved in the work yourself.

  • Evidence of raising the quality and effectiveness of other designers through your leadership and craft.

  • Experience independently leading client or senior stakeholder relationships in complex organizations.

  • Confidence navigating disagreement, ambiguity, competing priorities, and organizational politics.

  • The ability to frame unclear problems, create strategic direction, and bring stakeholders with you.

  • Strong product development instincts and a track record of working closely with Product and Engineering through build, launch, and iteration.

  • The judgment to know when to step into the detail, when to give direction, and when to let others lead.

  • Professional fluency in Spanish.

  • Clear, concise, and empathetic written and verbal communication in English.

  • Eligibility to work in the European Union without sponsorship or restrictions.

Experience with motion, 3D design, or products beyond web and mobile is a plus, including platforms such as Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Smart TV, set-top boxes, wearables, or game consoles.

Who we are

At DNA.inc, we love building platforms and products that people want to use. We specialize in helping clients envision, build, and launch large-scale software projects in streaming, media, automotive, and other industries. Headquartered in Europe, with offices in Amsterdam, Valencia, and Madrid, we share a passion for working on influential products that captivate global audiences.

By joining DNA.inc, you’ll collaborate daily with seasoned designers, engineers, and executives who have contributed to major streaming services such as Disney+, ESPN+, Eurosport, and SiriusXM.

We combine dedication to our mission with great care for our team. Our people receive the trust and support needed to grow, and engaging projects to learn from. We invest in your professional development through mentorship, learning budgets, conference participation, and a clear long-term growth path — all within a culture that celebrates expertise.

What we offer

  • A position with a dynamic, international digital consultancy

  • Fair compensation, aligned with your experience and regional standards

  • Flexibility in working hours and location

  • Opportunities to learn from and collaborate with accomplished engineers and designers

  • A clear growth path, whether you prefer to deepen your craft or move into leadership

  • Periodic company offsites across Europe

  • Support for your home office setup (hardware, software, etc.)

  • Additional benefits (e.g. pension) vary by country; details available upon request

Compensation

  • Reference location: Valencia, Spain

  • Our mid-point for Lead Product Designer in Valencia: 75K EUR

Please note that DNA.inc is a remote-first organization. A specific range (based on data) for your location will be shared in a first interview. For more information, see Compensation at DNA.inc.

Interested?

If you’re excited about embarking on adventurous missions with DNA.inc and have the skills and experience we’re looking for, we encourage you to apply through the 'Apply' button on our website!

Please note that, to safeguard the quality and integrity of our services, candidates selected for hire will be expected to complete a standard screening process before starting. This includes reference checks, education verification, a credit check, and a criminal background check. When we get to this point, we will set up these checks on your behalf and happily guide you through the process.

For any questions or further information, feel free to reach out to 'recruitment at DNA.inc'. Please, no recruiters.

Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, milestones, resources, dependencies, and deliverables.

Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure DevOps (ADO), particularly Boards, Backlogs, Queries, Dashboards, Sprints, and work-item management.

Demonstrated experience delivering complex application, cloud, data, integration, or digital transformation initiatives.

Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.

Experience managing RAID items, project plans, milestones, dependencies, financials, and executive reporting.

Strong understanding of the end-to-end SDLC.

Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, communication, and presentation skills.

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams and coordinate cross-functional technical teams.

PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or SAFe certification.

Experience working with Microsoft Azure, cloud modernization, DevOps, CI/CD, or data platforms.

Experience with enterprise-scale programs involving multiple system integrators and technology vendors.

Experience integrating ADO reporting with Power BI or other executive reporting tools.

Previous consulting or public-sector delivery experience is an asset.

Work With Us

At PLATO, we believe that great work happens when people feel supported, connected, and challenged in the right ways. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where experienced professionals share knowledge, mentor others, and contribute to solving complex, real‑world client projects.

We are committed to inclusive hiring practices and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including women, persons with disabilities, visible minorities, and Indigenous peoples. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, we’re here to support you.

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

As the Senior Customer Success Operations Manager, you'll play a critical role in building and scaling the operational infrastructure that supports Chainguard's post-sales organization, including Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Customer Support, and Renewals.

You'll serve as a strategic partner to Customer Success leadership, translating business priorities into scalable processes, systems, and performance frameworks that improve customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and revenue retention.

This role requires someone who can think strategically, influence cross-functional decisions, and drive complex initiatives from strategy through execution. You'll help shape how we operate as we scale, with a focus on automation, data-driven decision-making, and delivering a consistent, customer-centric experience.

What you'll do:

Customer Success Operations Strategy & Execution

  • Own and execute the Customer Success Operations roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and scalability.
  • Partner with CS leadership to translate organizational priorities into measurable operating plans, processes, and performance expectations.
  • Support capacity planning, resource allocation, and productivity modeling across Customer Success, Professional Services, and Support.
  • Identify operational gaps and lead cross-functional initiatives that improve how our post-sales teams operate.

Systems Strategy & Operational Infrastructure

  • Own the strategy, implementation, and optimization of our Customer Success technology ecosystem, ensuring systems support business needs as we scale.
  • Partner with Business Systems and IT to drive integrations, automation, and data integrity across Salesforce, CS platforms, support systems, and product analytics tools.
  • Establish scalable processes and workflows that reduce manual effort and improve visibility across the customer lifecycle.
  • Evaluate and recommend tools and technology investments that improve operational efficiency and the customer experience.

Renewals Strategy & Operations

  • Lead the operational implementation of our Renewals function, including forecasting processes, quota tracking, performance measurement, and renewal workflows.
  • Establish reporting and analytics around renewal attainment, gross revenue retention (GRR), net revenue retention (NRR), churn, and contraction.
  • Partner with CS, Sales, and Finance to improve renewal predictability, identify retention risks, and establish clear accountability for revenue outcomes.
  • Develop scalable processes for renewal engagement, risk identification, escalation, and cross-functional coordination.

Performance Measurement & Business Insights

  • Establish KPIs, reporting frameworks, and executive dashboards that measure customer outcomes, retention, and operational productivity.
  • Analyze performance trends and translate insights into actionable recommendations for leadership.
  • Drive consistent business reviews and operating cadences to evaluate performance, identify risks, and prioritize improvements.
  • Support annual planning through data analysis, productivity benchmarks, and operational recommendations.

Process Optimization & Customer Experience

  • Design and implement scalable processes across onboarding, adoption, customer engagement, renewals, and support.
  • Establish operational playbooks, service-level expectations, and accountability frameworks that improve consistency and execution.
  • Partner cross-functionally to identify friction points in the customer journey and implement improvements that drive customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Lead change management, enablement, and adoption for new processes, systems, and initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of Customer Success operating models, SaaS retention metrics, renewal forecasting, and customer lifecycle management.
  • Experience building and scaling operational processes, systems, and performance measurement frameworks.
  • Deep Salesforce expertise and experience working with CS platforms, support systems such as Zendesk, and product analytics tools.
  • Strong analytical capabilities, including forecasting, financial modeling, performance reporting, and translating data into business recommendations.
  • Experience partnering with senior leadership across Customer Success, Finance, Sales, and Business Systems.
  • Ability to independently identify business challenges, develop solutions, and influence decisions across functions.

Base salary: $140,000-$165,000.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About The Role

Salesforce is seeking a Hyperscaler Partner Sales Manager with the ambition, experience, and agility to accelerate co-selling with our most strategic technology partners across Retail and Consumer Goods with our hyperscaler partners. This individual will be measured based upon the ability to drive incremental ACV and Agentforce adoption via co-sell motions with Salesforce's top strategic hyperscaler partners including AWS and Google.

Hyperscaler co-sell is one of the largest growth levers for Salesforce to capture new pipeline from new and existing customers. Our extensive partner ecosystem needs a leader that can drive the success of our largest mutual customers by making it easier to buy and build across our joint partner solutions. This role is responsible for the continued expansion and adoption of the AWS Marketplace within Retail and Consumer Goods in AMER, as well as playing a leading role in our launch of Google Marketplace.

Success in this role will be determined by the ability to deliver incremental Salesforce ACV while driving adoption of partner solutions with Agentforce.

raw.title: Executive Assistant
raw.excerpt: We are looking for a highly capable Executive Assistant to provide high-level administrative and operational support to senior executives.
raw.description:
We are looking for a highly capable Executive Assistant to provide high-level administrative and operational support to senior executives.

We are supporting an investment and venture-building firm behind a diverse portfolio of emerging and established brands across sports, entertainment, and consumer markets. This is a high-trust role supporting senior leadership, with responsibilities expected to include calendar and travel management, coordination with internal and external stakeholders, meeting preparation and follow-up, research, communications, and broader executive support in a fast-paced, high-profile environment.

This is not a traditional admin role focused primarily on ad hoc tasks. We are looking for professionals who are comfortable working directly with executives, managing competing priorities, anticipating needs, protecting confidential information, and taking ownership of tasks and processes from start to finish.

The ideal candidate is proactive, highly organized, resourceful, and capable of working with minimal supervision. You should be someone who can identify what needs to be done, determine the best way to accomplish it, and follow through without needing constant direction.

Estimated Salary: The salary for this position has not been finalized yet. Please indicate your expected salary based on your experience in the application form, and we will consider it in our discussions.

Responsibilities:

Executive Support

  • Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to senior executives.
  • Manage complex calendars, schedules, appointments, and competing priorities.
  • Coordinate meetings, calls, and virtual appointments across multiple time zones, including Zoom meetings.
  • Help executives start each day organized and prepared by reviewing the calendar, highlighting key meetings, and proactively flagging new people, companies, or priorities that may require additional preparation.
  • Conduct advanced research on new contacts, companies, meeting participants, and relevant preferences or background information to help executives prepare effectively.
  • Prepare meeting agendas, briefing materials, presentations, and other executive documents.
  • Assist with PowerPoint presentation cleanup, formatting, and basic editing.
  • Take meeting notes, track action items, and follow up to ensure commitments are completed.
  • Manage executive correspondence, communications, and follow-ups through email, iMessage, and other communication channels as needed.
  • Help executives stay organized, prepared, and focused on high-priority activities.

Proactive Administrative & Operational Support

  • Anticipate executives' needs and proactively address issues before they become problems.
  • Own administrative processes and projects from initiation through completion.
  • Research information, gather options, make recommendations, and present findings clearly.
  • Conduct basic company and background research to support meetings, decision-making, and executive preparation.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, clients, vendors, and external stakeholders.
  • Follow up on outstanding tasks and ensure deadlines are met.
  • Develop and maintain systems, trackers, SOPs, and organizational processes that improve efficiency.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline repetitive administrative tasks and improve workflows.
  • Exercise sound judgment when determining what requires immediate attention, what can wait, and when an executive needs to be contacted or reminded—particularly when the executive is unavailable.
  • Take ownership of resolving routine issues independently and escalate matters appropriately when executive input is genuinely required.

Travel & Logistics

  • Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, transportation, and itineraries.
  • Prepare detailed travel itineraries and supporting information.
  • Assist with business and personal travel planning, including vacation planning, as needed.
  • Assist with meeting, event, and off-site logistics.
  • Handle last-minute changes and troubleshoot logistical issues as they arise.
  • Coordinate travel and logistics approximately 2–3 times per month, with the flexibility to accommodate changing needs.

Communication & Coordination

  • Draft and proofread professional emails, documents, presentations, and other correspondence.
  • Communicate professionally with executives, clients, partners, vendors, and other stakeholders.
  • Represent executives professionally when coordinating schedules, meetings, and requests.
  • Manage sensitive information and maintain a high level of discretion and confidentiality.
  • Use strong written and verbal communication skills to ensure information is communicated clearly and efficiently.

General Executive & Administrative Support

  • Assist with special projects and executive-level initiatives.
  • Conduct online research and prepare summaries, reports, or recommendations.
  • Maintain organized digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Support expense management, including receipt collection, tracking, and reconciliation through Ramp or similar expense-management software.
  • Support basic reporting and administrative coordination where required.
  • Take on other responsibilities that support the effectiveness and productivity of the executive team.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in executive assistance, virtual assistance, administrative support, operations coordination, or a similar role.
  • Previous experience supporting executives, founders, business owners, directors, or senior leaders is strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience working as a Virtual Assistant, Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Executive Administrative Assistant, or similar high-level administrative professional.
  • Strong experience managing calendars, schedules, meetings, correspondence, and executive priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities without becoming overwhelmed.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to determine what requires immediate attention versus what can wait.
  • Highly proactive and resourceful; able to work independently without needing step-by-step instructions.
  • Comfortable researching unfamiliar topics , companies, and individuals and figuring out solutions independently.
  • Strong follow-through and accountability—you don't need to be repeatedly reminded to complete tasks.
  • High level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.
  • Strong proficiency with common productivity and collaboration tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Zoom, Slack, iMessage, project management platforms, and similar tools.
  • Comfortable working with international teams and across different time zones.
  • Comfortable coordinating domestic and international travel and adapting to changing priorities throughout the day.

The Ideal Candidate

You will thrive in this role if you:

  • Think ahead rather than simply react to requests.
  • Can take a broad instruction and turn it into a completed outcome.
  • Are comfortable saying, "I've already taken care of it."
  • Naturally keep track of details, deadlines, and follow-ups.
  • Can manage several executives' priorities without losing sight of the bigger picture.
  • Are resourceful and know how to find answers rather than waiting for someone else to provide them.
  • Have strong business judgment and know when to act independently and when to escalate.
  • Can distinguish between a true priority and something that can reasonably wait.
  • Are comfortable making judgment calls when an executive is unavailable and know when something is important enough to interrupt or follow up.
  • Are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and changing priorities.
  • Take ownership of your work and treat the executive's time as highly valuable.
  • Are dependable, discreet, polished, and professional in all interactions.
  • Naturally prepare ahead of meetings by understanding who the executive is meeting, why the meeting matters, and what background may be useful.

Qualifications That Are a Plus

  • Experience supporting C-suite executives, founders, entrepreneurs, or senior leadership.
  • Experience working with international clients or companies.
  • Experience supporting executives based in the US or other international markets.
  • Experience managing multiple executives or stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Experience with project management or operations coordination.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Notion, Airtable, HubSpot, Ramp, or similar platforms.
  • Experience creating SOPs, workflows, systems, and process documentation.
  • Experience coordinating travel, events, or complex business logistics.
  • Experience with presentation preparation and PowerPoint formatting/editing.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within the first few months, a successful Executive Administrative Assistant should be able to:
  • Become a reliable extension of the executive they support.
  • Start each day with a clear understanding of the executive's schedule, priorities, and upcoming needs.
  • Manage recurring administrative responsibilities with minimal supervision.
  • Keep calendars, meetings, communications, travel, and follow-ups organized.
  • Proactively research new people, companies, and meetings so the executive is prepared in advance.
  • Anticipate upcoming needs and proactively prepare for them.
  • Take ownership of projects and administrative processes rather than simply completing individual tasks.
  • Make sound judgment calls about priorities and know when to act independently versus when to escalate.
  • Resolve routine issues without unnecessary executive involvement.
  • Reduce the executive's administrative workload and allow them to focus more time on strategic priorities.
  • Build trust through consistency, discretion, sound judgment, responsiveness, and strong follow-through.

Benefits

  • Food Allowance
  • Government Benefits
  • 13th Month pay
  • Work Equipment
  • Night Differential if applicable (10% of hourly rate)
  • 20 Leaves (after 6 months)
  • Holiday pay (200% on Regular holidays; 130% on Special holidays)
  • Overtime pay (max of 10.25 hrs/day)
  • Referral bonus (P10,000 if referral passed and stayed with the company for 3 months)
  • HMO (after 6 months)

Overview:

The Manager, Revenue Accounting will own the accounting for the revenue and billing functions within HealthEdge’s Finance & Accounting team.

About Centers of Excellence:

Centers of Excellence (COE) are teams whose primary goal is to provide expertise in a specific field. COEs will usually provide support through training, research, and skilled leaders. In the case of HealthEdge, our Centers of Excellence incorporate the Human Resources, IT, Legal and Financial fields, all of which provide support to our Product divisions and allows the enterprise to move forward and achieve its goals.

What you will do:

  • Own the accounting and transaction recording for SaaS and on-prem software licenses under revenue recognition (ASC 606) including deferred revenue and contract assets
  • Interpret new customer license agreements, SOWs and amendments to track and apply appropriate billing and revenue recognition schedules
  • Reconcile commissions on new deals, and apply the proper accounting treatment
  • Report monthly revenue results to FP&A team and assist with revenue forecasting
  • Serve as contract for the Company's external auditors and consultants to ensure compliance with accounting standards and Company policies
  • Work towards scaling, automation and continuous improvement of AR and revenue processes
  • Will manage a team of 4

What you bring:

  • 4-6 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting
  • CPA
  • Deep working operational knowledge of ASC 606 for SaaS companies, and billing/collections experience
  • Managerial experience preferred
  • Experience with NetSuite/OpenAir preferred

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

Final compensation will be determined during the interview process and is based on a combination of factors including, but not limited to, your skills, experience, qualifications and education.

raw.excerpt: GROW WITH US: Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience.
raw.description:
GROW WITH US:
Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.

STAY AWESOME:
Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

The Sr. Treasury Manager is responsible for managing treasury activities that support liquidity, cash visibility, investment oversight, and financial risk management. Reporting to the Director, Finance, the role leads cash forecasting and treasury reporting, FX hedging, and improves treasury processes and controls. The role partners with Accounting, FP&A, Tax, and other business functions to support operational funding needs and the continued development of the treasury function.

The Sr. Treasury Manager at Tandem also:


  • Manages cash positioning and liquidity monitoring, including visibility into cash balances and funding requirements across bank accounts and entities; recommend transfers and other actions within approved authorities.
  • Leads short- and long-term cash flow forecasting in partnership with FP&A, Accounting, Tax, and business stakeholders; assess funding needs, evaluate scenarios, and explain actual-to-forecast variances.
  • Manages day-to-day banking relationships and coordinates account administration, banking documentation, and service reviews; support account structures that improve cash visibility and operational efficiency.
  • Prepares treasury reporting and presentations for senior management and supports Board and committee materials, covering liquidity, investments, banking, and foreign exchange exposures and activities.
  • Supports oversight of external investment managers and portfolio reporting; monitor liquidity, maturities, performance, and adherence to approved investment policies, escalating exceptions to treasury leadership.
  • Supports foreign exchange exposure forecasting, hedge analysis, competitive pricing, and execution and settlement coordination under approved policies and delegated authorities; maintain hedge records and partner with Accounting on reporting requirements.
  • Improves and automates cash forecasting, treasury reporting, and banking processes; support systems enhancements and scalable processes as the treasury function develops.
  • Maintains accurate and consistent treasury data and documented controls; support bank access reviews, segregation of duties, payment controls, policy compliance, and audit requests in partnership with Accounting and other control owners.
  • Partners with Tax and Accounting on intercompany funding, cash repatriation, cash pooling, and treasury requirements for new entities; support financing analyses and special projects as assigned.

WHEN & WHERE YOU’LL WORK:

Remote: This position is fully remote and open to candidates within the United States. Equipment for the role will be provided and training will occur virtually.


Travel: This role will require car and air travel up to 10%of time

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, accounting, or finance or equivalent combination of education and applicable job experience.
  • 8 years related treasury experience with a minimum of 5 years of experience in a corporate treasury role at a global company, with exposure to cash management, cash forecasting, FX hedging, and investment management.
  • Knowledge of corporate treasury operations, cash management, cash flow forecasting, banking platforms, and financial reporting systems
  • Excellent analytical, management, and organizational skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills and flexibility to function in a dynamic and innovative environment.
  • Advanced Excel skills for cash forecasting and treasury analysis, with the ability to use Word and PowerPoint effectively for documentation, reporting, and presentations.
  • Strong leadership skills, including ability to work effectively with all levels throughout the organization and across functional lines.
  • High level of intellectual curiosity.
  • Ability to think strategically and communicate effectively across all levels of the organization.
  • Proven track record of reliable, detailed and accurate work product.
  • Ability to analyze large financial data sets, evaluate cash flow drivers and financial exposures, and communicate actionable treasury insights.
  • Flexibility to adjust to fluctuations in workload based upon changing priorities.
  • Working knowledge of liquidity management, investment portfolio reporting, foreign exchange exposures and hedging processes, and treasury policies and internal controls.
  • Skilled at effectively communicating department or area issues and results within and across functional areas and conducting presentations of technical information concerning specific projects or timelines. Able to gain cooperation of others.
  • Skilled at effectively leading a cooperative team effort and organizing resources to achieve team goals. Able to make and prioritize process and resource decisions based on overall team needs.

EXTRA AWESOME:

  • Relevant professional qualification (CTP, ACT, CFA), preferred.
  • Experience using treasury management systems; experience with implementation of treasury preferred.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

The starting base pay range for this position is $120,000 - $150,000 annually. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes bonus and a robust benefits package.


Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!


YOU SHOULD KNOW:

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information.


Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.


SPONSORSHIP: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:
At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at .

BE YOU, WITH US!

We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.

Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

REFERRALS:
We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!

APPLICATION DEADLINE:
The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.

Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow.

  • Technical Mentorship & Pairing: Act as a core technical anchor. Enable customer developers through architectural guidance, pairing on complex production logic, and building "spikes" (proofs of concept) that the customer then owns and scales.
  • Rapid Adaptability: Quickly grasp unfamiliar customer architectures, business domains, and codebases, providing immediate, collaborative technical direction and troubleshooting.

2. Guiding Production Success (AI & Systems Engineering)
  • Agentic Strategy: Guide customers in architecting logic systems using multi-agent LLM interactions, focusing on context engineering, semantic data, and dynamic orchestration.
  • System Hardening: Provide the technical expertise needed for customers to harden their own environments, helping them build policy ladders with extensive guardrails and mitigated deployment risks.
  • Deployment Excellence: Ensure customer applications are resilient, production-ready, and scalable. You provide the tools, SRE best practices, and systems knowledge required for a safe, repeatable path to production.
  • SRE & DevOps Guidance: Advise on environment setup and container orchestration to ensure backend stability and reliability once live.

3. Strategic Partnership
  • Customer Voice: Serve as a bidirectional bridge between the customer and Akka's internal Product and Engineering teams to influence the roadmap based on real-world engineering friction points.
  • Ongoing Growth: Host interactive "Office Hours" and recurring architectural reviews to help the customer's system safely evolve.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Agentic AI & Logic Systems Expertise: Deep, hands-on proficiency in constructing complex logic systems using LLMs and multi-agent frameworks. You must be highly skilled in context engineering, managing semantic data, designing dynamic orchestration flows, and implementing multi-agent interactions.
  • AI Safety, Guardrails, & Evaluation: Strong background in building enterprise-grade policy ladders and implementing robust guardrails to ensure agentic behavior remains predictable and safe. Experience building AI test suites for continuous evaluation and model performance measurement is highly desired.
  • Elite Communication & Client Polish: You must possess native-level English verbal and written fluency. You can confidently lead technical presentations, command a room of enterprise engineers, and translate complex concepts into clear, structured discussions.
  • Hyper-Fast Technical Adaptability: A voracious learner who thrives in ambiguity. You have a proven track record of picking up new languages, frameworks, and cutting-edge AI paradigms in days, not weeks, and can confidently write code and build prototypes within them.
  • The "Teacher" Mindset: A background in technical enablement, developer relations, technical consulting, or engineering mentorship. You genuinely enjoy teaching, public speaking, and pairing with other developers to solve problems.
  • Distributed Computing Foundation: Solid experience in distributed architecture and functional programming concepts. Specific hands-on experience with Akka (Clustering, Persistence, and Streams) is highly desirable.
  • JVM Proficiency: Strong professional understanding of Java or other JVM-based languages.
  • Cloud-Native & SRE Awareness: Understanding of application deployment and container orchestration, particularly Kubernetes, to help customers achieve a safe, repeatable path to production. Experience operating within or migrating workloads to VeloceDB framework environments is heavily prioritized.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning.
  • Flexible remote working environment.
  • Collaborative, inclusive, and innovative company culture.
  • A transparent, distributed work environment with a strong focus on work-life balance.
  • Challenging work that interacts with innovative applications used by millions.
  • A collaborative culture that attracts the "brightest minds" in the technology community.

raw.excerpt: Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, and technology to make a mark on our communities - our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors.
raw.description:
Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, and technology to make a mark on our communities - our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors. We believe in relentlessly pursuing (and sharing) the truth – bringing together millions of data points from quantitative and qualitative sources to base our decisions on. Our purpose is to unlock potential for our communities mentioned above. Our vision is a world where it’s easy to do the right thing throughout those communities. If you’re ready to uplift others, challenge your ego, commit to the truth, and be better than yesterday – keep reading.
Seer is a remote first agency and Certified B-Corp with team members working across the country. If an office environment is more your style, this position can also sit in our HQ office, Philadelphia. We can only consider candidates based in the US who are able to work continental US based hours.
The Role: You, the Team Lead, SEO + GEO, will own a portfolio of $800K–$1MM+ and lead a team of 6–8 people. You will operate as the executive-level SEO/GEO voice across your book of business — owning the C-suite relationship, proving long-term ROI to senior stakeholders, and ensuring the account team is running toward the right goals — while also directly managing, developing, and holding your team accountable to Seer's quality bar. You'll be both the strategic authority your clients trust and the people leader your team relies on for growth, direction, and support.

You're addicted to growth and development and it shows through the success you create for the people that surround you. Could this be love? Maybe.

Role Highlights

  • You will lead and manage a team of 6–8 people owning onboarding, performance management, coaching, and career development for your direct reports
  • You will be a key player in growing divisional revenue, primarily through retaining your portfolio of clients, with a healthy dose of up-selling and cross-selling when appropriate
  • You will build and maintain strong client relationships rooted in empathy, transparency, and the desire to help them exceed their goals
  • You will own the executive relationship on your accounts, making inroads with CMOs and C-suite stakeholders, translating 5-year SEO and GEO ROI into terms that resonate at the leadership level, and ensuring Seer's strategic value is visible above the account team layer
  • You will actively identify upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities across your portfolio — partnering with Paid Media, Creative, and Client Engagement to bring integrated growth recommendations to clients at the right moment
  • You will be a driving force behind Seer's Organic offering, pushing the SEO + GEO service forward, pressure-testing what's working, and turning emerging AI-search practices into repeatable methodology your team and clients benefit from
  • You will champion AI and innovation as a working discipline, not a buzzword: building AI fluency across your team, piloting new tools and workflows, and sharing what works (and what doesn't) with the broader org
  • You'll set the bar for how Seer wins in organic search, across SEO and GEO, and translate that into direction for your team and account teams rather than executing it yourself. You bring business sense to the portfolio, not just channel expertise
  • You will mentor and coach your direct reports and junior team members, giving them support on their work and investing in their growth
  • You will help define the SEO team of tomorrow, hopping in on sourcing, interviewing, and selecting new members for your team
  • You will drive thought leadership through sharing knowledge about the latest industry trends, tests and trials, both with Seer's clients and the larger digital marketing community

Essential Skills

  • Proven people management experience: you've led a team of comparable size (6–8), and you know how to hire, coach, give hard feedback, and develop people, not just review their work
  • Hands-on SEO + GEO agency experience across Content Strategy, Enterprise SEO, PR, Paid Media, and/or Analytics. You drive integrated strategies, leveraging AI where appropriate to drive efficiencies, measuring the effectiveness (rankings, traffic, conversions, revenue) and always backing up your decisions with data
  • Deep, hands-on GEO experience, you understand how AI Overviews, LLM-powered discovery, and generative search interfaces differ from traditional SEO, and you have tested, implemented, and can teach strategies to improve visibility across both. You see GEO as a growth area for the team, not a side project
  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI as a working tool, you've used AI to change how you or your team operates, and you want to keep pushing that forward, not just adopt what's handed to you
  • Superb client management skills. You drive conversation with C-level executives comfortably, educating and empowering those who don't "get" digital, while always connecting tactics to business goals
  • Strong conflict resolution skills, shown through your ability to diffuse high-intensity situations for both clients and team members
  • Experience navigating client organizations at the C-suite level, making inroads with CMOs, framing SEO and GEO impact in business terms (revenue, pipeline, lifetime value), and earning the trust of senior stakeholders who may have limited digital marketing context
  • Consistent track record in seeing opportunities for account growth and driving increased revenue

90 Day Goals

  • By Day 30: you will have completed division training, met 1:1 with each member of your team, and begun to support at least 2–4 impactful client initiatives
  • By Day 60: you will be up and running at full capacity, supporting a full book of business and a full team, with regular cadences (1:1s, team syncs) in place
  • By Day 90: you will be ready to expand your portfolio by kicking off 1–2 new clients, and will have identified at least one GEO or AI-driven initiative to roll out across your team

This might not be the right role for you if

  • Time-management, context-switching, and juggling multiple projects is quite challenging
  • You do not want continued-learning and innovation to be an expectation
  • Change management is difficult and you struggle with adapting to new tools and processes
  • You'd rather stay in individual-contributor mode than take on direct people-management responsibility
  • You’re uncomfortable in high stakes client-facing interactions, especially those that require you to think on your feet
  • You have difficulty giving critic and feedback to those around you
Have questions about recruitment at Seer? Check out our Custom GPT: Guide to Talent Acquisition at Seerto drop in your questions! You can ask it anything about our hiring process, and how to best prepare for an interview with us.
As a B-Corp Certified organization, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
Not ready to apply but want to keep in touch? Stay connected via our monthly Career Update newsletter! We'll share curated content on Seer, open roles, industry insights, career advice, events you don't want to miss, and more (so you never miss a beat).

raw.description:
Join us on a journey of endless possibilities

At Strada, possibility isn’t just a promise – it’s the foundation of everything we do. We believe in unlocking potential for every colleague, creating a journey of growth, discovery, and impact.


With the support, resources, and opportunities we provide, you’ll build a fulfilling future – working on meaningful projects that span industries and regions, contributing to outcomes that matter.


Strada is a people, payroll, and technology leader simplifying international workforce management. Operating in 180+ countries, we design and deliver people-first solutions powered by cloud-based technology – helping organizations grow and enabling workforces to perform at their best.


Learn more at


Strada is currently recruiting for a Workday Benefits Consultant (AMS/post production). We have an ever-expanding business pipeline and are seeking suitably skilled and interested candidates to help us build our practice in line with the growth of the Workday ecosystem.

As a Workday Benefits Functional Consultant, you will play a key role as part of an industry-leading team, helping to drive results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions.


The Workday Project Manager (PM) will be directly responsible for overseeing all stages of the project and project delivery. The responsibilities include assembling project teams, assigning individual responsibilities and enforcing accountability, developing and maintaining a budget and schedule to ensure timely completion of project, maintaining standard project management documentation and metrics with limited direction, working directly with internal and external client counterparts, other project leads, and ongoing operations to deliver successful implementation, and managing the scope of the project. The Workday Project Manager will also be responsible for promoting team engagement and building and maintaining a successful relationship with the client.


Manage Project Scope and Delivery


  • Leads ME/Launch, Phase X, or smaller LE (under 15k Employees) projects.
  • May participate in sales opportunities and process.
  • Acts as a coach or buddy for Associate PM or a PM.
  • Participates in building the practice initiatives.
  • Manages Workday implementations through all life cycles stages.
  • Work with the Client PM to develop the project plan and project charter, including procedures for managing Actions, Risks and Issues throughout the project.
  • Communicate Project Plan: ensure a common understanding by setting expectations regarding the project plan to align the stakeholders and team members. Implement approved actions and workarounds to mitigate project risks in order to minimize the impact on the project.
  • Execute Project Plan: execute the tasks as defined in the project plan in order to achieve the project goals.
  • Monitor and Control Project Work: measure project performance using appropriate tools and techniques to monitor and report on the progress of the project against plan and budget, identify and quantify variances, perform required corrective actions, and communicate to all stakeholders.
  • Manage Project Scope: manage changes to the project scope, schedule, roles & responsibilities and costs using appropriate verification techniques to keep the project plan and budget accurate, updated, and reflective of authorized changes as defined in the change control procedures; facilitate customer acceptance.
  • Ensure any sign-offs required for the project (e.g. stage and/or milestone sign-offs, design sign-offs, Stage Gate Reviews, Change Order sign-offs etc.) are obtained in a timely manner.
  • Close Contractual Obligations: Formalize final acceptance for the project from the sponsor/customer by ensuring that the delivered product(s) and services comply with the agreed deliverables lists, scope, and any organizational procedures. Ensuring the end of project survey is sent to the client as well as performing a project lessons learned.
  • Communicates: Provides information to others both internal and external to the organization; represents the organization to customers and other external sources.
  • Partnership with Workday: liaise with Workday in terms of the project status updates, Delivery Assurance Checkpoints, product gap reporting and other processes as defined in Workday Deployment Methodology. Set up and maintain Customer Scorecard in the Partner Centre, manage creation and access to Client’s tenants including Customer Central.

Align and Manage Resources and Budget

· Execute Resource Allocation Plan: manage resource allocation proactively by ensuring that appropriate resources and tools are assigned according to the project plan.

· Celebrate, either formally or informally, the accomplishment of goals.

· Engage Others: introduce the Alight project team members to the project. Manage, guide and motivate the Alight project team. Set clear vision, expectations and milestones for the project. Facilitate and enable effective teamwork and collaboration.

· Manage Client billing: with support from a Project Coordinator, ensure that any time spent on the project work gets reported against the right project codes and charged to the client (unless agreed otherwise with the Engagement Executive).

· Monitor and manage project budget and margin, take corrective actions when required.

Contribute to Practice Building

· Contributes to knowledge management capital through activities such as sharing documented lessons learned, documented deliverables, and internal methodology initiatives

· Understands quality standards for own work and monitors and manages work of team members, providing feedback as appropriate.

· Follow Alight Workday Deployment Methodology, suggest improvements and proactively address issues.

Ensure Customer Success

· Client Relationship: establishes and maintains client relationships. Communicates feedback to leadership as appropriate.

· Client Success: in conjunction with project’s Lead Consultants, plan and execute adequate Knowledge Transfer (within SOW scope) to the Client so they can be self-sufficient in administering Workday post go-live. Identify opportunities to introduce the Customer to Alight’s ongoing support offering, if the project is an initial deployment, and other services that may be beneficial for the Customer. If the ongoing support service is purchased, ensure timely completion of handover from the Project to the ongoing support team.

· Measure Customer Satisfaction: measure customer satisfaction at the end of the project by capturing customer feedback using appropriate techniques to gain, maintain, and improve customer long-term relationships.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Experience

Knowledge, Education, Certification, Skills & Technical Proficiencies

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Math, Computer Science, or Finance
  • Proficiency with MS Project
  • Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio
  • Ability to recognize personal skills, abilities, limitations and strengths, taking appropriate action to pursue developmental activities to strengthen skills and experience
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced multinational environment and to adapt to frequent change
  • Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage conflicting priorities
  • Excellent oral and written communications skills
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Commercial acumen – understanding what drives project revenue and profitability. Ability to effectively manage project budgets and forecasting to maximize revenue and profitability.
  • Good understanding of project management processes and techniques – including planning, progress tracking, risk and issue management frameworks, change control frameworks, sign-off procedures
  • If not already certified, must successfully pass Workday HCM and/or Financials Core and PM training classes and retain Workday certification

Preferred

  • Strong interpersonal skills to support team building
  • Ability to advocate a creative atmosphere, facilitate entrepreneurial meetings, and envision a final product and overall market acceptance early in the design and/or development process
  • Ability to develop cooperative relationships to achieve results through a win-win relationship
  • Ability to establish alliances with other departments and organizations by recognizing dependencies
  • Ability to transfer own knowledge to more junior colleagues and coach others
  • Ability to provide best practice advice to help clients put in place an effective project structure and governance framework
  • Ability to modify project deployment approach to cater for client specific requirements and constraints in a way that also caters for Alight business needs as well as Workday Delivery Assurance requirements
  • General understanding of Workday’s functionality (different modules and high level dependencies) as well as implementation tools
  • Awareness of cultural diversity and can embrace and capitalize those differences; applies knowledge in decision-making process
  • Project planning/scheduling and budgeting skills
  • Ability to identify project risks by defining risk strategies and developing the risk management plan
  • Participates as part of a team, understanding the various work styles of others and their roles on the team. Demonstrates enthusiasm and commitment to the goals and objectives of the team. Seeks help from other team members as appropriate
  • Ability to represent the company and department in a positive and professional manner
  • Embraces entrepreneurial spirit in work through recognizing and capitalizing on opportunities to improve the organization
  • Project Management certification (PMP or PRINCE2 Practitioner) is beneficial but not required
  • undefined

Flexible Working
So that you can be your best at work and home, we consider flexible working arrangements wherever possible.


At Strada, our values guide everything we do:

· Anticipate Customer Needs – We stay ahead of trends so our customers can grow and succeed.

· Own the Outcome – We take responsibility for delivering excellence and ensuring things get done right.

· Challenge Ourselves to Work Smarter – We move faster than the world around us to drive change and accomplish more.

· Empower Each Other to Solve Problems – We tackle challenges head on, ask tough questions, and collaborate to find the best solutions.

· Care About Our Work – We understand that what we do impacts millions, and we have a responsibility to get it right.


Benefits

At Strada, we support your whole self—offering a range of benefits for your health, wellbeing, finances, and future. These include health coverage, wellbeing programs, paid leave (vacation, sick, parental), retirement plans, learning opportunities, and more.


All offers are contingent on successful completion of background checks, where permitted by law and as appropriate for the role. These may include identity, education, employment, and in some cases, criminal history verification, checks against global watchlists, credit reports, and/or drug testing. You’ll be informed of the specific checks applicable to your role and location during the recruitment process.


Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Strada is dedicated to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. We believe that embracing differences strengthens our teams and drives innovation and success.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Strada is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination based on legally protected characteristics. We provide reasonable accommodations for disabilities and religious practices. Applicants may request reasonable accommodation by contacting their recruiter.


Authorization to work in the Employing Country

To be considered, you must have current and future work authorization in the country where you're applying, without the need for visa sponsorship by Strada.


Please note: This job description does not limit Strada’s right to assign or reassign responsibilities, including to subsidiaries, partners, or future business purchasers.

We offer you a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

Salary Pay Range

Minimum - Maximum:

$88,200.00 - $163,800.00

Pay Transparency Statement: Stradaconsiders a variety of factors in determining whether to extend an offer of employment and in setting the appropriate compensation level, including, but not limited to, a candidate’s experience, education, certification/credentials, market data, internal equity, and geography. Stradamakes these decisions on an individualized, non-discriminatory basis. Bonus and/or incentive eligibility are determined by role and level.

DISCLAIMER:

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job to other entities; including but not limited to subsidiaries, partners, or purchasers of Strada business units.

Inside Sales Supervisor

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for an Inside Sales Supervisor to help manage and grow the day-to-day sales operation while leading a small sales/customer service team.

You’ll work directly with company leadership and own the sales lifecycle from inbound inquiries through quoting, closing, shipping coordination, and post-sale follow-up. You’ll also coach a two-person support team, delegate tasks, and help ensure customers receive a strong experience throughout the sales process.

This is a high-autonomy, startup-like environment suited to someone who is confident speaking with customers, enjoys coaching a small team, and is comfortable solving different problems each day.

What You’ll Own

Inbound Sales & Customer Communication

  • Answer incoming calls and emails from current customers and leads.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of the company’s products.
  • Determine the appropriate next steps for each customer inquiry.

Sales & Closing

  • Manage customer inquiries throughout the sales process.
  • Prepare quotes and close orders.
  • Answer customer questions and complete required paperwork.
  • Take ownership of opportunities from inquiry through close.

Lead Follow-Up

  • Maintain long-term leads through consistent and proactive follow-up.
  • Keep opportunities moving forward through timely communication.
  • Identify when additional team support or follow-up is needed.

Team Leadership & Delegation

  • Coach a two-person sales/customer service support team on customer communication.
  • Delegate tasks to team members when appropriate.
  • Help the team stay organized and responsive to customer needs.

Post-Sale Coordination

  • Monitor the post-sale process and shipping experience.
  • Help resolve issues and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Maintain strong customer relationships after the sale.

Application Developer - Grant Management System Remediation & Workday Integration

Position Summary

The Application Developer is responsible for the remediation, enhancement, maintenance, and integration of the organization's Grant Management System (GMS) with Workday and related enterprise applications. This role will design, develop, test, and support Windows desktop applications, web services, data integrations, reports, and database components that support grant lifecycle management, financial compliance, budgeting, cost allocation, and reporting functions.

The Developer will work closely with business stakeholders, project managers, database administrators, and Workday integration teams to modernize and maintain a mission-critical application environment. The position requires strong expertise in Microsoft technologies, including C#, .NET Framework, WPF, SQL Server, SSRS, SSIS, and enterprise integration services.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

1. Application Development

  • Remediate, enhance, and maintain the organization's Grant Management System to support evolving business and compliance requirements.
  • Design, develop, and support Windows desktop applications using C# and .NET Framework 4.6.2.
  • Develop and maintain user interfaces utilizing Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF), Ribbon controls, and WinForms components.
  • Implement and support Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) architecture using SimpleMvvmToolkit.
  • Develop reusable application components, business logic, and service layers.

2. System Integration

  • Design and maintain integrations between the Grant Management System and Workday.
  • Develop and support WCF (SOAP) services utilizing FSADataService and related enterprise service components.
  • Design and consume APIs, web services, and data exchange processes.
  • Utilize Newtonsoft.Json for data serialization and JSON processing.

3. Database Development

  • Develop, optimize, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases.
  • Create and support T-SQL stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, and queries.
  • Manage and maintain SSDT database projects.
  • Design and troubleshoot database performance issues and data integrity concerns.
  • Develop and maintain ADO.NET data access layers using typed DataSets.

4. Reporting & Analytics

  • Design, develop, and maintain SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) reports.
  • Support embedded reporting solutions utilizing Microsoft ReportViewer controls.
  • Develop data extracts, dashboards, and operational reports supporting grant management activities.

5. Data Integration & ETL

  • Design, develop, and maintain SSIS packages for ETL processes and data feeds.
  • Support data migration, validation, transformation, and reconciliation activities.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot automated integration processes.

6. Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Create and execute MSTest unit tests.
  • Participate in code reviews and application testing activities.
  • Develop documentation, deployment procedures, and technical specifications.
  • Ensure adherence to software development lifecycle (SDLC) standards and best practices.

7. DevOps & Source Control

  • Utilize Visual Studio, MSBuild, and NuGet package management tools.
  • Manage source code through Azure DevOps, TFS, or equivalent version control platforms.
  • Participate in release management, deployment automation, and application support activities.

8. Production Support

  • Analyze and resolve application defects, incidents, and performance issues.
  • Provide technical support for business users and operational teams.
  • Participate in after-hours support activities as required for critical system releases or production incidents.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Equivalent combination of education and directly related experience may be considered.

Experience

  • Five (5) years of professional software development experience.
  • Three (3) years of experience developing applications using C# and .NET Framework.
  • Three (3) years of Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL development experience.
  • Experience building and supporting Windows desktop applications using WPF and/or WinForms.
  • Experience with enterprise system integrations and web services.
  • Experience developing and supporting SSRS reports and SSIS packages.

Required Technical Skills

  • C# on .NET Framework 4.6.2
  • WPF and WinForms development
  • MVVM architecture using SimpleMvvmToolkit
  • WCF (SOAP) services
  • ADO.NET and Typed DataSets
  • Microsoft SQL Server
  • T-SQL Stored Procedures
  • SSDT Database Projects
  • SSRS and ReportViewer
  • SSIS ETL Development
  • Newtonsoft.Json
  • Visual Studio
  • MSBuild
  • NuGet
  • TFS or Azure DevOps
  • MSTest Unit Testing
  • Microsoft Office Excel Interop

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating enterprise applications with Workday.
  • Experience supporting grant management, financial management, ERP, or compliance systems.
  • Experience with financial reporting and governmental grant administration.
  • Experience working in public sector, higher education, healthcare, or nonprofit environments.
  • Knowledge of federal grant management requirements, cost allocation methodologies, and compliance reporting.
  • Experience with software modernization and legacy application remediation projects.
  • Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies.
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud services and hybrid integration architectures.
  • Experience supporting complex reporting and business intelligence solutions.

Core Competencies

Technical Competencies

  • Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
  • Enterprise Application Development
  • Database Design and Administration
  • ETL and Data Integration
  • Systems Analysis and Troubleshooting
  • Reporting and Business Intelligence
  • Software Testing and Quality Assurance
  • Secure Software Development Practices

Professional Competencies

  • Analytical Thinking
  • Problem Solving
  • Attention to Detail
  • Customer Service Orientation
  • Written and Verbal Communication
  • Collaboration and Teamwork
  • Planning and Organization
  • Adaptability and Continuous Learning
  • Accountability and Results Orientation

Recommended Certifications

Microsoft Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate

Project & Quality Certifications

  • Certified Scrum Developer (CSD)
  • Professional Scrum Developer (PSD)
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)

Database & Reporting Certifications

  • Microsoft SQL Server Certification (legacy or equivalent experience)
  • Microsoft Business Intelligence or Data Analytics Certifications

Workday Certifications (Preferred)

  • Workday Integration Certification
  • Workday Studio Certification
  • Workday Reporting Certification

Position Success Factors

The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to modernize and support a complex Grant Management System while ensuring reliable integration with Workday, maintaining data integrity, delivering high-quality reporting capabilities, and supporting mission-critical grant administration processes through secure, maintainable, and scalable software solutions.

Benefits

AG Consulting Partners, Inc. is a Redmond-based boutique consulting firm. Our mission is to embrace the entrepreneurial spirit to relentlessly deliver an exceptional experience and results for our people and our clients.

We put our people first. Our excellent benefits to full-time employees include medical, dental, vision, PTO, 401K matching, education reimbursement, community and philanthropic events and flexible career paths.

We’re humbled to be consistently acknowledged by local and national organizations for our success, including Consulting Magazine, Puget Sound Business Journal, and Inc. 5000.

The compensation for this position is tailored to reflect your unique skill set, relevant experience, and the current dynamics of the job market. We strive to ensure that our compensation package is competitive and fair, taking into account various factors to provide a rewarding opportunity for our team members.

The annual salary range for this role is: 95000-135000 USD annually.
