1komma5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn more about our Product & Tech team!

deine position

Heartbeat AI is our energy optimisation platform that always provides our customers with the cleanest and cheapest energy. Great go-to-market starts with understanding our customers, and the best way to do that is to talk to them.

As a Customer Engagement Working Student on the Go-to-Market team, you reach out by phone to customers at key moments in their journey, check in on how things are going, and find out whether there is anything we can do to help. This is not a sales role. It is a listening and support role, where your conversations give the Go-to-Market team a first-hand view of the customer experience across our markets. You will support initiatives end to end, and your insights will directly feed decisions that go to Product, Sales, and Marketing, helping us sharpen our positioning, messaging, and customer journey.

  • You support Heartbeat AI GTM efforts across multiple markets by calling customers to check in, understand how their experience is going, and gather first-hand feedback

  • You listen carefully and document what customers tell you, turning individual conversations into clear and structured insights for the GTM team

  • You identify where we can add value, whether that means answering a question on the spot, coordinating support with the right team, or connecting the customer with a colleague who can help further

  • You help customers who are interested in taking the next step find their way to the right team, always with a supportive and pressure-free approach

  • You log every conversation accurately in our CRM and keep customer records current, so every customer receives consistent and joined-up support

  • You spot patterns across calls, markets, and customer groups, and turn them into short, usable summaries that can be compared across countries and inform positioning, messaging, and journey improvements

  • You coordinate logistics and follow-ups with Product, Tech, Marketing, and Sales stakeholders across regions, and join relevant syncs to learn how those conversations happen

  • You help maintain performance dashboards and trackers on customer outreach and outcomes across multiple markets, keeping data current so the team can see quickly where we can improve the customer experience, wherever it shows up

  • You take ownership of clearly scoped tasks and small projects end to end, checking in proactively when priorities are unclear

  • You report into the Go-to-Market Director but work closely with all the Go-to-Market team members across the globe

dein profil

  • You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s programme, ideally in Business, Energy Economics, Communications or a related field, and can work around 15 to 20 hours per week alongside your studies

  • You are curious about GTM, customer journeys, or customer insight, and want to learn how a scaling tech company listens to its customers and turns what it hears into better decisions

  • You are comfortable picking up the phone and speaking with customers, and you enjoy building rapport with people from all kinds of backgrounds

  • You are a genuine listener: you ask thoughtful follow-up questions and know when to speak and when to stay quiet

  • You are empathetic and patient, and you stay calm, warm, and professional in every conversation

  • You are structured and reliable: you follow through on tasks without being chased, keep accurate notes, and flag early when something’s blocked, even when juggling requests from more than one market team

  • You are comfortable working with spreadsheets, CRM tools, and data, and you’re keen to spot patterns in customer feedback rather than just running through a call list

  • You communicate clearly and aren’t afraid to ask questions or push back when something doesn’t add up, even when talking to more senior stakeholders

  • You are a fast learner who’s comfortable picking up new tools and adapting to a fast-changing environment, and to working with different teams and cultures across markets

  • You are fluent in German (C1/C2), written and verbal, as you will be speaking with German customers every day, and you are also fluent in English (C1/C2); additional European languages (Italian, Spanish, or others relevant to our markets) are a plus

  • Prior exposure to customer support, the energy market, or a tech/startup environment is a plus, but not a must

benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen

  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate

  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers

  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups

  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich

  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass

  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens

  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

Introduction to the Team & Role

As a Client Success Partner Coach (or CSP Coach), you will own the most critical customers in France and support, mentor and guide the CSPs that manage them.

The Client Success Partners are guiding the learning and development strategies of our customers through the 360Learning platform. They develop a strong relationship with each client and make sure our customers are satisfied, our contracts are renewed and our customers expand. As a Coach, your role is fundamental for the team: you are responsible for the development of every team member and the achievement of renewal and expansion of clients, for the largest accounts in the French market.

Within 1 month, you will:

  • Have started the new coach onboarding program
  • Have defined your routine with each team member
  • Pass the product pitch, competitor analysis and case study onboarding
  • Establish yourself as the point of escalation on your team’s accounts
  • Have familiarized yourself with the product, industry, and the internal tools designed for customer management at 360

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Define a reliable forecast
  • Define initiatives to fill any identified gaps in your team and with customers
  • Report on risk, detailed product needs, retention, expansion and customer performance metrics as well as support on customer warning meetings
  • Deliver the first quarterly performance review for your direct reports
  • Have defined the OKRs for the next quarter
  • Have defined a routine for working with the AMs / the product / the alliances / CS Ops
  • Be autonomous on the account reviews

Within 6 months you will:

  • Make sure your team's CSPs will reach their targets
  • Talk regularly with Decision Makers / HRs or L&D Directors
  • Identify expansion with the AE on your team’s book of business
  • Lead customer experience meetings to showcase how your customers are leveraging collaborative learning
  • Identify and nurture customer advocates to produce influenced sales
  • Have defined a vision/roadmap for your book of business for the next 12 months
  • Depending on the context, you will also hire new teammates and ensure their successful onboarding in your team

Within 12 months, you will:

  • Be a go to resource on the most sophisticated usage of the platform from our most demanding French customers
  • Define an annual roadmap for French strategic customer market, understanding competitors and opportunities for 360 Learning
  • Work with teammates on their self career development
  • Define career plans for each member of your team
  • Be able to improve the support offered to our customers

The Skill Set

  • At least 10 years of extensive experience in Customer Success and 5 years in a Manager position
  • Ability to find the middle ground between the product, learning and development strategy and champion collaborative learning to drive the French strategic business forward
  • Understanding of French enterprise market dynamics (corporate culture, L&D trends, procurement)
  • Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills (C-level execs, HR/L&D leaders)
  • Data-driven decision making (analyzing churn, adoption, and success metrics)
  • Coaching and mentoring skills (developing junior/mid-level client success managers)
  • Performance management & career development planning
  • Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR)
  • Successful experience as a CSP coach (having achieved objectives over the last 18 months)
  • Ability to conduct meetings with CEOs, Directors or COMEX members at a customer site
  • Experienced in managing complex customer situations
  • Ability to intervene in the pre-sales phase to promote and advise on the support required by the prospect
  • Ability to rely on the right people internally to move a project forward or manage a conflict
  • Excellent interpersonal skills
  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here:

What We Offer

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈
  • Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent.
  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠. Working remotely from outside France is also possible, subject to some conditions (tenure, performance, destination, length, etc.) and the approval of our Remote Committee 🌍
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 🌎🌏🌍
  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: & find out more about the teams, product and processes 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆

Interview Process

  • Phone Screen with the Talent Acquisition Manager
  • Discovery Meeting with the Senior Director of Customer Success
  • Case study with the Chief Customer Officer and the Senior Director of Customer Success
  • Meeting with the VP Sales Enterprise
  • Culture Fit Meeting with the CEO
  • Meet & greet with the CS team
  • References & Offer !
    • ⇾ Get ready using our Knowledge Base:

Who We Are

360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.
360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

Learning Includes Everyone.

In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!

raw.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Strategic Finance is a high-visibility, high-impact role embedded in the company’s decision-making core. You will partner with our executive, product, and go-to-market (GTM) teams, owning the financial modeling and analysis that drives our product and corporate strategy, optimizes our GTM engine, and informs critical operational decisions.

What you’ll do:

  • Partner with Product and GTM leaders to evaluate the financial ROI and viability of new products, business lines, and R&D investments.
  • Own the long-range plan, connecting product and revenue metrics to financial outcomes and keeping reporting accurate, timely, and consistent.
  • Build and maintain financial models that translate operating plans into outcomes, risks, and opportunities, including unit economics, pricing analysis, and scenario planning.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives on resource allocation, operational efficiency, and scaling business processes.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, corporate finance, or investment banking.
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong financial modeling skills, with a rigorous, quantitative approach to forecasting, budgeting, and measuring operational performance.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to turn complex financial concepts into clear narratives for non-financial stakeholders and to partner with senior leaders.
  • A high standard for operational excellence and a clear sense of how to turn ambiguous business questions into actionable plans.
  • Experience using AI tools to work faster and better, and a willingness to introduce them to your team and cross-functional partners.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with software, internet, consumption-based, subscription, advertising, or AI-driven business models.
  • Experience with ERP and planning tools such as NetSuite, Workday, Pigment, or Adaptive.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

raw.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:


EverPro, a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.

EverPro is looking for a Customer Experience Systems Strategist to join our Systems Operations team. In this role, you will own the strategy, implementation, and optimization of the technology that powers our Customer Experience teams across the EverPro portfolio.

In this role you will be responsible for the strategic transformation of the Customer Experience for EverPro’s customers. This will include the selection, implementation, and optimization of the technology that power our Customer Experience teams.

A major focus of this role will be helping our businesses modernize their CX technology stack, including the implementation and optimization of Fin (formerly Intercom), customer support platforms, and AI-powered service tools.


Responsibilities

  • Own CX technology implementations across EverPro businesses, from discovery and requirements gathering through configuration, testing, launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
  • Lead implementations and expansion of Fin and other AI-powered Customer Experience solutions across our portfolio.
  • Partner with CX leaders and Ops partners to understand business objectives, pain points, workflows, and customer journeys and translate them into technology solutions.
  • Help teams develop the processes, knowledge, and content required to successfully deploy AI-powered customer service experiences.
  • Own or support implementation of Customer Support, Customer Success, knowledge management, conversation intelligence, telephony, and CRM platforms.
  • Define implementation requirements, system architecture, integrations, workflows, permissions, reporting, and governance standards.
  • Lead data migration and system consolidation efforts when businesses transition from one CX platform to another.
  • Manage multiple cross-functional initiatives simultaneously and maintain clear project plans, dependencies, risks, decisions, and stakeholder communications.
  • Stay current on emerging AI and Customer Experience technology and identify opportunities to improve customer experiences while increasing operational efficiency.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • 5+ years of experience implementing, administering, or owning Customer Experience, Customer Support, Customer Success, or related SaaS platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Fin or a comparable AI-powered customer service platform strongly preferred.
  • Experience leading technology implementations from requirements gathering and solution design through launch and adoption.
  • Strong understanding of Customer Support and/or Customer Success operations, including case management, routing, automation, knowledge management, self-service, customer communications, and reporting.
  • Experience designing or implementing workflows that combine AI, automation, and human-assisted customer service.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with multiple businesses, technology stacks, and competing priorities.
  • Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to think strategically about the broader customer experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience implementing AI agents, chatbots, or generative AI within Customer Support or Customer Success organizations.
  • Experience with Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Planhat, ChurnZero, or similar CX/CS platforms.
  • Experience consolidating multiple Customer Support or Customer Success organizations onto a common technology stack.
  • Experience working within a multi-brand, portfolio, or SaaS organization.
  • Experience developing business cases and measuring ROI for CX technology and automation investments.

Where: Canada Remote
The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in Canada– if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Robust wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
  • 3 weeks of vacation to start, a paid volunteer day of your choosing, plus 2 floating holidays to celebrate anything of significance to you
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with 4% company match

Compensation: The target base compensation for this position is $120,000–$140,000 CAD per year in most Canada locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!


EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work.

raw.excerpt: Who We ArePindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do

Pindrop is looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to help our go-to-market (GTM) teams plan smarter, forecast with confidence, and sell more efficiently.

Reporting to the Director, Revenue Operations, you'll be the analytical and operational partner behind RevOps initiatives across GTM planning, forecasting, compensation, systems, and partner operations. You'll work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partnerships, Deal Desk, and Finance to gather the data, uncover what's working and what isn't, and bring the analysis that informs the department’s decisions. You'll support initiatives from discovery and analysis through design, build, and enablement.

This is a Manager-level individual contributor role. As you build expertise in our business, your impact will grow, from improving the data and reporting our teams rely on every day to shaping the analysis behind key GTM decisions.

We’re looking for someone who brings three strengths: the drive to find what’s slowing our teams down and build better processes to fix it, the ability to build trusted relationships with the teams RevOps supports, and strong analytical skills that turn data into clear recommendations.

GTM Planning, Capacity, and Compensation

  • Partner with cross-functional teams on annual and in-year GTM planning, building the processes and running the analysis behind territory design, books of business, account scoring, segmentation, and pipeline modeling
  • Deliver analyses that inform our headcount and capacity models, including rep ramp, productivity, and coverage assumptions, and create the executive dashboards that show where we have capacity gaps and need to hire
  • Own day-to-day sales compensation administration, including plan documents, new-hire setup, attainment tracking, and payout support
  • Provide the attainment and productivity analysis that informs compensation plan design, quota methodology, and rules of engagement

Forecasting, Pipeline, and Performance Insights

  • Own data preparation, meeting materials, and follow-up for weekly forecast and pipeline reviews
  • Own forecast data quality for net-new and renewal business, identifying and driving cleanup with sales managers, and help develop clear rules for pushing or closing deals
  • Own the reporting and dashboards that reps, managers, BDRs, and executives use to run the business, and deliver analyses on funnel conversion, velocity, attribution, and productivity
  • Help develop and maintain standard definitions for core GTM metrics and objects, such as customer, pipeline stages, and ARR, so every team works from the same numbers

Systems, Process, and Partner Operations

  • Proactively identify process gaps and issues across the GTM lifecycle, and develop solutions to correct them, including the system requirements, user experience, and plan for maintaining the data
  • Own Salesforce data quality, and help design and implement improvements across the sales cycle, including stage gates, lead routing, approvals, and Deal Desk workflows
  • Support partner operations across referral, reseller, marketplace, and alliance motions, including deal registration, approval processes, partner attribution, and field enablement on partner types
  • Build trusted relationships with GTM leaders and their teams, representing RevOps in working sessions and bringing the feedback and data that help the Director prioritize RevOps initiatives
  • Support GTM tool and vendor management, RevOps request intake, and the rollout and enablement of new tools and processes, including analysis for new tool and process investments
  • Work with Deal Desk, Legal, and Customer Success on process improvements that shorten the path from quote to close

Who you are

  • You take ownership and do the things you say you'll do
  • You dig into the data, spot what doesn't add up, and come back with a recommendation, not just a report
  • You enjoy building processes and infrastructure from the ground up, not just maintaining what already exists
  • You think about how a change lands with the reps, managers, and partners who have to live with it
  • You manage multiple projects at once and prioritize by business impact
  • You use AI responsibly to improve processes and work more efficiently, and you take full ownership of the final output

Your skill-set

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred
  • 3-5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Sales Strategy, or GTM Analytics, preferably at a high-growth B2B SaaS company
  • Admin-level Salesforce experience, including reports and dashboards, objects and fields, validation rules, and Flows (Salesforce Administrator certification a plus)
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, including the analysis and modeling that support planning, capacity, or compensation decisions
  • Working knowledge of SaaS metrics and the B2B sales cycle, including pipeline coverage, conversion rates, ramp, attainment, ARR, and retention
  • Experience with Gong, Outreach or Salesloft, LeanData, Gainsight, Highspot, Coefficient, DocuSign, Unifyr, or Tackle.io is a plus
  • Experience with SQL, BI/visualization tools, or data warehouses such as Databricks or Snowflake is a plus

What’s in it for you

  • Build the foundation, not just maintain it. RevOps at Pindrop has high-impact work ahead in planning, forecasting, compensation, and partner operations, and you'll help decide how it gets done.
  • See how a scaling revenue organization is run. You'll work directly with the Director of Revenue Operations and alongside Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Finance leaders, with visibility into how GTM decisions get made.
  • Support a business with real market urgency. AI-driven fraud and deepfakes are now a board-level concern for large enterprises, and your work will help the teams bringing Pindrop into those conversations operate at their best.
  • Work inside an AI-first organization. Pindrop is investing in AI across the business, and you’ll use AI to automate reporting, data cleanup, and systems work, and help define what an AI-enabled RevOps team looks like.
  • Grow your impact. As you build expertise, you’ll have more opportunities to shape how our GTM teams plan, forecast, and operate.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year, subject to manager approval and applicable company policies.
  • Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year
  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
  • Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!
  • Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution
  • Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.
  • Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents
    • One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It’s our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family!
  • Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work.
  • Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.
  • Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer.

US Base Pay Range
$90,000—$108,000 USD

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

raw.description:
Metro Vein Centers is a rapidly growing healthcare practice specializing in state-of-the-art vein treatments. Our board-certified physicians and expert staff are on a mission to improve people’s quality of life by relieving the painful, yet highly treatable symptoms of vein disease—such as varicose veins and heavy, aching legs.

With over 70 clinics across 9 states, and still growing, we’re building the future of vein care—delivering compassionate, results-driven care in a modern, patient-first environment.

We proudly maintain a Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 93, the highest patient satisfaction in the industry.

This is not a generic sales role.

We’re hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) - internally named, Patient Intake Coordinator, with experience in medical call centers, front desk patient scheduling, or insurance-based sales. You’ll serve as the first voice a patient hears, managing phone conversations with empathy and urgency while verifying insurance, overcoming objections, and securing appointments across our 60+ clinics. As a Patient Intake Coordinator, your mission is to connect with prospective patients, bring clarity to their symptoms and treatment options, and confidently guide them to book a vein evaluation and ultrasound. You are the frontline driver of new patient growth, ensuring every interaction is patient-first, educational, and action-oriented.

Success in this role requires a deep understanding of healthcare workflows, confidence navigating insurance barriers, and prior experience converting calls into booked visits.

If you’ve worked in a medical practice, urgent care center, or dental front desk—and know how to guide patients, ask the right questions, and document accurately in EMRs—this is for you.

Language Skills
We are now accepting applications for bilingual, English / Spanish speaking candidates only.

Compensation

Independent Contractors (Latin America only)

  • $1,500 USD per month base compensation, paid bi-weekly

Compensation structure is based on employment classification and work location.

  • Schedule: Full-time | Includes evenings and one weekend day

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the first point of contact for new patient leads
  • Proactively connect with patients via inbound and outbound phone calls, email, and text
  • Build rapport, answer questions, and guide patients to book consultations at over 60 nationwide clinics
  • Communicate insurance coverage and payment options clearly to minimize booking barriers
  • Verify insurance, initiate authorization requests, and manage CRM/EMR documentation
  • Troubleshoot patient concerns and tailor your messaging to improve conversion rates (CVR)
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a seamless handoff to clinical care
  • Continuously refine your approach based on feedback and performance data

What Success Looks Like

Your performance will be measured by:

  • Activity & Productivity: Maintain high engagement by making and taking up to 100 calls per day.
  • Appointment Booking: Consistently book 10 to 15 evaluations with an ultrasound (U/S) per day.
  • Conversion Performance: Achieve a 55%+ conversion rate on qualified calls.
  • Operational Excellence: Deliver a consistent, patient-first experience aligned with QA guidelines and document 100% of interactions accurately in CRM/EMR systems.
  • Speed and efficiency in response times and follow-up
  • Patient satisfaction scores (NPS, direct feedback)

What You’ll Bring

  • Drive & Resilience: A competitive work ethic and a "productivity mindset". You should be energized by scoreboards and metrics, with a high resilience to rejection.
  • Sales Execution: Strong persuasion and objection-handling skills. You are comfortable "controlling a conversation" and moving a patient from initial interest to a scheduled visit.
  • Operational Discipline: The ability to navigate multiple tools (CRM, EMR, and phone systems) simultaneously with high attention to detail under pressure.
  • Coachability: A commitment to growth, with the ability to act on coaching and feedback quickly to improve performance.
  • Background Preference: Experience in sales (e.g., cold calling) or high-volume service environments (e.g., military or hospitality) is highly valued.
  • Bilingual in Spanish is a requirement

Requirements

  • Based in Latin America and working as an independent contractor (this role is not open to US-based applicants)
  • Fluent in English and Spanish for live patient calls
  • Available full time on US time zone hours, including evenings and one weekend day
  • Your own computer, noise-cancelling headset, webcam, reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, private workspace

How to Apply

Submit your resume and answer the application questions. Qualified applicants are invited to a short one-way video interview on HireFlix, answered in English and Spanish.

Healthy legs. Happier lives.
At Metro Vein Centers, we believe exceptional care begins with an exceptional experience. Our mission is to make vein care approachable, empowering, and connected to overall well-being. From the first conversation to the final follow-up, every patient interaction reflects our commitment to compassion, expertise, and trust.

A team united by purpose.

Our values guide everything we do:

  • Commitment to Growth – We invest in our people, fostering advancement and professional development at every level.

About NLA and TCS

New Left Accelerator (NLA) and its 501(c)(3) affiliate, The Capacity Shop (TCS), lead operational capacity-building programs that empower social justice organizations and movements to execute bold work safely. We bridge the gap between ambitious strategy and operational excellence, scaling structures and impact without sacrificing legal compliance or integrity. To achieve systemic change, organizations must use every tool in their toolbox effectively—including multi-entity structures.

Through deep collaboration with field experts, we build the financial and compliance training systems that allow movement organizations to manage risk and remain resilient. Our work is rooted in a commitment to:

  • Power Building For Systemic Change: Equipping organizations to build power to dismantle oppressive structures.
  • Operational Power: Building the "operational" capacity to execute bold work and to strategically manage risk.
  • A Multi-Entity Lens: Optimizing the diverse legal structures necessary to win critical battles.
  • Transformative Partnerships: Prioritizing those working at the intersections of race, gender, and class.

At NLA, our work is guided by a Theory of Change. We accompany organizations and movements in building sustainable, resilient ecosystems prepared to win the most ambitious fights of our time.

Overview

NLA and TCS are seeking a systems-minded Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day processes that keep our organization running smoothly. This role will split their time supporting the logistics for three critical areas: Operations, People & Culture, and Fundraising. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple workflows while collaborating with multiple stakeholders. This is a full-time, fully remote role reporting to the Finance and Operations Manager.

This is a remote position. We strongly prefer candidates who can work 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central Time to support collaboration with the Operations team.

Responsibilities

Operations & Systems Logistics

  • Support the Finance & Operations Manager with the high volume of contracts, including tracking the process in Asana to ensure contracts are executed in a timely and accurate manner
  • In coordination with the Finance & Operations Manager, implement and maintain the Google Drive architecture, and lead troubleshooting support with staff
  • Support Finance & Ops Manager with large volume of vendor bill tracking using Bill.com and QuickBooks Online
  • Support additional Operations projects as assigned.

Compliance

  • Create and maintain a compliance calendar (such as business insurance reporting requirements, deadlines, and renewals)
  • Support the Finance & Operations Manager with tracking state payroll registrations, correspondence, and business account information
  • Track and maintain the organization’s state workers’ compensation insurance, including supporting the People & Culture Director with regular audits

Fundraising Operations

  • Maintain up-to-date and accurate data in the contact management Airtable
  • Maintain up-to-date data in the grant tracking Airtable in collaboration with the Fundraising team
  • Ensure grant and fundraising documentation including grant agreements and payment confirmations, is up-to-date and accurate in Google Drive
  • Support the preparation and submission of grant materials

People & Culture (supporting the Director of People & Culture)

  • Support logistics for staff step-backs and retreat planning, including: location and lodging research, scheduling, and travel logistics
  • Coordinate staff recognition efforts
  • Support with annual open enrollment and other benefits administration projects

Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong alignment with NLA’s vision and organizational values
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in nonprofit operations/administrative roles, with a strong preference for candidates who have movement-building and/or 501(c)(4) experience
  • Proficiency with database management that includes grants and/or contracts tracking
  • Experience and an understanding of nonprofit compliance requirements, strong preference or experience with multi-entity compliance across 501(c)(4), 501(c)(3), campaign, PAC
  • Solid judgment, project management, analytical, planning, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and highly organized
  • Proficiency in coordinating multiple projects and competing deadlines
  • Commitment to a collaborative and learning culture
  • High level of professionalism and discretion in handling confidential information
  • Knowledge of and familiarity with the following systems: Google Suite, Asana, Dropbox Sign (or similar e-signature software), Airtable, QuickBooks Online, and Bill.com

Compensation, Benefits, and Position Details

Title: Operations Coordinator

Reports to: Finance and Operations Manager

Hours: Full-time

Location: Remote, U.S.-based (applicants must reside and be able to legally work in the United States); Some domestic travel required (1-3 times per year)

Compensation: Starting at $60,720-$66,000 per year

Benefits: NLA offers a competitive benefits package available to all full-time employees, including:

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance
  • Dental and vision insurance covered at 75%
  • 50% employer-paid insurance coverage for all dependents
  • Employer-paid short-Term disability and life insurance
  • FSA/HSA accounts
  • Flexible paid time off, including vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, 1-week summer break, and 1-week winter break
  • Professional development funding
  • Monthly work-from-home technology stipend
  • Retirement plan with up to 4% employer matching

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a UX Writer, Product Experience to help create clear, consistent, and intuitive language across Bask Health's software platform.

As a UX Writer, you'll help people understand how to use these tools through thoughtful, concise, and practical interface language.

This is a hands-on product writing role focused on the words people encounter while using software. You'll work on navigation labels, buttons, onboarding instructions, form guidance, tooltips, notifications, error messages, confirmation screens, and other interface content that helps users complete tasks.

Your work will span merchant-facing and patient-facing experiences. Merchants need clear instructions for configuring storefronts, managing products, and operating their businesses, while patients need understandable guidance as they complete questionnaires, navigate checkout, and interact with digital healthcare experiences.

You'll collaborate closely with product designers, product managers, engineers, and content designers to understand how features work and ensure the language within those features is useful, accurate, and consistent.

Rather than simply editing copy after a feature has been designed, you'll participate throughout the product development process. You'll review prototypes, identify confusing interactions, recommend improvements, and help teams make decisions about how information should be communicated.

You'll also help maintain consistent terminology and tone across the platform. As Bask continues developing new features, you'll contribute to writing guidelines and reusable interface patterns that make product experiences feel connected.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, clarity and accuracy are especially important. You'll work with appropriate subject matter experts when content involves clinical or pharmacy-related processes, ensuring that language reflects approved functionality and avoids misleading or unsupported claims.

You'll use usability feedback, research findings, and product observations to improve existing interface language and identify opportunities to reduce confusion.

We're looking for someone who enjoys making complicated software easier to understand, has strong attention to detail, and knows how to write concise product content that helps users take the right next step.

What You'll Do

  • Write clear, concise, and user-friendly interface copy across Bask Health's platform.
  • Develop navigation labels, button text, menu descriptions, and contextual instructions.
  • Write onboarding guidance for merchant-facing and patient-facing experiences.
  • Create form labels, helper text, placeholders, and validation messages.
  • Improve error messages so users understand what went wrong and how to resolve it.
  • Write confirmation messages, success states, and next-step instructions.
  • Develop clear empty-state messaging and contextual guidance.
  • Create interface content for merchant dashboards and administrative tools.
  • Write instructions for storefront configuration and business management workflows.
  • Improve patient-facing questionnaire instructions and form guidance.
  • Support checkout and account management experiences with clear interface language.
  • Develop notification and status messaging for approved platform workflows.
  • Collaborate with product designers to ensure copy fits naturally within interface layouts.
  • Review wireframes and prototypes to identify unclear language or confusing interactions.
  • Work with product managers to understand feature requirements and user goals.
  • Partner with engineers to ensure interface copy is implemented correctly.
  • Maintain consistent terminology across different areas of the platform.
  • Contribute to UX writing guidelines and reusable content patterns.
  • Help define tone and language standards for product interfaces.
  • Review existing product copy for clarity, consistency, and accessibility.
  • Simplify technical terminology into language users can understand.
  • Participate in product discovery, design reviews, and planning discussions.
  • Work with researchers to evaluate whether users understand interface instructions.
  • Incorporate usability findings and product feedback into copy improvements.
  • Collaborate with clinical and pharmacy stakeholders when specialized terminology requires review.
  • Document writing decisions, terminology recommendations, and content changes.
  • Support content quality reviews before product releases.
  • Own assigned UX writing projects from initial requirements through implementation and iteration.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in UX writing, content design, product writing, or a closely related field.
  • Portfolio or writing samples demonstrating UX writing for digital products.
  • Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
  • Experience creating interface copy for web or mobile applications.
  • Strong understanding of user-centered writing principles.
  • Ability to communicate complex information clearly and concisely.
  • Experience writing navigation labels, buttons, instructions, error messages, and notifications.
  • Familiarity with common digital product interaction patterns.
  • Understanding of plain-language writing principles.
  • Experience collaborating with product designers and product managers.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineers during product implementation.
  • Familiarity with Figma or comparable collaborative design tools.
  • Understanding of accessibility and inclusive writing practices.
  • Experience maintaining consistent terminology across multiple product experiences.
  • Familiarity with UX writing guidelines or content style guides.
  • Ability to review interfaces and identify confusing or unnecessary language.
  • Experience incorporating feedback into writing improvements.
  • Familiarity with usability testing and user research concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to explain writing decisions and communicate recommendations clearly.
  • Experience working in cross-functional product development teams.
  • Ability to balance user needs, product requirements, and technical constraints.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple assignments.
  • Ability to independently deliver high-quality product writing.
  • Interest in improving software usability through thoughtful communication.

Nice to Have

  • Experience writing for SaaS platforms or business software.
  • Familiarity with merchant-facing tools and administrative dashboards.
  • Experience writing for e-commerce or direct-to-consumer products.
  • Background in healthcare, telehealth, or patient-facing digital experiences.
  • Experience writing onboarding instructions and multi-step form guidance.
  • Familiarity with subscription, checkout, or account management workflows.
  • Understanding of healthcare-related privacy considerations.

  • Familiarity with white-label or multi-tenant SaaS products.
  • Experience writing for configurable workflows.

  • Experience writing for AI-powered interfaces or assistants.
  • Understanding of responsible AI communication and clear user expectations.
  • Familiarity with frontend development concepts.
  • Experience working in fast-moving, cross-functional product teams.

About the Role

NetOps Africa is helping a client seek an experienced IT Support Engineer with Tier 2 or Tier 3 experienceto provide technical end-user support and infrastructure administration within a fast-paced Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment.

You will resolve technical issues across workstations, servers, networks, Microsoft 365, cloud services, and business applications. This role requires strong troubleshooting abilities, excellent customer service, detailed documentation, and the ability to independently manage technical issues through resolution.

The ideal candidate has hands-on MSP experience, a solid foundation in Microsoft technologies and networking, and enjoys working directly with clients to resolve complex technical challenges.

Technical Support and Troubleshooting

Documentation and Team Collaboration

  • Collaborate with senior engineers on complex escalations and infrastructure issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve technical processes and reduce recurring incidents.

Minimum Requirements
  • At least 3 years of professional IT support experience, preferably within an MSP environment.
  • Strong hands-on experience supporting Windows 10/11 and Windows Server environments.
  • Solid knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and NTFS/share permissions.
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Entra ID, and Microsoft Intune.

  • Working knowledge of Hyper-V, VMware, or comparable virtualization technologies.
  • Familiarity with backup and disaster recovery solutions such as Datto, Veeam, or Acronis.

  • Ability to troubleshoot independently, prioritize workloads, and manage escalated support tickets.

Preferred Experience and Certifications

  • Microsoft certifications such as MS-102, MD-102, or AZ-104.
  • CompTIA A+, Network+, or Security+.
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting and technical automation.
  • Familiarity with phone-based technical support queues and remote customer support.
  • Experience mentoring junior technicians.

Remote Working Requirements

As this is a fully remote position, candidates must have:

  • Reliable fiber internet with a minimum speed of 100 Mbps.
  • Reliable backup power to maintain productivity during power interruptions.
  • A suitable computer with at least an Intel Core i5 or equivalent processor, preferably no older than five years, and a minimum of 8 GB RAM (16 GB preferred).

Complete your application on the NetOps Africa career site and submit your required introductory video and CV with relevant experience.

When was the last time your upline actually picked up the phone? Here, you get direct coaching from a 40-year industry veteran.

At Taubman Financial Management (TFM), we believe experienced agents deserve better. We're an independent life and annuity agency built on one simple idea: put people first and success follows. Your effort is what gets rewarded here, not your recruiting numbers, your seniority or who you know.

100% remote. Live and work anywhere in the U.S.

Compensation that respects your production

  • Competitive, transparent contract levels from day one, with a clear path to higher levels based on your results
  • You own your book of business
  • No mandatory fees, no hidden splits, and no required lead purchases

Mentorship directly from me, not a call center

Everything we do is focused on one goal: helping you build a career you succeed in and reach the goals you set for yourself.

Advanced markets support for your bigger cases

  • Debt management and financial planning resources that open the door to whole-household relationships

Bring us your complex cases. We'll help you design them, present them and close them.

Leads on your terms

One fully automated system, from quote to placed policy

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Hong Kong. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Hong Kong.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

As a subject matter expert and team lead, you will not only anticipate risks and formulate advanced scoping strategies but also propose new methodologies to elevate the discipline as a whole. You will exercise significant judgment to deliver a definitive impact on customer and operational goals, frequently leading cross-functional efforts and coordinating the activities of your peers to ensure departmental success.

What You’ll Do


Methodology Innovation

  • Advance the scoping discipline by proactively proposing and implementing new techniques, tools, and methodologies tailored to evolving business contexts and industry trends.

Complex & Ambiguous Scoping

  • Lead the discovery and scoping of highly complex, ambiguous enterprise engagements. Conduct in-depth evaluations of variable, hard-to-identify factors to anticipate implementation risks and recommend sustainable, creative solutions.

Strategic Autonomy & Execution

  • Translate broad departmental objectives into actionable processes. Independently define and execute the approach for new, special, or unprecedented scoping assignments.

Team Leadership & Coordination

  • Act as a team lead by coordinating the daily activities of other scoping team members, ensuring the successful, high-quality completion of departmental assignments and SOWs.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead cooperative efforts among members of different teams (Sales, Delivery, Product, Legal) to align on complex deal structures and deliver seamless pre-sales to post-sales transitions.

Departmental Impact

  • Exercise significant interpretative judgment to evaluate different technical approaches, making impactful recommendations that definitively drive customer, operational, and service objectives across the department.

What You'll Need


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 6+ years of experience in SaaS professional services, pre-sales, solution scoping, implementation, or technical consulting, with a strong preference for experience supporting Workiva solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven track record acting as a team lead, coordinating the work of junior and mid-level analysts.
  • Deep understanding of the broader SaaS industry and a demonstrated ability to connect day-to-day scoping work to the achievement of high-level company objectives.
  • Ability to navigate high ambiguity, conduct detailed evaluations of complex data, and apply expert knowledge using creative means.
  • Capacity to evaluate various technical and commercial techniques, making definitive and impactful recommendations.
  • Exceptional ability to lead cooperative efforts without formal reporting lines, regularly interacting with managers and liaising with senior managers.
  • Strong capability to independently map out and determine processes for completely new or special assignments.
  • Strong organizational and leadership skills necessary to guide peers and coordinate multi-person tasks.

Travel Requirements and Working Conditions

  • 25% travel for internal meetings
  • Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely and not in a Workiva office

Workiva will not provide visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. on a permanent basis.

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $106,000.00 - $185,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
description: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

raw.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
raw.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
raw.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Job Description: Veterans Service Officer (VSO)

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote, United States

About the Role

We are seeking VA-accredited Veterans Service Officers to help evaluate and improve AI systems focused on veterans' benefits. You will use your claims experience to review questions from veterans and their families and ensure AI-generated answers are accurate, clear, and useful. No prior AI experience is required.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Review veterans' benefits questions for accuracy and real-world relevance.
  2. Develop evaluation guidelines covering service-connected disability compensation, claims filing, and supporting evidence.

Required Qualifications

  1. Current VA accreditation as a VSO representative, County Veterans Service Officer, accredited claims agent, or equivalent.
  2. At least 1 year of experience preparing and filing VA claims for veterans or their families.
  3. Knowledge of disability compensation, dependent and survivor benefits, and appeals processes.
  4. Must be based in the United States.
  5. Available for 20–30 hours per week and able to start quickly.
  6. Strong written communication and attention to detail.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with military records, including DD-214 forms.
  • Experience creating guides, checklists, or training materials.
  • Experience assisting diverse veterans and families, including rural and non-English-speaking communities.
