Director of Sales Engineering

Graphiant is transforming enterprise networking with a modern, scalable Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) platform designed for performance, simplicity, and agility. As we expand into new markets, we’re looking for a senior technical sales expert to support strategic customer engagements and partner enablement across the U.S.

As the Director of Sales Engineering, you’ll serve as the senior technical point of contact for our sales team and partners throughout the region. While this is an individual contributor role, you’ll operate at a highly strategic level—leading technical sales efforts, shaping customer architecture decisions, and driving solution adoption in complex enterprise environments. This role is ideal for a hands-on Sales Engineering leader who excels in high-impact engagements, builds strong relationships, and thrives in fast-paced, early-stage settings.

Reports To:

Head of Sales

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead technical sales efforts across the U.S., working closely with account executives, channel partners, and enterprise customers
  • Own the technical sales cycle from discovery to solution design, POC execution, and post-sale transition
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers and partners, articulating Graphiant’s platform value and architectural differentiation
  • Deliver compelling technical presentations, demos, and workshops for both executive and engineering audiences
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams—Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success—to influence product direction and customer experience
  • Partner with the broader Sales Engineering team to share regional insights, best practices, and competitive intelligence
  • Represent Graphiant at industry events, customer briefings, and partner-led engagements throughout the region
  • Support onboarding, training, and technical enablement for partners and internal sales teams

Core Competencies

  • Expert-level knowledge of enterprise networking—ideally including NaaS, SD-WAN, hybrid cloud, or edge connectivity
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technology into business value
  • High emotional intelligence and executive presence—able to influence decisions without direct authority
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action and comfort operating without formal structure
  • Travel as needed across the U.S. (~30–40%)
  • Comfortable balancing strategic customer conversations with hands-on solution validation

Experience

  • 10+ years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or technical customer-facing roles
  • Proven success supporting complex enterprise sales cycles and working with field sellers, channel partners, and cross-functional teams
  • Background in networking, cloud infrastructure, or SaaS technologies
  • Demonstrated ability to drive technical sales outcomes without direct reports or large team structure
  • Experience with partner/channel engagements and co-selling preferred
  • Familiarity with PoCs, network design reviews, and integration planning in pre-sales contexts

  • Ensure all systems are operated, maintained, and disposed of IAW documented security policies and procedures, including but not limited to Assessment & Authorization (A&A).
  • Support the development and maintenance of all security documentation, such as the System Security Plan, Privacy Impact Assessment, Configuration Management Plan, Contingency Plan, Contingency Plan Test Report, POA&M, annual FISMA assessment, and incident reports.
  • Coordinates with appropriate stakeholders and system owners to ensure all NIST 800-53 controls are properly implemented and assessed during the steps of the ATO lifecycle
  • Research assigned IT security systems to provide insight into IT security architectures and IT security recommendations for assigned systems.
  • Report and respond to security incidents.
  • Assess vulnerabilities to determine if additional safeguards are necessary, ensure systems are patched and security-hardened at all levels of the “stack,” and monitor to ensure vulnerabilities are remediated as appropriate.

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions delivers cybersecurity and IT services to federal civilian, defense, and national security customers nationwide. We support the full cyber lifecycle, from secure system design and accreditation through AI-enabled operations, threat emulation, and continuous improvement, across classified and unclassified environments. Our work is independently certified for quality and security, including CMMI, CMMC, and ISO certifications.

Valiant is a multi-year Washington Business Journal Best Places to Work winner, and our growth and cyber leadership have been recognized by Washington Technology, Northern Virginia Technology Council, and the Triangle Business Journal. We offer strong benefits, rewards for earning industry certifications, and room to grow your career as we grow. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, our distributed workforce supports customers from coast to coast. We go where the stakes are highest, and the margin for error is zero. If you want meaningful work alongside talented professionals, apply today.

Benefits Snapshot

Valiant takes care of the people who support our customers, with real choices in coverage and real investment in your career. Eligible full-time employees receive:

  • A choice of medical plans, from an affordable HSA option to a full-featured PPO, with generous company contributions
  • Dental and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Company-paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
  • Optional supplemental life, accident, and critical illness coverage to round out your protection
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off that grows with your years of service, plus paid federal holidays
  • Paid certifications, professional development, and the Valiant University training portal
  • Flexible spending accounts and a wellness and fitness program
  • Referral bonuses when you help us bring great people to Valiant

Benefit eligibility and plan details are subject to the terms of each plan and may change from time to time.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $115,000 to $130,000. This range reflects Valiant Solutions' good-faith estimate of the base salary reasonably expected for this position upon hire, at the time of posting. The range has been established based on the scope of the role, market rates, and internal equity. Where a candidate falls within the posted range will depend on job-related factors, including relevant skills, experience, qualifications, achievements, education, geographic location, applicable security clearance requirements, additional corporate responsibilities, and other legitimate, non-discriminatory business considerations. The posted range does not guarantee an offer at any particular salary. In addition to base salary, this position includes the benefits described above.

Remote Work Policy (Remote and Hybrid Positions Only)

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that aligns with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. In alignment with Valiant's inclusive and engaging environment, cameras are encouraged and can be required to be on during virtual video conferences. Additionally, in alignment with the Office of the Inspector General’s effort to eliminate conflicting employment, all Valiant employees are required to disclose any current or future outside employment engagements. During onboarding and throughout employment, employees must disclose any current activities or intent to engage in outside employment or other professional activities and obtain written approval. Employees may not solicit or conduct any outside business during core business hours for Valiant Solutions and our clients.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Valiant Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Valiant Solutions provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

Physical Demands

Sitting or standing at a desk for prolonged periods and consistently operating a computer. Frequent communication and exchanging of accurate information via electronic communication, phones, and in person. Occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information

By submitting your resume for this position, you authorize Valiant Solutions to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates, and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education, and experience. Job Role: Salesforce Technical Consultant

Compensation range: $3,000 AUD - $4,000 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: The client partners with individuals going through sensitive family-related legal issues by covering legal expenses upfront. Their models looks at the strengths of each case rather than someone’s financial background, allowing them to provide support quickly.

Role Overview: This is a key role in our team building our new core business platform on Salesforce. You will help shape our future, with an immediate focus on improving functionality, delivering enhancements, fixes, debugging, support and crucial data analysis. By investigating issues and strengthening our current system, you’ll lay the groundwork for our next phase of innovation. You engage directly with key business stakeholders, learn from a high-performing team in a supportive environment and manage your work directly through Jira. As a Salesforce technical consultant, you will be part consultant, part developer, be comfortable working with business stakeholders and understanding the underlying requirements, and be very familiar with the Salesforce platform, common patterns and best practices.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define requirements for platform enhancements and fixes.
  • Perform debugging, root cause analysis, and resolve technical issues on the Salesforce platform.
  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies to ensure data integrity.
  • Deliver solutions using declarative Salesforce tools (Flow, Validation Rules, Permissions).
  • Undertake light Apex and customisation as needed.
  • Support and troubleshoot system integrations.
  • Manage your workload and priorities using Jira.
  • Document fixes, technical findings, and best practices.

Requirements

  • 5+ years proven experience in a Salesforce support, analyst, or consultant role.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging skills and communication skills.
  • Comfortable communicating directly with stakeholders to understand requirements, manage expectations and share findings.
  • Anticipate business needs beyond what’s explicitly specified in the requirements.
  • Proficient with Salesforce declarative tools, especially Flow.
  • Basic to intermediate skills in Apex and/or Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Experience with Jira or similar project management tools.
  • Familiarity with our wider tech stack is highly regarded, including CI/CD (e.g. Gearset), version control (e.g. GitHub), OmniStudio, JotForm, HubSpot, Slack, AWS S3 and Dialpad.
  • A proactive learner, keen to grow your career in a collaborative team.
  • Salesforce Certifications including Platform Developer II (PD2) and related certifications are very highly regarded.


Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

Benefits

    • 13th-Month Pay (Pro-Rata): Contractors who remain actively engaged with the company as of December 20 each year, and are not under notice of termination, are eligible for a pro-rata 13th-month payment based on their period of engagement during the year.
    • Liquidity Event Bonus (LEB): Contractors accrue a cash bonus of AUD $5,000 for each completed year of service, capped at AUD $30,000 per contractor. This is paid within 30 days of a liquidity event, such as a company sale or IPO, provided the contractor is actively engaged with the company at that time.
    • Paid NSW Public Holidays: Filipino contractors are paid for the 9–10 days each year when the company is closed for New South Wales public holidays.
    • Equipment: New contractors are provided with a laptop of their choice (Mac or PC), which will be shipped to them before their start date, subject to completed paperwork and background checks.

raw.title: Integrated Marketing Specialist

raw.description:
Are you a digital marketing professional who loves combining creativity, technology, and strategy to make an impact? Innovetive Petcare is looking for an Integrated Marketing Specialist to join our growing marketing team!
This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on digital marketer who enjoys managing websites, optimizing content, improving search engine visibility, and bringing digital projects to life. You'll play an important role in strengthening the online presence of more than 80 veterinary hospitals across our network of specialty, emergency, and general practices.
If you're comfortable working in WordPress, understand SEO best practices, enjoy exploring new digital and AI tools, and have a knack for keeping projects organized and moving forward, we'd love to hear from you!

About Innovetive Petcare

Innovetive Petcare is an Austin-based veterinary management company supporting a growing network of 80+ specialty, emergency, and general practice veterinary hospitals. We provide business management resources, marketing expertise, and operational support that empower veterinary teams to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care to pets and their families.
Our mission is simple: Excellent pet care comes from exceptional teams. We believe in supporting our hospitals while preserving the unique identities and cultures that make each practice special.

What You'll Do

As our Integrated Marketing Specialist, you'll help execute digital marketing initiatives that strengthen our hospitals' online presence, improve the user experience, and support business growth across multiple veterinary brands.
Website Management & Digital Content
  • Manage and maintain multiple WordPress websites using Beaver Builder and Elementor.
  • Create, edit, optimize, and publish website content, including landing pages, service pages, and reusable page templates.
  • Ensure website content is accurate, engaging, user-friendly, and aligned with brand standards.
  • Apply on-page SEO best practices to improve organic search visibility, website traffic, and content performance.
  • Maintain accurate hospital information, service details, and location content across websites and Google Business Profiles.
  • Conduct website audits to identify opportunities for improvements in content, functionality, technical performance, and search visibility.

    SEO & Digital Optimization
  • Research and implement SEO recommendations using tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other digital marketing platforms.
  • Monitor website performance and identify opportunities to improve search rankings, engagement, and user experience.
  • Evaluate SEO recommendations against Google guidelines, analytics, and actual performance data.
  • Leverage AI tools to support content development, research, optimization, and workflow efficiency while ensuring accuracy and quality.
  • Stay current on digital marketing trends, SEO developments, website best practices, and emerging technologies.
Project Coordination & Execution
  • Coordinate website updates and digital marketing projects from initial assignment through completion.
  • Collaborate with internal marketing and creative teams, hospital leadership, external vendors, and digital partners.
  • Support website launches, quality assurance testing, and troubleshooting of website functionality, integrations, widgets, and online forms.
  • Manage project timelines, track deliverables, communicate progress, and proactively address potential roadblocks.
  • Ensure digital projects are completed accurately, efficiently, and in alignment with established priorities and brand standards.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve consistency across multiple hospital websites and brands.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a proactive, detail-oriented digital marketing professional who enjoys taking ownership of projects, solving problems, and balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on digital marketing experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing WordPress websites, including working knowledge of Beaver Builder and Elementor.
  • Working knowledge of SEO principles, including on-page optimization, keyword research, metadata, content structure, and organic search best practices.
  • Experience using SEO platforms such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, or comparable tools.
  • Strong digital content writing, editing, publishing, and optimization skills.
  • Proficiency with AI tools and the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated content for accuracy, quality, and relevance.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a desire to continuously improve processes and results.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Looker Studio.
  • Familiarity with creative and design tools such as Canva, Figma, Adobe Photoshop, or Adobe Illustrator.
  • Experience with Asana, Microsoft Office, or similar project management and productivity platforms.
  • Experience supporting veterinary, healthcare, or other multi-location businesses.
  • Familiarity with local SEO and Google Business Profile management.
  • Experience coordinating website launches, redesigns, or multi-site digital marketing initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means helping our veterinary hospitals put their best digital presence forward. You'll make an impact by:
  • Keeping hospital websites accurate, current, engaging, and optimized for search engines
  • Improving website content, usability, and organic search performance.
  • Managing digital projects efficiently while meeting deadlines and maintaining quality.
  • Identifying website issues and opportunities before they become bigger challenges
  • Maintaining consistent brand presentation and accurate hospital information across digital platforms.
  • Finding smarter ways to work through technology, AI, and process improvements.
  • Building strong working relationships with internal teams, hospital stakeholders, and external partners.

Work Environment & Schedule

  • Location: Austin, Texas, with Texas-based candidates preferred.
  • Work Arrangement: Primarily a professional office or remote work environment, depending on business needs and approved work arrangements.
  • Schedule: Generally standard business hours, with occasional flexibility needed to support website launches, project deadlines, or time-sensitive initiatives.
  • Travel: Occasional travel to veterinary hospitals or company meetings may be required.
  • Technology: Regular use of computers, WordPress, digital marketing platforms, project management systems, and virtual collaboration tools.

Why Innovetive Petcare?

At Innovetive Petcare, you'll be part of a growing organization where your work directly supports the teams caring for pets and their families every day.

We believe in creating an environment where talented people can bring ideas forward, collaborate, grow professionally, and make a meaningful impact. You'll have the opportunity to work across a diverse network of veterinary hospitals, contribute to exciting digital initiatives, and help shape how our practices connect with the communities they serve.

Our benefits and perks may include:
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance options
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • Continuing education and professional development opportunities
  • Employee discounts on veterinary services
  • Opportunities for career growth and advancement
  • A collaborative team environment that encourages innovation and continuous improvement

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you're a digital marketing professional who enjoys the intersection of website management, SEO, content strategy, technology, and project coordination, we'd love to meet you!

Apply today to join Innovetive Petcare as our Integrated Marketing Specialist and help strengthen the digital presence of veterinary hospitals across our growing network.

Our recoverability platform is purpose-built by frontline recovery experts and is deployed across hybrid cloud and on-premise environments; delivering measurable improvements in recovery readiness and faster, more confident restoration when ransomware strikes.

About This Position

The ROC Manager, Network Services leads a team of network and firewall specialists embedded in Grypho5's unified ROC and reports to the Director, ROC Technical Services. The successful candidate is responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations of the Network Services team and ensuring that all customer inquiries and issues are resolved in a timely and efficient manner, while maintaining uninterrupted 24x7x365 watch coverage for the perimeter defense practice.

Subject Matter Expert - Infrastructure as Code & DevOps Automation

Position Summary

We seek an experienced IT Automation Specialist to lead infrastructure automation initiatives across our enterprise environment. As a subject matter expert, you will design, implement, and maintain scalable automation solutions using industry-leading tools including Terraform, OpenTofu, Ansible, AWX/Tower, and advanced DevOps platforms. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with strategic thinking to drive infrastructure modernization and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform and OpenTofu for cloud and on-premises infrastructure provisioning
  • Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks and roles for configuration management, application deployment, and system patching across heterogeneous environments
  • Architect and optimize Ansible Tower/AWX implementations for enterprise-scale automation, including RBAC, credential management, and workflow orchestration
  • Lead adoption of agentic AI capabilities to automate decision-making processes and reduce manual operational overhead
  • Establish the best automation practices, standards, and frameworks; conduct code reviews for infrastructure automation projects
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex automation issues; provide technical documentation for knowledge transfer to other teams
  • Integrate automation solutions with CI/CD pipelines, monitoring systems, and ticketing platforms
  • Document technical architecture, runbooks, and operational procedures for all automation systems
  • Evaluate and recommend new automation tools and technologies that improve efficiency and reduce operational risk
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Cloud, Infrastructure, Security) to embed automation across IT operations

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of IT infrastructure and systems administration experience
  • Expert-level proficiency with Terraform and/or OpenTofu; demonstrated ability to manage complex infrastructure states
  • Advanced expertise in Ansible; proven experience in designing and maintaining Ansible Tower or AWX in production environments
  • Strong Python programming skills; ability to write custom modules, plugins, and automation scripts
  • Deep understanding of DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code best practices
  • Experience with public cloud platforms (Azure, GCP) and hybrid/on-premises infrastructure
  • Knowledge of version control systems (Git) and collaborative development workflows
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities with demonstrated experience resolving production incidents
  • Excellent communication skills; ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience implementing and managing agentic AI solutions for IT operations automation
  • Experience with advanced Ansible Tower features (workflows, dynamic inventory, LDAP/SAML integration)
  • Familiarity with configuration management databases (CMDB) and ServiceNow integrations
  • Knowledge of GitOps methodologies and tools (ArgoCD, Flux)
  • Certifications such as HashiCorp Certified Terraform Associate, Ansible Specialist, or equivalent cloud/infrastructure certifications
  • Open-source project contributions or demonstrated thought leadership in the infrastructure automation community

Technical Skills Matrix

IaC: Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation | Expert

Config Management: Ansible, Ansible Tower, AWX | Expert

Agentic AI: LLM orchestration, AI-driven automation, prompt engineering | Intermediate+

Languages: Python, Bash, Go, HCL, PowerShell | Advanced

Cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, hybrid infrastructure | Advanced

raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Product Engineer to help build and improve the merchant-facing experiences that power businesses on Bask Health.

You'll work across the frontend and backend to create intuitive, reliable tools that help merchants configure their businesses, manage products and subscriptions, and operate their telehealth storefronts.

This is a hands-on product engineering role for someone who enjoys owning features from initial concept through implementation, deployment, and iteration. You'll collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering, balancing thoughtful user experiences with scalable backend architecture.

We're looking for an engineer who can move comfortably between React interfaces, TypeScript services, databases, and third-party integrations—and who understands that great product engineering requires both technical quality and an understanding of the people using the software.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain full-stack features for Bask's merchant platform.
  • Build merchant-facing interfaces using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
  • Develop backend functionality and services using Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Improve merchant onboarding and business setup experiences.
  • Build and refine tools for managing storefront configurations and settings.
  • Develop interfaces for product catalogs, product configuration, and commerce workflows.
  • Support subscription management and merchant-facing billing experiences.
  • Build intuitive workflows for configuring and operating telehealth businesses.
  • Develop APIs connecting merchant-facing applications with backend services.
  • Work with SQL databases to model and manage merchant and commerce-related data.
  • Design reliable integrations between merchant tools and other Bask platform capabilities.
  • Improve the usability, responsiveness, and accessibility of merchant interfaces.
  • Collaborate with product managers and designers to translate business needs into production features.
  • Participate in technical planning, architecture discussions, and implementation decisions.
  • Take ownership of features from requirements through release and ongoing improvements.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex merchant workflows.
  • Improve performance and reliability across frontend and backend systems.
  • Write maintainable, well-tested code and participate in code reviews.
  • Investigate and resolve production issues across the application stack.
  • Help establish reusable frontend patterns and shared product components.
  • Consider security, privacy, and tenant isolation when building merchant functionality.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity while maintaining engineering quality.
  • Mentor other engineers through technical feedback, collaboration, and code reviews.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to continuously improve the merchant experience.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, preferably in full-stack or product engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and maintaining production web applications.
  • Professional experience with TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience developing frontend applications using React.
  • Experience with Next.js or comparable React-based application frameworks.
  • Experience building backend applications and services using Node.js.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, API integration, and backend service design.
  • Experience working with SQL databases and relational data models.
  • Ability to develop features across the frontend and backend independently.
  • Experience designing and implementing complex application workflows.
  • Strong understanding of frontend architecture, state management, and component design.
  • Familiarity with authentication, authorization, and application security principles.
  • Experience debugging and optimizing production applications.
  • Understanding of software testing, automated testing practices, and code quality.
  • Experience working with Git and collaborative engineering workflows.
  • Ability to translate product requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to balance technical decisions with usability and business needs.
  • Experience collaborating with product managers, designers, and other engineers.
  • Comfort taking ownership of projects and delivering production-ready functionality.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and contribute effectively in a remote engineering environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building merchant-facing SaaS platforms or business management tools.
  • Experience with e-commerce platforms, Shopify integrations, or direct-to-consumer businesses.
  • Familiarity with subscription commerce and recurring billing workflows.
  • Experience integrating payment platforms such as Stripe.
  • Experience developing product catalogs, merchant dashboards, or storefront management tools.
  • Experience with AWS services and serverless architecture.
  • Familiarity with SST, AWS Lambda, SQS, or EventBridge.
  • Experience with tRPC, Prisma, or Drizzle ORM.
  • Experience working in multi-tenant SaaS architectures.
  • Familiarity with monorepo development environments.
  • Experience building reporting or analytics features for business users.
  • Understanding of conversion optimization and merchant onboarding.
  • Experience with design systems and reusable component libraries.
  • Familiarity with accessibility and frontend performance optimization.
  • Experience developing software for healthcare, telehealth, or other regulated industries.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA-related engineering considerations.
  • Experience using AI development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or contributing to technical architecture decisions.

About the Job



Summary

Corporate FP&A is an important function for Ovation Healthcare, sitting at the center of the broader finance team to support the CFO and other business leaders to run and grow the business—and to ensure Ovation Healthcare’s leadership and board gain financial visibility and insights on the business. This team runs Ovation Healthcare’s financial processes, including our Strategic and Annual Planning process and quarter forecasts, and helps architect the information flow and methodologies we need for dynamic business partnership. This leader establishes processes on return on investment for critical investments for the business. Sales operations builds and supports sale pipelines, salesforce compensation and supports and sets up and runs Ambulatory surgery center accounting/finance.
Corporate FP&A sets the parameters and forecast processes for the finance team and partners with other key operational teams on the moving pieces that impact our financial outlook. You will work with partners across finance and the leadership team.

Job Duties

  • Manage key financial processes, including strategic planning, budget planning, forecasting and performance reporting.
  • Perform monthly analysis of actual compared to budget/forecast for the income statement by line of business and for cash flow and balance sheet accounts.
  • Architect financial commentaries and documents to support key financial deliverables.
  • Develop new processes or improve existing processes relating to financial planning/reporting.
  • Develop key metrics to track team-specific and company-wide trends, identify opportunities, provide recommendations, and collaborate across all levels.
  • Support ad hoc projects and help define systems improvements to support the company’s growth.
  • Apply an analytical approach to influence strategic decision-making, with a focus on capital allocation decisions and long-term financial planning.
  • Establish ROI reporting and evaluation of significant investments to drive decision making on key investments.
  • Provide financial analysis and commentary to important partners including Ovation Healthcare’s board and management team.
  • Provide guidance and reporting on sales pipeline, contract renewals, sales performance, and critical opportunities.
  • Manage and continue to grow a team.
  • Understand how to operate in and improve upon Ovation Healthcare's financial systems.
  • Coordinates sales forecasting and actively monitors sales metrics and sales progress. • Supports the development of sales territories and provides market intelligence essential to the sales organization. Recommends revisions to existing reports or assists in the development of new reporting tools as needed.
  • Supports Ambulatory Surgery Center business through management and oversight for accounting and back office processes.
  • Implements enabling technologies to field sales teams. Monitors compliance and optimizes the effectiveness of technology investments; and
  • Defines, Builds and Reports and Supports KPI reporting for customers, internal business leaders and board.
  • Defines sales operations needs working closely with sales and marketing and supports pipeline creation, update and defines and supports sales compensation

Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of experience in finance preferred, with 5+ years in FP&A in FP&A.
  • Shown record of growth in responsibilities and leadership.
  • Bachelors Degree required, MBA preferred.
  • Healthcare experience preferred.


Benefits


The base compensation range for this position is:


$190,090.88 - $304,145.41

Compensation ranges could be hourly or salary depending upon the exempt status of the posted position.


Beginning compensation is determined based on objective factors such as location, qualifications, skills, certifications, and experience. Typically, a candidate is hired in the lower to midpoint of the range; the top end of the range is reserved for candidates with extensive specialized experience and mastery within the role. Compensation may increase over time based on performance, experience, and tenure.


Compensation is only part of Ovation's total compensation package. Some additional benefits offered to full-time associates are:

  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short and long-term disability coverage
  • HSA with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts for health care, and dependent care accounts
  • Wellness platform with premium incentives
  • Employee assistance support and additional voluntary supplemental plans including accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and child disability insurance
  • Robust and flexible paid time off offerings and company paid holidays
  • 401(k) plan with discretionary employer match opportunities
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Company issued equipment

raw.description:
Overview

Overview:

We are looking for a self-directed BI Analyst to join our growing HealthEdge Business Intelligence team. In this role you will own the end-to-end design and delivery of business intelligence dashboards in Tableau and Amazon QuickSight, working in close partnership with internal HealthEdge stakeholders to turn data into clear, actionable insight.

You will collaborate daily with our onshore and offshore data engineers, who build and maintain the AWS-based lakehouse and analytics-ready data sources you will consume. Your focus is on the analytical and visual layer: understanding what business teams need to decide, modeling the data into intuitive dashboards, and delivering a polished, usable experience that holds up to executive and operational scrutiny.

The ideal candidate operates independently, has strong opinions about usability and visual design, and is relentless about working efficiently — shipping high-quality dashboards quickly and iterating with users rather than disappearing for weeks at a time.

Core Responsibilities

Dashboard Design and Development

  • Build, publish, and maintain Tableau and Amazon QuickSight dashboards that serve internal HealthEdge operational and executive audiences.
  • Translate business questions into well-modeled QuickSight datasets and Tableau data sources, applying appropriate joins, calculated fields, parameters, and filters.
  • Apply strong visual design principles — clear hierarchy, intentional use of color, consistent layout, and accessible typography — so dashboards are immediately usable by their intended audience.
  • Optimize dashboard performance, evaluating SPICE vs. Direct Query in QuickSight and live vs. extract connections in Tableau, and managing refresh schedules.
  • Maintain a clean, well-organized portfolio of published assets across both BI platforms, retiring stale content rather than letting it accumulate.

Stakeholder Partnership and Insight Delivery

  • Engage directly with internal business stakeholders across the organization to understand the decisions they need to make and what evidence would change those decisions.
  • Distill findings into clear narratives and recommendations; package insights so non-technical stakeholders can act on them without translation.
  • Maintain lightweight documentation describing what each dashboard answers, what it does not, and who owns the underlying data.

Collaboration with Data Engineering

  • Partner with onshore and offshore data engineers to define and refine the analytics-ready data sources that power dashboards.
  • Write your own SQL for ad-hoc analysis, prototyping, and data validation; surface gaps, quality issues, or modeling changes back to the data engineering team.
  • Help prioritize the data engineering backlog by clearly articulating which new data, columns, or refresh frequencies are needed to unlock business value.

Quality, Iteration, and Continuous Improvement

  • Validate dashboard numbers against source systems and surface discrepancies promptly.
  • Monitor usage and gather feedback from end users; retire or rework dashboards that are not earning their place.
  • Identify and propose opportunities to consolidate redundant reports, improve refresh cadence, or migrate legacy Tableau or Excel content into QuickSight (or vice versa) as the platform strategy evolves.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience building production BI dashboards in Tableau, Amazon QuickSight, Power BI, Looker, or comparable modern BI tooling — with at least one tool used at deep, hands-on proficiency.
  • Demonstrated ability to design clean, usable dashboards with strong visual hierarchy, intentional use of color, and a clear point of view. Portfolio or work samples preferred.
  • Proficiency in SQL — comfortable writing your own queries to explore data, prototype, validate dashboards, and prepare datasets.
  • Solid understanding of data warehouse and lakehouse concepts: dimensional modeling, joins, granularity, slowly changing dimensions, and the difference between transactional and analytical data.
  • Strong sense of ownership and self-direction. Comfortable managing your own prioritization across multiple internal stakeholders and asking for help when blocked.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication. Able to translate ambiguous business questions into a sharp set of dashboards and to explain results clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience, in a quantitative, analytical, design, or business field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with both Tableau and Amazon QuickSight, including dataset creation, calculated fields, parameters, row- and column-level security, and dashboard publishing in each.
  • Healthcare or health plan domain experience (claims, membership, provider, care management, or customer support data).
  • Experience translating workbooks and reports between BI platforms (Tableau ↔ QuickSight, Excel → BI tool).

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to shape the analytical and visual layer of a greenfield AWS-native BI platform.
  • A collaborative, small-team environment where your dashboards land in front of HealthEdge leadership and operational teams and directly inform decisions.
  • Exposure to a broad technology stack spanning analytics, data engineering, and modern cloud infrastructure.
  • A collaborative team that values quality, usability, visual design, and efficient delivery.

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

**The annual US base salary range for this position is $114,000 to $122,000. This salary range may cover multiple career levels at HealthEdge. Final compensation will be determined during the interview process and is based on a combination of factors including, but not limited to, your skills, experience, qualifications and education.

raw.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Tailscale is looking for a Developer Relations Engineer to own and improve the developer experience across Tailscale’s expanding product portfolio. You’ll help developers understand, adopt, extend, and build with our core VPN/connectivity product, while also shaping how that experience evolves as Tailscale expands into new product areas like secure AI access (Aperture), privileged access management (PAM), and whatever comes next.

You’re a builder, investigator, and storyteller. You write code, chase technical curiosities all the way down, and turn what you learn into things other developers can use like demos, docs, talks, blog posts, sample apps, workshops, videos, tools, and open source contributions. You build things, break things, explain things, and keep going until the thing you’re working on has a name.

You’re comfortable speaking at conferences and just as comfortable digging through an API, a GitHub issue, or a weird networking edge case until it makes sense. You’re probably the kind of person who runs a local AI model in your homelab and can explain exactly why. You ask “why does it work that way?” often, and your instinct is to make the answer clearer, simpler, and better for the next developer.

Requirements

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with demonstrated experience building, debugging, and shipping real projects through professional work, open source, self-directed learning, or ambitious personal projects.
  • Ability to create clear, useful developer-facing materials, including code samples, demos, tutorials, docs, blog posts, videos, talks, and workshops.
  • Deep curiosity about how systems work, especially across networking, infrastructure, security, identity, cloud, open source, AI, or developer tooling.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems, such as production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, homelabs, local AI setups, networking experiments, or open source contributions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly, creatively, and practically.
  • Experience presenting to technical audiences, whether through conferences, meetups, livestreams, workshops, podcasts, videos, or internal engineering forums.
  • Comfortable working in public through GitHub issues, pull requests, community forums, social channels, open source projects, and developer feedback loops.
  • Strong developer empathy, emotional intelligence, and product sense; you notice friction, understand why it matters, and help translate it into better docs, APIs, examples, workflows, and product experiences.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing, support, community, and other technical stakeholders while operating independently and driving high-impact projects from idea to execution.
  • Comfortable managing multiple workstreams, meeting regular publishing, event, or launch deadlines, discussing technical tradeoffs in detail, and traveling for events, conferences, and community moments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Go, networking, VPNs, WireGuard, identity, access controls, infrastructure automation, or security products.
  • Experience building developer education programs, sample apps, workshops, technical video content, or conference talks.
  • A visible history of technical writing, talks, demos, open source contributions, or community work.
  • Experience with homelabs, self-hosting, local AI models, infrastructure experiments, or other “I wanted to understand how this works, so I built it” projects.
  • Familiarity with secure AI access, privileged access management, zero trust, or modern infrastructure security patterns.
  • Familiarity with open source contribution workflows and technical collaboration in public.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, whether gained through formal education, professional experience, open source work, self-directed learning, or building ambitious projects on your own.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems. This could include production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, open source contributions, homelab experiments, local AI setups, networking projects, or anything else that shows how you think.
  • If your background is less conventional, we still want to hear from you. Bring us your GitHub repos, blog posts, diagrams, configs, talks, demos, lab notes, or the deeply specific story of why your homelab is built the way it is.
  • Comfort discussing technical tradeoffs in detail such as explaining what you built, why you built it, what broke, what you learned, and what you would do differently next time.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

UK Pay Range

raw.title: Senior Customer Success Engineer
raw.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, technical customer success is about helping businesses successfully implement, understand, and use our software. We value technical curiosity, clear communication, proactive problem-solving, and people who take ownership of complex customer challenges.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Engineer to help Bask Health's customers successfully implement, integrate, troubleshoot, and adopt our software platform.

This role combines technical problem-solving with customer-facing communication and long-term customer success.

You'll work directly with merchants, entrepreneurs, and healthcare businesses using Bask Health to operate direct-to-consumer telehealth experiences.

Our platform supports storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and other business-critical capabilities.

You'll develop a strong technical understanding of how these systems work together and how customers use them in their daily operations.

You'll serve as a technical point of contact for customers who need help with complex implementations, integrations, platform configuration, and advanced troubleshooting.

You'll collaborate with customer success managers to understand customer goals and identify technical challenges affecting adoption or account health.

You'll help customers move from initial setup to reliable day-to-day use of the platform.

You'll provide technical guidance during onboarding, implementation, and the introduction of new platform capabilities.

You'll investigate customer-reported issues, reproduce problems when possible, and identify likely causes using available technical tools and documentation.

You'll work with engineering teams to resolve issues that require code changes, infrastructure investigation, or deeper product expertise.

You'll be responsible for communicating technical findings and next steps in a way customers can understand.

You'll help customers troubleshoot API integrations, webhooks, authentication issues, data flows, and other supported technical connections.

You'll also assist with platform configuration challenges involving storefronts, questionnaires, checkout, and workflow automation.

You'll help customers understand technical requirements, supported configurations, and implementation limitations.

As a senior member of the team, you'll take ownership of particularly complex technical customer situations.

You'll be expected to investigate issues independently, organize relevant evidence, and involve the appropriate teams when necessary.

You'll help distinguish between configuration issues, product defects, integration problems, and requests for new functionality.

You'll document your findings so customers and internal teams have clear records of technical issues and resolutions.

You'll proactively identify recurring technical challenges that may be affecting multiple customers.

You'll recommend improvements to onboarding processes, troubleshooting documentation, and technical customer education.

You'll work with product managers to communicate customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve usability and technical reliability.

You'll collaborate with engineers on issue reproduction, technical requirements, and validation of customer-facing fixes.

You'll help customers adopt new features by explaining technical functionality and supporting implementation when appropriate.

You'll also work with customer success managers to identify technical risks that could affect retention or expansion.

You'll participate in technical customer meetings when specialized knowledge is needed.

You'll be comfortable speaking with both nontechnical business owners and technically experienced customer stakeholders.

You'll translate technical information into practical guidance without overwhelming customers with unnecessary complexity.

You'll maintain awareness of security, privacy, and appropriate handling of sensitive information when investigating issues involving healthcare-related workflows.

You'll recognize when clinical, pharmacy, compliance, or patient-related questions require involvement from the appropriate authorized teams.

You'll contribute to internal technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and repeatable support processes.

You may also mentor less-experienced customer success engineers and share approaches for investigating complex issues.

This is a senior individual-contributor position with substantial technical ownership, not a formal engineering management role.

We're looking for someone with strong technical troubleshooting skills, experience supporting customer-facing SaaS products, and the ability to build trust through clear communication.

Experience supporting e-commerce merchants, online storefronts, payment workflows, or merchant-facing platforms is particularly valuable.

You should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, learning new systems, and taking responsibility for driving technical issues toward resolution.

Success in this role means helping customers implement the platform successfully, reducing recurring technical friction, improving adoption, and building confidence in Bask Health's technology.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a senior technical point of contact for assigned customer accounts.
  • Support technical onboarding and implementation for new customers.
  • Help customers configure and adopt supported Bask Health platform capabilities.
  • Investigate complex technical issues affecting customer workflows.
  • Reproduce reported problems and document relevant technical findings.
  • Troubleshoot API integrations, webhooks, and supported data connections.
  • Assist with authentication, permissions, and configuration-related issues.
  • Support troubleshooting involving merchant storefronts and checkout workflows.
  • Investigate technical issues involving questionnaires and platform configuration.
  • Help customers understand supported technical requirements and limitations.
  • Collaborate with customer success managers on technical account needs.
  • Partner with engineering teams to escalate product defects and complex issues.
  • Provide engineers with clear reproduction steps, logs, and technical context.
  • Coordinate customer communication during technical investigations.
  • Translate technical findings into clear, actionable explanations.
  • Track technical escalations through resolution and customer follow-up.
  • Identify recurring technical problems and recommend preventive improvements.
  • Help develop technical onboarding guides and troubleshooting resources.
  • Document common integration issues and recommended resolutions.
  • Support customers adopting new product features or integrations.
  • Participate in customer meetings requiring advanced technical expertise.
  • Work with product managers to communicate technical customer feedback.
  • Assist with validating fixes for customer-reported issues.
  • Identify technical risks that may affect customer adoption or retention.
  • Support internal investigations of customer configuration problems.
  • Help improve technical escalation and issue-triage processes.
  • Share technical knowledge with other customer-facing team members.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer issues, findings, and resolutions.
  • Follow security and privacy requirements when investigating customer issues.
  • Coordinate with appropriate clinical or pharmacy stakeholders when needed.
  • Recommend product improvements based on recurring customer challenges.
  • Take ownership of complex technical customer outcomes and follow through on commitments.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in customer success engineering, technical account management, solutions engineering, technical support engineering, or a closely related customer-facing technical role.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting customers using B2B SaaS or other complex software platforms.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience investigating software configuration, integration, or application issues.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP requests, and common integration concepts.
  • Familiarity with JSON, webhooks, and API authentication.
  • Ability to use technical documentation to investigate and resolve issues.
  • Experience communicating directly with customers about technical problems.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating with software engineers on customer-reported issues.
  • Ability to reproduce bugs and provide clear technical reproduction steps.
  • Experience distinguishing product defects from configuration or integration issues.
  • Strong understanding of software onboarding and implementation processes.
  • Ability to manage complex technical escalations independently.
  • Experience documenting technical investigations and resolutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to organize multiple customer issues and competing priorities.
  • Experience working with customer success, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar software systems and workflows quickly.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to technical accuracy.
  • Familiarity with software security and appropriate data-handling practices.
  • Ability to maintain customer confidence during difficult technical situations.
  • Experience using technical ticketing or customer support systems.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability to collaborate during required U.S. Eastern Time working hours.
  • Ability to take ownership of technical customer outcomes through resolution.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting e-commerce merchants or merchant-facing SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with Shopify, BigCommerce, or other online storefront platforms.
  • Experience troubleshooting checkout, payment, or subscription commerce workflows.
  • Experience working with Stripe or similar payment integrations.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Experience using browser developer tools to investigate customer issues.
  • Ability to read application logs or use monitoring tools.
  • Experience using Postman or similar API testing tools.
  • Familiarity with SQL and basic database troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting SaaS integrations and third-party applications.
  • Understanding of OAuth or other authentication frameworks.
  • Experience working with webhooks and asynchronous workflows.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based software architecture.
  • Experience supporting high-value or enterprise customer accounts.
  • Experience working with CRM or customer success platforms.
  • Experience developing technical documentation and support playbooks.
  • Experience mentoring junior technical support or success engineers.
  • Familiarity with healthcare technology or telehealth platforms.
  • Understanding of HIPAA-related technical considerations.
  • Experience supporting AI-enabled features or workflow automation.

raw.title: Founding Go-to-Market Lead, Wholesale Distribution
raw.excerpt: Wholesale distributors still take a large share of their customer orders by email: a PDF from a contractor, a spreadsheet from a plant, a photo of a handwritten list, a few lines typed into the email body.
raw.description:
Wholesale distributors still take a large share of their customer orders by email: a PDF from a contractor, a spreadsheet from a plant, a photo of a handwritten list, a few lines typed into the email body. Someone on the order desk reads each one and keys it into the ERP (the distributor's core system: Prophet 21, Eclipse, Infor, and others). Ten minutes and forty clicks per order, six people doing it all day, and every mistyped part number is a return. We are building software that reads those orders in any format, matches them to the distributor's catalog and contract pricing, and creates the order in the ERP itself, with a person reviewing only the exceptions. We are at the validation stage: before we build the full product, we want to talk to twenty distributors and run three paid pilots on real order flow. Your job is to make that happen.

Who we are

DeepSense is an AI-native company builder headquartered in Cyprus. We build software businesses with small teams and a lot of AI agents doing the routine work, and we are starting a new venture for the US wholesale distribution industry. This role is our first person on the ground in the United States.

What you will do in the first 90 days

  • Weeks 1–2: build a target list of about 100 distributors in one vertical (plumbing and HVAC) with $20–100M in revenue, using association and buying-group membership and your own network. Our agents do the research and draft the outreach; you put your name on it and pick up the phone.
    - Weeks 3–8: book and lead 20 conversations (45 minutes each) with owners, presidents, and directors of operations. The goal is to learn, not to sell: how orders come in today, how many people touch them, what breaks, what they have tried, why they said no to the vendors who called before us, whether their ERP has an API license. Our founder joins most calls; an agent takes notes.
    - Weeks 9–12: convert the best conversations into three paid pilots ($3,000–5,000 for 60 days) on live email order flow, and help define what "success" means for each one.
    - Throughout: tell us the truth about what you hear, including "nobody wants this." That answer is worth as much to us as a yes.

How we will measure the work

Three to four booked conversations per week; most of them with the person who owns the P&L or operations; three signed pilots by the end of the contract.

Who you are

- 8–15 years in US wholesale distribution, on one of two sides: you ran operations, customer service, or inside sales at a distributor with $30–200M in revenue, or you sold or implemented software for distributors (Epicor Prophet 21 or Eclipse, Infor CloudSuite Distribution or SX.e, Conexiom, DCKAP, Unilog, Proton, or similar).
- You have personally sat on, or managed, an order desk, and you know what a bad part-number match costs.
- You can name twenty distributors you would call tomorrow, and some of them would take the call.
- You are comfortable hearing no fifteen times in a row and writing down exactly why.
- You can travel to two industry events during the contract.
- You are based in the US, ideally within reach of Chicago, Dallas, Atlanta, or the Ohio Valley.

Nice to have

- Relationships inside a buying group (Affiliated Distributors, IMARK) or an association (ASA, HARDI, NAED, NAW).
- An earlier stint at an early-stage company, or a distributor that went through an ERP migration.
- You have already used AI tools in your own work and have opinions about what they get wrong.

Who this is not for

Enterprise software sellers who have never been on a warehouse floor. People who want to build a sales team before there is a product. Consultants who advise but do not make calls. Anyone who needs a finished product and a price list before they can start a conversation.

How we work

Small team, no middle management. AI agents do the list building, research, drafting, note taking, and follow-up scheduling; you do the part that needs a human who speaks the industry's language. Weekly written updates instead of status meetings. Decisions on the product are made from your call notes, so we will read every one of them.

Process

1. A 30-minute intro call with the founder.
2. A paid trial task ($1,000, five working days): book three conversations with directors of operations at distributors in the target vertical and send us notes from the first one.
3. Contract offer within 48 hours of the trial.

Contract-to-hire · Remote, US (Midwest or South preferred) · ~20% travel
$10,000–14,000 per month for a 3-month full-time contract; conversion to a founding full-time role at $130,000–170,000 base, pilot bonus, and 0.5–1% equity
